phyi nang byang chub kyi sems bcing ba'i man ngag ces bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// don dam kun rdzob byang chub sems// lhan cig skyes te mun pas bsgribs// kun tu skye ba'i nyams len ni// bdag gis 'di ru bshad par bya// spyi bo'i gtsug nas bo la'i bar// sna tshogs rtsa ni bsgom par bya// de nas bde chen 'khor lo ru// sgo nga'i khog pa lta bu yi// byang chub sems la sems gtad nas// bo la'i rtse la rgyal po tsam// gsal la sran rdog tsam du bsgom// bde chen sgo nga'i rtsa las ni// byang chub sems ni 'dzag par bya// lte ba'i bar du rnal 'byor gyi// gnyis med bdud rtsis bkang byas pas// shes pa bde ba'i mchog tu 'gyur// bsgom pa'i spyod yul phar mi spro// sems ni tshur la bkug mi bya// dper na sbrul gyi mdud pa bzhin// sems ni rang grol gnas pa ste// dngos po'i bya ba bral 'gyur ba// rnal 'byor yid kyi zhen pa chod// mī na bdag gis rtogs pas grol// byang chub kyi sems bcing ba'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon mī na pas mdzad pa rdzogs so/// / ༄༅// rlung gi de nyid bsgom pa'i man ngag ces bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon gho ra khas mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ bā yu tat+t+waṃ bha bā no pa de shaṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/ rlung gi de nyid bsgom pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gho ra kha ni ba lar srung*// ba rdzis ba lang 'tsho bar byed// 'tsho bar byed cing gnyid med 'gyur// nyi ma dang ni zla ba gnyis// ro gcig par ni 'dres par 'gyur// gho ra kha ni sgra gcan gyis// nyi ma zos pa ngo mtshar che// gal te rgyab kyi sgal tshigs su// drag tu bcings pas rnal 'byor pas// skad cig tsam gyis khams su grub// gzhom du med cing kun nas dwangs// stong nyid dngos po rnam par gsal// nyi ma dang ni zla ba gnyis// ro gcig par ni 'dres par 'gyur// gho ra kha ni sgra gcan gyis// nyi ma zos pa ngo mtshar che// shing bu gting du nub pa dang*// pha bong gyen du 'byung bar 'gyur// dga' bas bdag ni sgrub bo zhes// gho ra kha ni smra bar byed// nyi ma dang ni zla ba gnyis// ro gcig par ni 'dres par 'gyur// gho ra kha ni sgra gcan gyis// nyi ma zos pa ngo mtshar che// nor bu thams cad rdo rjes 'bigs// gho ra kha yi rnal 'byor ni// bla ma'i drin gyis grub pa yin// nyi ma dang ni zla ba gnyis// ro gcig par ni 'dres par 'gyur// gho ra kha ni sgra gcan gyis// nyi ma zos pa ngo mtshar che// rlung gi de nyid bsgom pa'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon gho ra khas mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /

༄༅// rnal 'byor bzhi'i nyams len gyi babs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon tan ti pas mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ tsa tur yo ga bha bā na nā ma/ bod skad du/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i nyams len gyi thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// sems dang sems nyid rgyu med de// bsgrub bya sgrub byed thig le'i ngo*// 'bras bu ma grub mya ngan 'das// dpal ldan dpa' bo yi ge med// lte bar gsang ba'i ge sar la// ā li kā li la brten nas// rnal 'byor bzhi yi nyams khen bshad// lte ba ye shes 'khor lo ru// rtsa ni brgyad kyi thig btab nas// ā phreng kā phreng mnyam bsams nas// mkha' 'gro brgyad kyi me lce sbar// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin ni// nam mkha'i dbyings kyi 'od las ni// gnyis med zung 'jug 'dzag byas pas// dpa' bo rnams kyi lam nas rgyu// de 'gags rnal 'byor mtshan ma med// brtan pa'i rnal 'byor grub 'gyur bas// sangs rgyas rnams kyi sa lam thob// ā li kā li'i rnal 'byor ro// a hoḥbazlas pa'i rnal 'byor pa// dngos dang dngos med bral 'gyur bas// phyi nang dug gi rnam pa sel// rnal 'byor 'di ni brtan grub na// zla ba drug nas 'grub 'gyur ba'i// rdo rje sems dpa' dang mnyam mo// de ni rig pa'i rnal 'byor ro// sems nyid gnas su pad+ma ni// mnyam pa nyid ni dmar por bsam// pad 'dab bzhi la thig le ni// dbus su rgyu med thig le yin// de dag rnams kyi kha dog ni// shar du dmar dang byang du ser// nub tu dkar dang lho ru nag /sna tshogs 'od gsal dbus su 'phro// sngar bshad sngags dang bcas pa ni// sgom na rnal 'byor dbang phyug ste// skad cig gcig la rdzogs sangs rgyas// de ni mnyam nyid rnal 'byor ro// mi bskyod chu dang rnam snang mdzad// phyi nang bdud rtsi lnga yis ni// sngags pa'i thabs kyi rnal 'byor kye// tan ti bdag gis grub pa thob// rnal 'byor bzhi'i nyams len gyi thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon tan ti pas mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /

༄༅// rlung gi de nyid bsgom pa'i man ngag ces bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon tso rong ghis mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ bā yu tat+taṃ bha bā na nā ma/ bod skad du/ rlung gi de nyid bsgom pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dur khrod ma ni lhan skyes rtogs pa med// phra zhing mi dmigs rang bzhin yid 'ong ba// pad+ma'i dbus 'gyur sna tshogs rol mdzad de// dus kyi stobs kyis dpa' bo gnyis med pas// nam mkha' khyab cing thim par dmigs pa med// mnyam pa'i bde rtogs skad cig gcig la ni// khams gsum g.yo zhing bder lta rtogs pa de// bla ma'i bka' yis gang yang lhan skyes so// bla mas ma rtogs lhan skyes gzhan du min// yon tan rnams la nga rgyal ma byed kye// lhan cig skyes pas gnyid log myos gyur pas// dam tshig glang chen lta bur spyod// dbang po sgo dgu'i sngags kyis lam bkag nas// brtan pa'i bum pas de ni mya ngan 'das// pad+ma'i ge sar rlung gi 'byung 'jug 'di// brtan par bcings na mgon po 'chags par 'gyur// rlung nyid thim pas mi 'gyur kha dog med// 'brel med dran med sems nyid stong pa la// sgom dang sgom rgyu bsgom bya de la med// g.yo ba'i sems nyid ting nge 'dzin gyis ni// sems kyi rgyal po rten med mkha' la lding*// mnyam par non cig lus kyis 'khrul 'khor bya// sems nyid bde can bkram pas mya ngan 'das// gti mug zhags pa bcad cing gzhan dag spang*// skad cig gcig la 'khor ba'i chags pa bral// de nyid bcings pas bya ba bral gyur pas// 'gro ba drug tu yang dag skye mi len// gang zhig rtsa sgor ma yengs gnas pa des// drag po'i rkun mas de la 'jigs pa med// gang zhig rdzun rku na ni mya ngan med// sngags nyid rang gi lus la gnas pa ste// bde ba thams cad rnal 'byor dran par gyis// bde ba rtogs pas yon tan skye 'gyur ba// khyim gyi bdag mo rang lus rang bzhin tshim gnas la// rlung gi sems nyid pad+ma'i chu dang 'dra// 'byung ba rnams ni de yis myong 'gyur bas// de phyir g.yo ba'i sems la rnal 'byor pa'i// sgo dgu bkag nas nan tan gyis// rnal 'byor gyis ni gti mug bcad byas la// gnas kyi yon tan rtogs pas chags med 'gyur// sprin ltar cho 'phrul rang bzhin kun brtags kyi// gti mug gnas kyis gti mug bsregs byas nas// lhan cig skyes pa'i gnas la rnal 'byor thim// thams cad nub pas steng 'og lam 'gags pas// gnas kyi nyams kyis 'khor ba mya ngan 'das// de ni rnal 'byor bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs// nyin mtshan bla ma spyi bor bsgom byas nas// lhan cig skyes pa nyid du gnas gyur pas// yang nas yang du nam mkha'i bdud rtsi brngub// rjes 'brang bkur sti dri med sku thob pas// ka ba gcig la gzhal yas sgo dgu ste// lam gyi sgyu lus bdag gis gcig tu rtogs// de yis bdud bzhi'i bar chod sel bar 'gyur// de phyir dge sbyin khrims sogs dgos mi 'gyur// dge sbyong chos smras lha nyid bsgom pa de// chos kyi ro ni sus kyang rtogs pa med// sku gsum brtan par 'dod na rnal 'byor kye// phyi nang byang chub sems kyi rlung nyid bsgom// dug lnga'i yan lag bcad pas myur du ni// byang chub sems kyi lam la legs par 'jug

/rnal 'byor brtan pa thob ste skye mi 'gyur// rlung gi de nyid bsgom pa'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon tso rong ghis mdzad pa rdzogs so/// / ༄༅// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon bi na pas mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī niṣ+pan na kra ma/ bod skad du/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa/ rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje mkha' 'gro gzhu ru thogs// dngos po thams cad 'ben du btsugs// gnyis su med pa'i mda' yis brgyabs// sgom dang bsgom rgyu dmigs pa med// bsnun pas skye ba dmigs ma gyur// bdag gzhan gnyis kyi mtha' yang bcad// gnyis su med pa'i mda' yis brgyabs// sgom dang bsgom rgyu gnyis ka med// stong pa'i gzhu ni bkang byas nas// shor med mda' ni rdeg par byed// gsod dang gsad bya gnyis ka med// gnyis su med pa'i mda' yis brgyabs// sgom dang bsgom rgyu gnyis ka med// nam mkha'i cho 'phrul chen po yis// chos nyid thams cad bsdu byas nas// gnyis su med pa'i mda' yis brgyabs// sgom dang bsgom rgyu gnyis ka med// bi rūs 'di ltar 'khor byas nas// gcig nas nyi shu'i bar du ni// dngos por cir yang zhugs pa med// yi ge stong pa gsos su byin// gnyis su med pa'i mda' yis brgyabs// sgom dang bsgom rgyu gnyis ka med// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po bi rū pa nas brgyud pa slob dpon bi na pas mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /

༄༅// thabs dang shes rab gtan la dbab pa'i bsdus pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon tsa ma ris mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ pra dz+nyo pā ya bi nish+tsa ya sa mu da yaṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/ thabs dang shes rab gtan la dbab pa bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig sprin ltar rtog pa sel zhing rang bzhin dri ma med// nang pa rnams kyi gzhan dang mi mnyam gnyis med chos sku de// gzugs ldan sna tshogs longs sku'i rang bzhin rnams kyi rgyur gyur pas// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med sprul sku de la phyag 'tshal nas// lhum mkhan rig 'dzin bdag gzhan don du rnam par bsdu byas nas// ma rtogs sems can rnams la phan phyir ma lus de nyid ni// bdag gis bshad bya blo ldan rnams kyis gus pas nyan par gyis// dngos po'i rtog pa la brten nas// dngos med bdag med yang dag 'byung*// gnyis ka rtog par mnyam mod kyi// byis pa rnams la drang phyir gsungs// de las nyon mongs thams cad de// skye 'jig sdug bsngal de las 'byung*// bdag gzhan gnyis kyi 'dzin pa yis// thar pa 'thob par mi 'gyur bas// de phyir dngos po spang bya zhing*// dngos med la yang brten mi bya// rnal 'byor dngos po la brten na// 'khor ba nyid las gzhan du med// phan tshun 'brel phyir de dag min// de min bdag gzhan grub pa med// dper na nam mkha'i me tog bzhin// de phyir dngos dang dngos med ni// rdzun pa'i cho 'phrul spang bar bya// rang bzhin ma grub dri ma med// de phyir pha rol phyin mar grags// khyab byed snying rje dbyer med de// rnal 'byor pa yi thabs yin no// chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa ltar// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pas// 'dzin bya 'dzin byed thog mtha' med// dri med dngos po'i mtshan ma bral// gnyis dang gnyis min zhi ba'i bdag /de rnams la gnas bde ba'i mchog /rang rig ye shes chos kyi dbyings// zhi dul pha rol phyin ma yin// theg pa gsum dang sku gsum ldan// sngags ni 'bum sde grangs las 'das// dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog phyag rgya dang*// 'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten rnams// lha dang lha min brgya byin dang*// mi dang yi dwags dud 'gro sogs// dper na chu yi rlabs bzhin te// de las 'byung zhing thim par 'gyur// de phyir thabs dang shes rab kyi// gnyis med don ni bsgom par bya// mi mnyam pa yi sngags nyid kyis// stong nyid bsgom par mi bya zhing*// de bzhin dngos po bsgom mi bya// de dag gnyis kyi 'dzin pa ni// mya ngan 'das kyang 'khor ba yin// de ni mi rtag spang byas pas// dmigs med stong nyid 'grub 'gyur ro// brjod bral nam mkha'i snying rje ste// de nyid yid bzhin nor bu ltar// 'gro ba'i don ni byams pa yin// nam mkha' kun la khyab pa bzhin// gnyis med sems ni dga' ba yin// dngos dang dngos med gnyis dag la// bsgom pa'i btang snyoms de nyid ni// dngos med don dam bsgom par bya// bya ba dang ni byed pa po// sgom dang bsgom rgyu gnyis ka med// sbyin dang sbyin bya gnyis ma grub// 'dzin bya dang ni 'dzin pa po// brtags pas nyon mongs dngos po med// de nyid ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas// byang chub sems ni 'grub 'gyur ro// chags pas bsgribs pa 'khor ba yin// sprin med nam mkha' lta bu ni// rtog pa dang bral mya ngan 'das// de phyir sems ni brtan byas nas// blo dang ldan pas bsgom par bya// bla ma'i zhal gyi pad+ma las thob gdams ngag bris// bdag nyid grub pa gang zhig dge ba'i 'bras bu des// 'gro drug nyon mongs 'dam las brgal zhing dri med pa// byang chub sems la gnas shing grub pa thob par shog

/thabs dang shes rab gtan la dbab pa'i dngos grub bsdus pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po tsa ma ris gsungs pa rdzogs so/// / ༄༅// rang bzhin grub pa med pa'i gzhi'i man ngag ces bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ swa bhā wa a sid+dhi nā ma u pa de sha /bod skad du/ rang bzhin grub pa med pa'i gzhi'i man ngag ces bya ba/ rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// e ma ji ltar mkhas pa yis// lha khang 'di ni bzhengs par byas// ka ba gcig la sgo dgu pa'i// shing mkhan gang gis khang par byas// ji ltar nam zhig lha khang de// 'jig par 'gyur ba mi shes pas// lha khang nang gnas phug ron ni// gnas ni gang du 'chol bar byed// ji ltar nam zhig lha khang de// 'jig par 'gyur ba mi shes na// gang gis g.yogs shing zhal zhal byas// sgo rab bsdams pa de lta na// ka ba srin gyis zos pa na// ji ltar nam zhig lha khang de// 'jig par 'gyur ba mi shes so// gang gis g.yogs shing zhal zhal byas// lha khang nang gnas phug ron ni// gnas ni gang du 'tshol bar byed// mar dang sbrang rtsi'i zas byin yang*// rigs ngan gyi ni spyod pa 'dra// de bzhin rdo rje 'gro bar byed// ji ltar nam zhig lha khang de// 'jig par 'gyur ba mi shes so// lha khang nang de'i phug ron ni// gnas ni gang du 'tshol bar byed// sna tshogs mngon can phug ron ni// lha khang bum pa spangs nas ni// dpa' bo'i sgo nas smra bar byed// ji ltar nam zhig lha khang ni// 'jig par 'gyur ba mi shes so// lha khang nang gnas phug ron ni// gnas ni gang du 'chol bar byed// lha khang bum pa spang sa nas ni// dpa' bo'i sgo nas smra bar byed// sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin no zhes// 'phags pa klu sgrub smra bar byed// rang bzhin grub pa med pa'i gzhi'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /

༄༅// rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon si la a lis mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ rat+na mā la nā ma/ bod skad du/ rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po kun gyi bdag nyid ni// dngos po'i rang bzhin ma grub pa'i// bla ma rje la phyag 'tshal nas// rin chen phreng ba bshad par bya// sgom dang bsgom rgyu rnal 'byor gyi// rtog pa de ni bden pa min// bden gnyis grub pa med pa'i phyir// sgom la brten par mi bya'o// chos kyi dbyings dang de bzhin nyid// gang yang rang bzhin rtogs pa de// zhi ba rang rig gnyis su med// bla ma dang po'i dgongs pa'o// mtshan nyid med pa'i shes rab ni// phyag rgya bla ma'i gdams ngag bcas// phra zhing rang rgyud ye shes kyis// ma rdzogs pa yi skad cig la// yang dag grub par mi 'gyur ro// bla ma gnyis pa'i dgongs pa'o// rnam par rtog pa bden pa min// rtog med rjes su 'brel ba yis// rim gyis rnam rtog rnams dang bral// dper na tha gur sbrul 'dzin te// rnal 'byor rtog med bde ba che// bla ma gsum pa'i dgongs pa'o// ma rig pa yi snang ba 'di// rang rig ye shes rtogs gyur na// rmi lam nyin mo'i snang ba rnams// mnyam pa nyid du don rtogs pas// tshor ba tshor byed gnyis su med// gnyis dang gnyis med spangs pa yi// gang la mi gnas rnal 'byor de// shes rab pha rol phyin ma yin// bla ma bzhi pa'i dgongs pa'o// bdag nyid sha la'i dgongs pa ni// dmigs med snying rje'i rnal 'byor pa// gnyis 'dzin gnyis med don rtogs can// zab mo'i chos nyid la gnas pas// rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'thob 'gyur// rtog pa dang bral dri ma med// rnal 'byor rol pa'i lta spyod ni// chos rnams rang bzhin rtogs gyur na// bde dang sdug bsngal gnyis med rtogs// de ltar rtogs pas rang grol 'gyur// rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po si la a lis mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /

༄༅// snying rje bsgom pa'i byin rlabs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon til+li pas mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ kā ru ṇa a dhiṣ+ṭhā na bha bā na nā ma/ bod skad du/ snying rje bsgom pa'i byin rlabs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i byin rlabs thob gyur pas// skad cig gcig la mnyam par rtogs// rgyud sde rnams las mi gsal bas// snying rje bsgom pa'i nyams len bshad// rnal 'byor de nyid dran byas nas// mtshan bcas mtshan med rang bzhin gyis// snying ga'i dbus su thig le ni// mun pa'i rab rib bsal gyur pa// zla rtsi'i steng du bsam par bya// rang bzhin bdag por rol mdzad pa// drag po'i gzi brjid phreng bas brgyan// he ru ka dpal mgon po che// bdud bzhi las ni rnam par rgyal// lhan cig skyes pa'i dur khrod gnas// bde ba chen po dga' ba'i mchog /ro myong longs sku byang sems ldan// yi ge rgyu med yang dag gsungs// lha bsgom phreng sngags mtshams gcod dang*// sbyin sreg klog sogs dgos pa med// rtog pa rnams ni spangs byas nas// 'jigs med snying rje bskyed byas la// slob ma dang ni bdag nyid kyi// snying gar bsgoms pas ye shes ni// thams cad mkhyen dang mnyam par 'gyur// de nyid rtogs pas yang dag 'phrad// rdzu 'phrul bzhi dang sa bcu thob// nam mkhar bskyod de mi snang 'grub// skye ba dran zhing rang sems rtogs// 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar ni// rang rig gzhan rig thams cad skye// mgal me'i 'khor lo bskor ba ltar// sna tshogs sems kyi rang bzhin gyis// nyams skyes rnal 'byor grub pa thob// snying rje bsgom pa'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon til+li pas mdzad pa rdzogs so/// / ༄༅// theg pa chen po'i gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon dho khan dhis mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/

ma hā yā na a ba tā raṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/ theg pa chen po'i gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// theg pa chen po'i bdag nyid ni// bde chen rgya mtsho'i bdud rtsi yin// mtha' dbus mnyam pa'i tshad nad sel// dpa' bo che la phyag 'tshal lo// theg pa rnams kyi mchog gyur pa// shes dang shes bya'i ye shes ni// gzhan la phan phyir rang la min// bdag gis gtan la dbab par bya// 'dzin dang 'dzin bya'i rig pa ni// so so'i las dang rnam par ldan// dngos po gzugs can 'ching ba'i rgyu// phyi dang nang gi gzugs med pas// de nyid ma grub gnyis med de// gang zhig 'dzin pa gzugs yin te// 'dzin pa med pas de nyid do// de ni dam pa'i ye shes te// lhun grub kha dog dbyibs dang bral// mkhas pa rnams kyis rang rig rtogs// gang zhig rig pa stong pa ste// stong pa min la rig pa min// 'di dag thams cad rang 'gag go /bden gnyis bral ba'i rnal 'byor gyis// stong nyid rig pa'i lta ba 'di// snying rje chen po'i shes rab bo// rdzogs pa'i rim dang lha sgrub sogs// rgyud rnams kun las gsungs pas kyang*// de nyid don dam ye shes min// don dam ye shes stobs kyis ni// rdzogs pa'i lha ni grub par 'gyur// de phyir bdag ni dho khan dhis// blo dman rnams kyi yul min pa// don dam kun rdzob gnyis med bshad// theg pa chen po'i gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po dho khan dhis mdzad pa rdzogs so/// / ༄༅// sems la gros 'debs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon a dzo kis mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ tsit+ta s+ya saṃ pra dhā ya byā baṣ+ṭa naṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/ sems la gros 'debs pa zhes bya ba/ yum rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo// dpa' bo dpa' mo 'byung po rnams kyis bskor byas pa'i// dpal chen he ru ka yi zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas// khams gsum sems can rnams kyi sgrib pa bsal ba'i phyir// bdag gzhan rnams kyi don du sems la phan pa'i gros 'debs bya// 'dod pa pad+ma'i chu ltar rig nas sems nyid kye// bla med lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu khyod kyis dran par gyi// de yis dpal ldan zhal mthong gnyis med don rtogs te// de phyir nyams len brtson pas phyag rgya chen po thob pa'i phyir// sna tshogs gzugs sgra sogs la ma chags ma zhen na// 'khor bar mi gnas rgyu med mya ngan 'das pa thob// pad+ma bzhin mdzes mngon sum mig gi dbang po dang*// sgra brnyan rna ba nyams shing sems nyid rmongs 'gyur bas// kye ma zhe sdang phrag dog dug ni ci phyir 'dzin// skra dkar gnyer ma la sogs khyod kyis mthong gyur kyang*// yongs su 'tshol bar zhen pas nyes pa'i skyon gyis bcings// rab 'bring tha ma'i spyod lam 'dod chags zhe sdang gis// mkhas btsun mngon pa'i nga rgyal 'khor ba'i gnas su 'khyams// yi dwags lha min dud 'gro la sogs sdug bsngal mang*// de phyir phrag dog spongs la rang bzhin dmigs par gyis// lha dang klu dang mi rnams bde ba grangs mang thob gyur kyang*// sems kyi rgyal po 'dod pas mi ngoms ngo mtshar che// gnyen bral sdug bsngal mchi ma rgya mtsho bas kyang lhag

/dur khrod gnas kyi keng rus bsags pas ri rab mnyam// 'dod pa'i 'khrugs pas rma byung khrag ni mtsho dang 'dra// kye ma sems kyi rgyal po'i rnal 'byor ci phyir srid mi spong*// mi lus 'dod bya khom ldan yang dag thob byas nas// dngos po rnams ni chu bur lta bur blta byas la// khyod kyis bdag gzhan rnams la ji srid phan par gyis// 'khor ba'i 'dam la bying gyur thar pa shin tu dka'// dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ngu 'bod tsha grang bsreg cing btsir// sred pas phrag dog yi dwags bkres skom skye 'gyur la// snying rje'i gnas thob dud 'gro phan tshun zhe sdang che// lha yang gnas nas ltung 'gyur mi rnams sdug bsngal mang*// de ltar 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal khyod kyis dran byos la// don dam kun rdzob tha snyad sna tshogs spang bar gyis// longs spyod sprin phung glog ltar rnam par g.yo bar 'gyur// tshe ni rlung gis bskyod pa'i pad+ma'i chu ltar 'jig /lang tsho rnams ni mi rtag de ltar blta byas nas// mkhas pa rnams ni myur du nags su 'gro bar gyi// 'khor ba'i 'dod pa'i gnyen bshes chags pas phrag dog skyes// mthar yang gshin rje'i gnas 'gro rgyal ba 'thob mi 'gyur// khyod kyis de ltar shes na thar pa'i lam thob bo// mi lus dam pa yang dang yang du thob par dka'// dper na rgya mtsho'i chu rlabs rlabs snang zla ba'i gzugs brnyan dang*// rmi lam mig 'phrul 'khrul snang sna tshogs sgom byed na// 'khor ba'i zhags pas bcings grol rgya las bya bzhin no// de phyir sems nyid ma chags ma zhen nyams len gyis// 'khrul zad gang zhig rnal 'byor bde ba thob pa des// sems gsal yal ga brgya yis sangs rgyas 'bras bu thob// sems la gros 'debs pa zhes bya ba slob dpon a dzo kis mdzad pa rdzogs so/// / ༄༅// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i bla ma bsgom pa'i phyag rgya chen pa'i nyams len

zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon paṃ ka las mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ sashā na mārga pha la gu ru bha bā na ma hā mu dra bhā wa na nā ma/ bod skad du/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i bla ma bsgom pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum gyi ni// rtsa gsum brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// yig 'bru gsum gyi nyams len ni// nyam chung nyon cig bshad par bya// lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo nas// sna bug gnyis dang tshangs pa'i bar// rtsa gsum la ni sems gtad bya// g.yon gyi dkar dang g.yas rtsa dmar// dbus kyi mi bskyod mthing ga la// g.yas par hūm̐ dang g.yon par oṃ// tshangs pa'i bu gar āḥyig bsam// 'od gsal ma zing ga dkar dang dmar// khams gsum sprul pa'i 'od kyis khyab// gdul bya btul nas slar yang thim// yi ge gsum gyi zla tshes la// stong pa'i thig le steng du ni// brgyud pa'i bla ma 'od gsal ni// de steng 'di ltar bsgom par bya// g.yon gyi sna bug yi ge la// yid ches nyams myong bla ma ni// skar ma lta bu'i 'od gsal bsgom// 'bras bu mngon sum bla ma ni// hūṃ yig zla tshes steng du ste// brtan par bsam gtan bsgom par bya// rlung gsum 'gags te gdon gsum sel// dug gsum rnam rtog bral 'gyur ba// rgyu 'bras chos kyi rtog pa spang*// lus kyi dgon pa brtan gyur pas// bdag gzhan gnyis med don rtogs te// dur khrod kyi ni 'jigs pa spang*// ha ri tsan+d+ra nam mkha'i dbyings// dri za'i grong khyer longs spyod byed// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i bla ma bsgom pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len zhes bya ba slob dpon paṃ ka las mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /

༄༅// rtsa rlung gi sgo nas rnal 'byor gyi spyod pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon ḍam+bi pas mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ nā da bin+du dād re yo gi nī tsār+ya nā ma/ bod skad du/ rtsa rlung gi sgo nas rnal 'byor gyi spyod pa zhes bya ba/ yum bdag med ma la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag ni mdog sdug 'phyon ma min// dbyibs legs 'phyon ma'ang ma yin te// dgyes rdor spyod pa'i dge sbyong gis// de ni bdag gi bdag por 'gyur// bdag ni mtshams su phung bar 'gyur// ban+dha pa yis mtshams su bcom// de ni bdag gis ji ltar bya// phyogs bzhir bltas na thar sa med// thams cad bltas pas nam mkha'i dbyings// bdag ni mtshams su phung bar 'gyur// ban+dha pa yis mtshams su bcom// da ni stong pa'i de nyid rtogs// smros dang sems khyod ci rtogs na// de ngor gzhan zhig 'gro bar byed// bdag ni mtshams su phung bar 'gyur// ban+dha pa yis mtshams su bcom// da ni dur khrod dgon pa ru// de ru bdag ni gnas par byed// ri sbyong ba yi gnas dag tu// skye rga'i rgyun ni bcad nas gnas// bdag ni mtshams su phung bar 'gyur// ban+dha pa yis mtshams su bcom// ban+dha mkhas pa chen po des// sna tshogs sems ni gar byed pa// de yis rang bzhin dbang du 'dus// bdag ni mtshams su phung bar 'gyur// ban+dha pa yis mtshams su bcom// rtsa rlung gi sgo nas rnal 'byor gyi spyod pa zhes bya ba slob dpon ḍom+bhi pas mdzad pa rdzogs so/// / ༄༅// yi ge gnyis pa'i man ngag ces bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon ḍom+bi pas mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ a k+ṣa ra dwi pa u pa de sha nā ma/ bod skad du/ yi ge gnyis pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ bla ma rje btsun rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rig byed dang ni gtun shing yin// dzā dang mu sal gtun dung yin// sa ma bhe dang gtun du byas// a thar shim mas phyag bdar byas// kye hoḥbadag gis gtun 'di ni// bla ma dam pa'i bka' dang brdung*// bla ma dam pa'i man ngag dang*// drang shing rkang pas rdeg par byed// dngos po'i rang bzhin spyod pa na// zla ba drug na sangs rgyas pa'i// lam 'di bdag gis dang du blang*// kye ma rtse gcig sems kyis brdung*// 'di ltar 'bras ni nag po las// bsod nams brdeg pa gnyis ka yis// bsnun pas snyigs ma zad gyur te// rang sems stong pa nyid du lus// kye hoḥbadag gis gtun brdung yin// nyi zla gnyis ni 'gram shing byas// rkang pa'i gtun nang bdag gi gnas// 'di ni lkugs pa'i rmi lam 'dra// ji ltar gang la smra bar byed// kye hoḥbadag gi gtun shing ni// nam mkha'i he dang hūm̐ sgra sgrogs// srid pa'i nges pa gnyis spangs te// nyin mtshan skad cig re re la// gtun dang mnyam pa nyid du gnas// yi ge gnyis pa'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon ḍom+bi pas mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /

༄༅// de nyid bde ba bsgoms pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i man ngag ces bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon kuk+ku ri pas mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ a nu yo ga tat+taṃ bha bā u pa desha nā ma/ bod skad du/ de nyid bde ba bsgoms pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig snying gar kha sbyor pad+ma'i dbus su ni// sems nyid phra zhing rab gsal khyab la nyams dang ldan// khams gsum thams cad nye bar gnyis med 'thob 'gyur ba// mnyam zhing gnyis med chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo// g.yo 'gyur dbang po'i rta rgod nang du thim pa de// rgyal ba rnams kyi ye shes yang dag snod du ni// mkhas pas gnyis med 'thob 'gyur myur ba'i don rtogs pas// dpal ldan dri med nam mkha' ltar ni lta ba 'grub// sangs rgyas rjes dran rnal 'byor chos kyi dbyings la ni// chos dang chos nyid bsgoms pas chos sku'i rang bzhin thob// de nyid dran tshor rig pa med 'gyur ye shes mthong*// shin tu bsgom pa'i dgos pa 'od gsal yid gnyis med// yi ge med pa'i thig le snying gar gnas pa ni// sgom par byed pa'i rnal 'byor ye shes rab tu skye/ de las rdo rje mkha' 'gro snying rjer ldan pa thams cad gnas// sangs rgyas rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' khams gsum bcas// de nyid rang bzhin mchod pas mchod 'os rnams las mchod pa thob// gang zhig rnal 'byor sgom byed sangs rgyas rnams kyis mchod// mchod sgom byed pa de ni 'bras bu sangs rgyas gsungs// rdo rje rnal 'byor nang gi bdag nyid gnyis sbyor bas// de phyir rdo rje'i mchod pas mkhas pa rnams kyis ma chod// ye shes lnga 'phros sangs rgyas 'grub 'gyur the tshom med// gang zhig rnal 'byor lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo la// ban+du ka yi 'bras ltar pad drug ge sar dbus// a nṛ su tri pre du ka rigs drug dgag phyir bsgom// dbus su khong stong yig 'bru drug po rim gyis ni// ka la thim pas sems nyid 'gags te skye ba med// bsgrib bya sgrib byed rang sems dri med dmigs pa med// rgyud rnams 'dul phyir gsungs te rnal 'byor don dam min// sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub 'gyur rang bzhin mchod pa che// gnas chen nyi shu rang gnas sa lam rim par thob// de phyir de nyid gzhan du mi 'tshol rang la gnas// rnal 'byor de nyid ma rtogs 'khyams nas ci zhig bya// gal te de nyid rtogs na gzhan du ci zhig bya// skal bzang bdag nyid rang la grub cing de nyid thob// gang zhig gang gi sbyor bas brtul zhugs can gyis ni// gnyis med bsam gtan la ni smyon pa bzhin du spyod// nam mkha'i gos can yang na rnal 'byor de min pa// lus la yi dam lha gnas rang bzhin de nyid bsgom// zla ba drug tu ngag bsdams mkha' 'gro rnams dang 'phrad// ye shes 'od 'phro rnal 'byor sangs rgyas rnams dang mnyam// sgyu ma mkhan ltar 'dul mchog 'gro ba'i don mdzad do// de nyid bde ba bsgoms pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon kuk+ku ri pas mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /

༄༅// sems dang sems nyid 'dul ba'i thabs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon me ko las mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ tsit+ta tsi ti la sha pa no pā yaṃ/ bod skad du/ sems dang sems nyid 'dul ba'i thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// spu mdog sna tshogs ri dwags te// rkang pas rdeg cing phyogs bzhir 'gro// bdas nas nam mkhar bsad par byas// rang gi sha yis rang lus la// rnam pa kun tu dgra ru song*// bhu su ku yi rngon pa yis// skad cig gcig kyang gtong ba med// ri dwags mo ni pho la smras// nags su gnas na bde bar 'dug /de nas byung nas gsod par byed// rang gi sha yis rang lus la// rnam pa kun tu dgra ru song*// bhu su ku yi rngon pa yis// skad cig gcig kyang gtong ba med// pho ni mo la 'di skad smras// su la bdag gis gnod ma byas// ci yang bdag gis zos pa med// su la'ang gnod pa ma byas na// ci yi phyir na sod cig smra// rang gi sha yis rang lus la// rnam pa kun tu dgra ru song*// bhu su ku yi rngon pa yis// skad cig gcig kyang gtong ba med// rtswa dang chu la mi gnod pa'i// gang du gnas kyang ltogs pa med// rtag tu btsal yang ma rnyed pa'i// ri dwags pho mo 'di gnyis ni// bdag gis rnyed par ma gyur to// rang gi sha yis rang lus la// rnam pa kun tu dgra ru song*// bhu su ku yi rngon pa yis// skad cig gcig kyang gtong ba med// rgyug cing 'gro ba'i ri dwags ni// de yi rjes ni rnyed pa med// bdas pas nam mkha'i dbyings su gtor// bhu su ku yi rngon pa yis// skad cig gcig kyang gtong ba med// sems dang sems nyid 'dul ba'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon shān+ta de wa nas brgyud pa slob dpon me ko las gsungs pa rdzogs so/// / ༄༅// lha kun gyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon gha dha ris mdzad/

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ sarba de wa s+ya dha niṣ+pan na kra ma marga nā ma/ bod skad du/ lha kun gyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i lam zhes bya ba/ mkha' 'gro rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mi snyan sgra sogs spangs pa yis// dben zhing gsang ba'i sa phyogs sam// yid dang mthun pa'i dgon pa ru// rim pa 'di bzhin bsgom par bya// shing gcig byang chub sems yin te// a wa dhū tī'i chu 'gram la// lte ba'i gtum mo dur khrod de// ri khrod snying ga'i pad+ma la// dgon pa rnam snang gnas yin te// nags tshal pad+ma'i gsang ba ru// bhi ḍa dang ni rdo rje chu// byang chub sems dang bzhi mnyam dang*// rin chen 'byung ldan 'od dpag med// thig le'i gnas ni drug la bsgom// rnal 'byor pa yi sgrub pa bstan// de nas lus kyi maṇ+ḍal ni// rang bzhin dri ma med pa'i rtsa// lhan cig skyes pa'i nyams dang ldan// zlum po nam mkha' lta bu ste// mthe bong tshad ni bde chen la// oṃ mam haṃ gnyis gang rung bsgom// me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis// maṇ+ḍal byin gyis brlabs byas nas// mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes ni// rnal 'byor snying ga'i sgra gcan gyi// steng du bhū ni dud ka bsam// mi bskyod pa yi rgya mtsho la// oṃ ni skar ma lta bu ste// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni// mgrin pa'i 'khor lor bsam par bya// byang chub sems dang rak+ta dang*// mi bskyod chu yi thig le'o// de ltar byin brlabs rtsa bsgoms nas// bsod nams tshogs ni bsag pa'i phyir// mtshan med rtsa dang 'khor lo bzhi// phyag rgya bzhi yi rgyas btab nas// thig le bzhi la nyams len bya// tshad med bzhi yi nyams skye'o// de ltar rnal 'byor bzhi bsgoms nas// rdzogs pa'i hūm̐ bsam bgegs bskrad do// snying ga'i khong stong dbus su ni// pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ nyi ma// hūṃ las 'bar ba'i rdo rje 'phro// phyi dang nang bgegs mtshams gcad do// de nas rnal 'byor stong nyid ni// skyil krung bca' zhing lus nyid bsrang*// mig gi dbang po sna rtser gtad// dngos po thams cad rjes dran na// dri ma med pa'i nam mkha' la// skar ma lta bu'i sems nyid kyis// phra rab tsam gyi bdag gzhan bsgom// stong nyid lta ba brtan byas nas// rdzogs pa'i dbang gi rim pa bstan// rdo rje dril bu'i sbyor ba yis// rkan gyi phyogs su 'gyu lha mo// bde ba chen po'i zla rgyun ni// 'babs sam dbang bskur lus tshim mo// de nas dpa' bo dpa' mo yis// gang yang dpal ldan 'dus pa'i sku// dri med me long gzugs brnyan dang*// nam mkha'i skyes bu lta bu ni// rang bzhin kha dog dbyibs dang bral// ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin ni// nam mkha'i dbyings su bsgom par bya// de ltar rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni// skal ldan rnams kyi don phyir brtsams// de yis dge ba gang thob pa// 'gro bas byang chub thob phyir bsngo// lha kun gyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i lam zhes bya ba slob dpon gha dha ris mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /

༄༅// bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgom pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon rā hu las mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ a tsin+ta bha ba ti pa ri bhā wa na nā ma/ bod skad du/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgom pa zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dgongs pa mdor bsdus rnal 'byor gyi// tshad med bzhi yi nyams len ni// bsam gyis mi khyab bshad par bya// rgyu 'bras stong pa'i rang bzhin la// dngos med gzugs dang gnyis med smra// dmigs med 'bras bu 'bad med 'gyur// dper na 'brug med char bzhin no// de phyir rang bzhin bdag med kyi// brtul zhugs skal ldan rnal 'byor pas// snang zhing srid pa sna tshogs 'di// dngos po stong pa bdag med de// ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par dag /de lta bu yi snying rje la// sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su med// mi bsgom mi rtog rang bzhin gsal// mtha' dbus bral ba dbu ma'i don// de lta'i sems kyi rang bzhin bsgom// ma rtogs pa yi sems can la// nad 'don snying rje bsgom par bya// bdag gi mdun du gang zhig kyang*// mnyam par bzhag ste mnyam par bsgom// de la rnam pa thams cad kyi// gnyis med don ni 'grub 'gyur ro// bsgom pa'i snyan brgyud gdams ngag ni// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// kun gyi sems nyid hūm̐ yig dkar// bdag dang gzhan gyi snying gar bsgom// nyi ma'i gdan steng thig ler bsgom// de nyid kyi ni 'phro 'du las// nyon mongs thams cad sbyangs par bsam// de ni gnyis med don yin te// lha yi de nyid rang bzhin med// de ltar snying rje bsgom byas nas// bsam mi khyab pa'i byams pa ni// phan phyir 'di ltar bsam par bya// rnal 'byor bdag nyid snying ga ru// pad+ma 'dab brgyad sran ma'i tshad// de nas 'od gsal dkar dmar te// bar du me lha'i aṃ yig ni// dngos po'i rnal 'byor gang yang med// de las cir yang bsam mi khyab// gang zhig sgom pa'i rnal 'byor de// gnyis med ye shes 'grub 'gyur ro// gsal rig med pa chos kyi sku// de ltar phra ba'i rnal 'byor pas// mngon shes shar te gnyis med rtogs// dga' ba'i rang bzhin 'byung 'gyur la// btang snyoms 'bras bu thob pa'o// kha cig lha mo bzhi bsgoms nas// kha cig ngag gi 'don par brten// gnyis med bsgom pa mi shes so// zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa yi// zhal gdams gzhan la phan phyir ni// rā hu las ni bshad par byas// tshad med bzhi bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgom pa zhes bya ba slob dpon rā hu las mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /

༄༅// rang rig ye shes kyi lta ba'i nyams len zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon tsam pa kas mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ āt+ma pa ri bid dz+nya na dṛṣ+ṭi u pa de sha nā ma/ bod skad du/ rang rig ye shes kyi lta ba'i nyams len zhes bya ba/ yum bdag med ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rang rig ye shes las yin na// byed pa po med las med do// de dag med na bya ba med// gsum ni ji ltar gnas med do// gal te phyi ni bden pa yin// tha snyad 'brel phyir nang du brjod// gal te kun rdzob rang rig yin// rig pas rig pa rig pa med// rnal 'byor bdag nyid rig na ni// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'joms par byed// tha snyad 'di yi dngos po rnams// rang bzhin ma grub dri ma med// dngos po rnams ni ma grub pas// gzhan dag bdag la grub rgyu med// de phyir bdag ni gtan med pa// gal te sgra don rtogs bya yin// rang bzhin don la sgra don med// dngos po ma grub rnal 'byor pa// nga bdag 'di ni thams cad bral// gnyis bral ma rig mun pa med// de med dri med ye shes te// 'di ltar rnal 'byor rig pa yis// 'khor ba'i 'ching ba grol bar byed// gan rkyal nyal bas rnal 'byor skye// lus kyi mnyam bzhag dran par gyis// mig bgrad rnam par shes pa 'bul// nam mkha'i phyogs su bltas byas pas// mthong rgyu yid la 'dzin rgyu med// phyogs kyi rtog pa bral ba yis// dbang po nub 'gyur gnyis med 'grub// rang rig ye shes kyi lta ba'i nyams len zhes bya ba slob dpon tsam pa kas mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /

༄༅// grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rtogs pa'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon dpa' bo 'od gsal gyis bsdus/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ tsa tur shī ti sid+dhaṃ saṃ bo dhā hṛ dā ya nā ma/ bod skad du/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rtogs pa'i snying po zhes bya ba/ ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag don rtogs sangs rgyas dang 'dra grub pa'i zhabs la gus btud nas// gang zhig sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor mi dge'i las kyi chu srin gyis// rab tu g.yeng zhing khrid gyur de dag gdon phyir rnal 'byor dpa' bo yis// grub pa dag gi nyams myong rtog pa'i lta ba phreng bar bsdeb par bya// gu ru lū hi pa'i zhal nas/ khyi rgod mi srun sna la sbrang rtsi bskus pas phyogs rnams kun tu za bar byed// de bzhin blo dman skal min rnams la bla ma'i man ngag byin pas rang rgyud sreg /skal ldan skye med rtogs pa rnams ni snang ba thug phrad tsam gyis rnam rtog 'joms// dper na glang chen rab brtan myos pa'i sna la ral gri btags pas dgra dpung 'joms// gu ru li la pa'i zhal nas/ tshad med bzhi yi dgon pa ru// rnal 'byor rgyal po seng ge bzhin// mgo la g.yu mdog ral lngas brgyan// rnal 'byor dbang rtags rigs lnga 'chang*// seng ge'i sder mo bcu dag gis// klad pa la sogs sha rus 'byed// rnal 'byor pha rol phyin bcu yis// rnam rtog mi mthun phyogs rnams 'byed// li las de ltar rtogs nas grol// gu ru bir+wa pa'i zhal nas/ phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nas lhan cig skyes pa de// mi bsam mi reg bdag med rang gi ngang la gzhag /chad par mi 'gyur nyams su myong bas rang gis rig /rtag par mi 'gyur mngon zhen med pas zung du 'jug /gu ru ḍom+bi pa'i zhal nas/ gser 'gyur yi nus pa yis// lcags rnams gser du 'gyur ba ltar// rin chen dbang gi nus pa yis// nyon mongs gnyis med ye shes bsgyur//

gu ru sha wa ri pa'i zhal nas/ ma rig pa yi nags tshal du// gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi ri dwags rgyu// thabs shes gnyis kyi gzhu bdungs nas// snying po'i don gyi mda' zhig 'phangs// 'chi ni rnam par rtog pa 'chi// sha ni gnyis su med par zos// ro ni bde ba chen por myong*// 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po thob// gu ru sa ra ha'i zhal nas/ kye hoḥgrogs dag lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de// gzhan nas mi rnyed bla ma dam pa'i zhal nas rnyed// don dam zhal gyi ngo bo de rtogs na// yid la 'chi ba med cing lus la chad pa med// gu ru kaṃ ka li'i zhal nas/ ji ltar nam mkha' stong pa la// gcig dang gzhan gnyis spangs pa'i gzugs// rang snang ye shes btsun mo de// dpe med tha snyad kun las 'das// gu ru mī na pa'i zhal nas/ lcags kyu thogs pa'i nya pa yis// las dbang rgya mtsho'i nang du khyer// nya chen lus la brten byas nas// lha chen gdams ngag nyams blangs pas// yon tan sa dang rdo dag gis// ma thegs mī na pa zhes grags// gu ru gho ra kha'i zhal nas/ rigs ni rab dang 'bring dang tha ma ru// gnas pa'i rgyu la rkyen gyi stobs ldan pas// 'gag med las dbang 'bras bu ngo mtshar che// tso rang gi la byang sems bsnyen bkur byas// de rkyen stobs kyis khams kyi sa bon brtas// ma tsin dha ris 'chi med bdud rtsi brtan// gho ra kha yis gnyis med de nyid mthong*// srid gsum ba dzi'i rgyal po ngo mtshar che// gu ru tso rang gi'i zhal nas/ thog med srid pa yun ring du// ma rig sdong po'i rtsa ba la// 'du byed chu yis legs brlan nas// srid pa'i yan lag sna tshogs rgyas// ma rig pa yi shing chen de// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag dang*// shes rab gsum gyi ste'u yi// tsa rang gi yis de nyid bcad// gu ru bī na pa'i zhal nas/ phyin ci log la goms pa'i sgra// gus dang brtson pas dpyad byas nas// ma grol skye med sgra dpyad pas// bī na pa yis bdag med rtogs//

gu ru shān+ti pa'i zhal nas/ bu chung ma yis gsos pa yis// gyad kyi stobs dang ldan pa bzhin// blo chung bla ma'i man ngag gis// rim gyis brid pas theg pa che// rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa yi// nad rnams sman gyis sel ba ltar// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa ni// bla ma'i gdams pas skad cig sreg /gu ru tan+ti pa'i zhal nas/ 'jig rten pa yi thags mkhan rnams// snal ma thams cad thags su btag /nga yis bla ma'i man ngag gis// chos rnams thams cad thags su btag /ye shes lnga yi stong nyid ni// snal ma man ngag btag so la// shes rab kyi ni sgrom bu yis// dbyings rig gnyis med chos skur btag /gu ru tsa ma ri pa'i zhal nas/ rnam rtog mtshan ma'i ko ba 'di// stong nyid rdo rje'i sbang nang du// chos brgyad spangs pa'i rgyun gyis ni// shes rab nyams myong bsnyung dang btsem// lhun grub chos sku'i lham byed par// tsa ma ri pa lham mkhan mchog /gu ru khaḍha pa'i zhal nas/ 'jig rten mtshon thogs dpa' bo ni// rgyun du dgra dang g.yul 'gyed kyang*// bdag nyid sdug bsngal dbang du 'gyur// 'chi med ye shes ral gri yis// srid gsum dgra rnams pham byas nas// khaḍha pa ni longs spyod byed// gu ru nā gā rdzu na'i zhal nas/ gang zhig ma rtogs spyod pa mi bya ste// byas na rgyal srid 'bangs kyis bzung ba bzhin// rtogs pas ma rtogs spyod pa mi bya ste// byas na glang chen 'dam du zin pa 'dra// gu ru kah+ṇa pa'i zhal nas/ shing rta'i 'khor lo gcig dang mi ldan khrid kyang 'gro bar mi nus ltar// sbyin sogs 'bad pa byas kyang bla ma mi ldan dngos grub dam pa min// bya rgod rtsal rdzogs 'dab gshog rgyas pa dag ni nam mkha' gcod cing rgyug /skal bzang rnal 'byor rnams ni dbang gi gdams ngag khong du chud pas bde// gu ru ka na ri pa'i zhal nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad ngo bo gcig

/de ni rtogs na rang bzhin rang gi sems// rtogs par 'dod na ma bcos ji bzhin zhog /goms par byas na rnal 'byor mngon du 'gyur// gu ru tha ga na'i zhal nas/ gang zhig rna bar chu zhugs na// chu nyid kyis ni 'byin pa bzhin// de bzhin snang srid rdzun pa la// rdzun par bsgoms pas bden pa mthong*// gu ru nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal dpung tshogs rnams kyis ni// gling dang gling phran rnams la dbang byed ltar// lhan cig skyes pa'i ror gyur rnal 'byor ni// 'khor ba dbang sgyur bde ba chen po yin// gu ru sha wa ri pa'i zhal nas/ legs byas ri mo mkhan dag gis// shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs brnyan bris// mthong na bdag nyid 'jigs 'gyur la// brtags na ma grub gzugs brnyan snang*// gu ru til+li pa'i zhal nas/ ri rab ngos la bya gnas pas// bya yi rang bzhin gser du snang*// mkhas pa skye med rtogs pa yis// dngos po bor na bde ba che// gu ru tsa tra pa'i zhal nas/ rnal 'byor pa yis gang snang gdams pa yin// mthong ba skye med rtogs pa slob dpon mchog /byis pa rnams kyis gnyis 'dzin rtog pa yin// dge dang sdig pa'i 'bras bu de la gnyis su 'byung*// gu ru bha tra pa'i zhal nas/ stong nyid don rtogs 'khrul pa zhi// byams pa bsgoms pas spyod pa rdzogs// sna tshogs gnyis med goms pa yis// mi mthun ro gcig 'bras bur rtogs// gu ru rdo khan dhi'i zhal nas/ kun rdzob bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*// don dam rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis// zung 'jug phyag rgya chen por bsgom// 'bras bu sku gsum ye shes 'chang*// gu ru a dzo ki'i zhal nas/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis// steng sgo sna rtsar thig ler bsgom// de nyid la ni blo brtan pas// yungs kar stong nyid dmigs pa stor// gu ru ka la pa'i zhal nas/ 'gro ba 'di dag thog med dus nas 'khrul// de yis 'jig rten thams cad ma snyoms grags// bla ma'i gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i sman gyis ni// 'khrul pa'i nad rnams skad cig gcig la sreg

/gu ru ḍom+bi pa'i zhal nas/ yun ring dus nas dri ma 'khrud byas kyang*// sol ba'i rang bzhin dkar por 'gyur ba med// rang bzhin rnam dag stong nyid dag par 'gyur// bla ma'i gdams pa rang bzhin khrus mkhan mchog /gu ru kaṃ ka na'i zhal nas/ rtogs pa yid bzhin nor bu la// nyams su myong ba'i mdog phyung bas// spyod pa nus pas dgos 'dod 'byung*// ro snyoms ldan pa rnams kyis 'grub// gu ru ka ma la'i zhal nas/ rgya mtsho zab cing rgya che'i nang na nor bus gang ba la// klu yi rgyal po rnams ni de la longs spyod ngo mtshar che// de bzhin snang grag thams cad ye nas chos sku yin pa la// rtogs pa dang ldan longs spyod ngo mtshar che// gu ru ḍeng gi pa'i zhal nas/ rta dang glang po rgya mtsho 'dra na rab tu bde// spre'u byis pa chu yi ri mo 'dra na rtog pa yin// chu bo nyi ma sman dang 'dra na dbyer mi phyed// gtsug phud mig dang 'khor lo lta bus 'bras bu thob// gu ru ban ḍhe'i zhal nas/ mngon zhen med pa byams pa'i mchog /gnas lugs rtogs pa snying rje yin// zag med bde ba dga' ba ste// chos rnams ro gcig btang snyoms rdzogs// gu ru ḍan ṭa na'i zhal nas/ ji ltar dran rig sna tshogs dag /rtog med dbyings su zad cing 'gag /de bzhin snang srid chos rnams kun// stong nyid dbyings su zad cing 'gag /gu ru kuk+ku ri pa'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas chos sogs rnams las don mi 'byung*// 'dod dang 'bad rtsol yod na sangs rgyas min// bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs nyams myong dpal// cha ldan rang la yod kyang ma mthong ngo*// gu ru ku tsi pa'i zhal nas/ gang la lhan cig skyes pa ni// glang po che yi mig bzhin du// gze rer skyes na zug rngu 'byung*// glod nas ma zhen bsam gtan mchog /bla ma'i gsung gi 'od zer gyis// yod dang med pa'i mtha' ma rnyed// gang zhig ma rnyed de mtho'o// mtha' de rtogs na don gyi mchog

/gu ru dha mu pa'i zhal nas/ gnyis las ma rig dug dag gis// rig pa skyes la rgyun du zan// bla ma'i gsung gi 'od zer gyis// snang srid 'khrul pa'i dug nad sel// gu ru ma hi la'i zhal nas/ ma rig pa yi nga rgyal gyis// ma rtogs yid bzhin nor bu bsgrib// spyod par 'dod pas dgos 'dod 'byung*// ro snyoms ldan pa rnams kyis 'grub// gu ru a tsin dha'i zhal nas/ dmigs med phyag rgya chen po ru// 'khrul pa'i dran yid sna tshogs stor// ye shes rig pa'i snang ba yis// gang snang phyag rgya chen por mthong*// gu ru pa ha'i zhal nas/ bde'o bde'o dngos med bde// zhen pa med pas dngos med bde// brtags pas thams cad der shes bde// bsgrub bya med pas gsang ba bde// gu ru ni la na'i zhal nas/ spyi bo'i 'dab ma 'dam skyes su// sa bon g.yo ba dga' ba ste// snying po 'byin pa mchog tu dga'/ lhan skyes dga' bral bla med thob// gu ru bhu su ku'i zhal nas/ bdag nyid ma rtogs bar du ro la khyad par che// de bzhin 'khor ba dag dang sangs rgyas tha dad che// rtogs pa'i dus na 'khor ba bde ba chen po ste// dper na rgya mtsho'i nang na 'bar ba'i rin chen bzhin// gu ru in+d+ra bhū ti'i zhal nas/ dus kyi sna rtse dag ni byin rlabs dag dang mi ldan na// phyi dang nang du spyod pa dag gis rnal 'byor 'tshang mi rgya// dga' bde'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas dag dang khyad par med pa ni// zhen pa btang na rang bzhin skyes pa'i nyams myong mchog tu dga'// gu ru me ko pa'i zhal nas/ bla ma dam pa dag las dang por rang gi sems rtogs bya// de nas snang ba kun tu tha dad med byas te// gnyis med goms pas dur khrod gnas su brgyug par bya// mnyam par rtogs nas smyon pa'i brtul zhugs spyod par bya// gu ru ko da la'i zhal nas/ bde dang sdug bsngal thams cad sems las byung*// bla ma'i gdams pas sems kyi ri bo brkos// blo ldan pa yis ri bo brkos gyur kyang*// gnyug ma'i bde ba chen po 'thob mi 'gyur// tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad// tshogs drug yul la bde ba rgyun mi 'chad// brtags pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu// bsgom dang sgom med gnyug ma'i ngang du zhog

/gu ru kaṃ ri pa'i zhal nas/ rang bzhin gzugs kyi sol mal du// dran rig rnam rtog sol ba la// la la ras nā'i sbud pa bus// dhū tī'i ye shes me sbar nas// dug gsum rnam rtog chos skur brdungs// kaṃ ri pa yis rtogs nas grol// gu ru dzā lan+dha ra'i zhal nas/ khams gsum lus ngag yid gsum gyi// dran rig rnam rtog sna tshogs kun// la la ra sa nā dhū tī ru// byin brlabs ci phyir bcing mi bgyi// gu ru rā hu la'i zhal nas/ phyi yi sgra gcan bzang po yis// zla ba'i snang ba gnyis med zos// kun rdzob zla ba'i thig le ni// dbyings rig sgra gcan gnyis med zos// gu ru dha rma pa'i zhal nas/ snang srid chos kyi snod du ni// byang chub sems kyi mar zhun blugs// tshogs drug rnam shes sdong bu la// gnyis med ye shes me sbar bas// rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i mun pa bcom// gu ru dho ka ri'i zhal nas/ chos dbyings rang bzhin snod nang du// rig pa chos sku'i rdzas nyid bcug /dbyings rig gnyis kyi 'bras bu ni// skal ldan rnal 'byor rig pas rtogs// gu ru me dhi na'i zhal nas/ rig pa gnyug ma'i shes rab dang*// nyon mongs goms pa'i thabs dag gis// rang bzhin gnas lugs gzhi dag la// bde chen lhun grub 'bras bu rtogs// gu ru paṃ ka dza'i zhal nas/ ji ltar bla mas ma zin ma rtogs dus dag tu// yid bzhin nor bu dang ni nor bu mching bu mnyam// bla ma dang ni rtogs pas yongs su zin gyur na// nyi zla'i 'od dang srin bu me khyer ji bzhin no// gu ru ghaṇ+ḍa pa'i zhal nas/ la la ras nā dhū tī gsum// bla mas byin brlabs bcing bar bya// bdag dang sems dang snang ba gsum// rtogs pa bskyed phyir mkhas pas bsten// gu ru dzo ki pa'i zhal nas/ mar me'i rtse mo lta bu yi// phra zhing gsal ba'i yid goms pas// brtan zhing g.yo ba'i dngos po kun// chos kyi dbyings su thim par 'gyur//

gu ru tsa lu ka'i zhal nas/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams pa ni// yun ring dus nas goms pa yis// sa sogs rig par thim pa las// rang snang phyag rgya chen por 'gyur// gu ru go tu ri'i zhal nas/ phyi nang chos kun sems su 'dus// sems nyid gsal ba'i don rtogs na// spyod lam rnam bzhi chos kyi skur// rtogs pa mngon gyur rdzogs sangs rgyas// gu ru lu ci ka pa'i zhal nas/ gang zhig thog ma med dus nas// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor yun ring 'khyams// gru thob bla ma dam pa yis// brgal dka'i mtsho las de ring brgal// gu ru na ra gu na'i zhal nas/ chu rlabs lta bu'i nyams brtan nas// spyod pa thabs kyis gzhol bar bya// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis// chags sdang rtog pa rang zhir byas// gu ru a nan+da'i zhal nas/ ye shes rig pa'i ting 'dzin ni// thog ma med nas gnyug mar gnas// ji ltar rtogs na nges pa yin// rnam rtog dran pa de nyid min//

gu ru pa tsa ra'i zhal nas/ gar yang ma blta dbus su ltos// mchog dang dga' bral bde ba che// sngags kyi gsang ba stobs brjod nas// rnal 'byor rtags ni mgu bar bya// gu ru tsam pa ka'i zhal nas/ thabs dang shes rab 'od gsal lta bu la// bla ma chu bo'i rgyun gyis kun la khyab/ lhan cig skyes pa dpag bsam shing dag la// 'bras bu sku gsum rang gsal rab tu rdzogs// gu ru bhi k+ṣa ṇa'i zhal nas/ bla med dur khrod byang chub gnas chen du// zung 'jug bde chen bgrod dka'i lam bstan pas// phyogs 'chal bral ba'i dbang phyug rnal 'byor mchog /bla ma'i gdams pa'i drin gyis de nyid rtogs// gu ru bhe khi pa'i zhal nas/ bdag nyid gdod nas sangs rgyas la// rtog pa'i dbang gis chos nyid yin// dbang blangs lhan cig skyes pa des// skye med rgyas 'debs rdo rje 'dzin// gu ru kaṃ pa la'i zhal nas/ rgyu mthun las kyi 'khor lo yis// srid pa'i glu gar sna tshogs byas// ye shes rig pa'i me yis ni// 'khrul pa'i dri ma ma lus sreg /gu ru ju ma pa'i zhal nas/ sngags pa kun gyi sdom pa mchog /rang gi rtogs la zhen med de// gnyug ma sems kyi rtogs pas gang*// sangs rgyas thams cad de mthong yin// gu ru ma ṇi bha dra'i zhal nas/ gang zhig ma rtogs dus kyi tshe// rnam rtog sna tshogs sgra phyir 'breng*// de phyir rang bzhin mngon du gyur// gang snang rang bzhin de de nyid// gu ru me kha la'i zhal nas/ phyi dang nang kun sems su 'dus// zhen pa med na ro snyoms ldan// 'bad rtsol med na sgom pa'i mchog /gnyis med bde chen rdzogs sangs rgyas// gu ru nā ga ka la ka'i zhal nas/ go cha chen po bgos nas kyang*// nor bu lta bu'i snying stobs kyis// rang gi sems kyi gru btang nas// ri mo'i khong par nges par zhugs// gu ru ka la ka la'i zhal nas/ chos dbyings rnam dag mkha' dkyil du// skye med 'brug sgra legs bsgrags pas// snang srid 'khrul pa'i chos rnams kun// sku gsum ye shes 'bras bur mdzes//

gu ru ka na ta la'i zhal nas/ bla ma dam pa'i khab dag dang*// snying rje yi ni skud pa yis// khams gsum ma lus gos su btsem// gos kyi rnal 'byor ngo mtshar che// gu ru dha hu la'i zhal nas/ zung 'jug rig pa rin chen mdzod// gnyis med ngang ste btsal bas min// bya ba btang ba'i sems bzhin du// ji ltar bzhag pa de ltar bde// gu ru u dhi la'i zhal nas/ ji ltar rnal 'byor rjes 'brang 'khrul// ma 'brel bag chags ma btang zung*// gang la mi gnas 'gro ba zung*// gzhan la btsal ba de yang min// gu ru ka pā la'i zhal nas/ dngos kun gnyis med rdo rje 'dzin// rgyan sogs thogs pa glo bur ba// ngar 'dzin 'khrul pa de nyid kyang*// rang gis btsal bas rnyed ma yin// gu ru ki ra pa la'i zhal nas/ ji ltar ma rtogs bar du rang gzhan rtog pas bcings// de tshe rtogs par gyur na rang gzhan gnyis ma grub// des na sangs rgyas zhes bya rang gi bla dwags yin// de nyid spros bral ma bcos rang sar rang bzhin gzung*// gu ru sā ga ra'i zhal nas/ 'gro rnams sdug bsngal gyis gdungs la// 'dod yon dag gi char dbab bo// de bzhin nyid kyi gnas chen du// rig pa'i klu rgyal nyid gzir nas// skal ldan rig 'dzin pho mo la// gsang sngags rig pa'i char dbab po// gu ru sarba bhi k+ṣa'i zhal nas/ gang zhig ma rtogs dus na sna tshogs ro la khyad par che// gang zhig rtogs pa'i dus su ro rnams ngo bo bye brag med// de bzhin ma rtogs nyid na 'khor 'das tha dad snang*// de nyid rtogs na 'khor ba myang 'das tha dad med// gu ru nā ga bo dhi'i zhal nas/ sa la gnas na thams cad skal ba bzang*// rgya mtsho'i gting du phyin na dbul dang bral// ral gri lag tu thogs na longs spyod che// phyogs med dag tu phyin na gnyen dang 'phrad// gu ru dā ri ka pa'i zhal nas/ bde ba chen po rang la yod kyang ma rtogs 'khrul pas bsgribs// de bsal 'dod pas bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsag bya// tshogs gnyis ma bsags skye ba brgya ru 'bad byas kyang*// bla ma dag dang mi ldan bde ba chen po rtogs mi 'gyur//

gu ru su ta la'i zhal nas/ thams cad bde gshegs rang bzhin te// blos bzhag log pa'i lam spangs nas// snying po'i lam la brtson byas na// snying po'i 'bras bu gdon mi za// gang gis bla ma dam pa las// dbang rnams lhan cig skyes pa de'i// ro yis kun la khyab bya ste// skye med rgyas 'debs rdo rje 'dzin// gu ru pa na ha'i zhal nas/ snying po gnyug ma'i don bsams pas// ji ltar bsam pa de ltar rtogs// des na de nyid rang dgar gnas// 'dod rgu lhug par thams cad 'byung*// gu ru ko ki la'i zhal nas/ bya ba btang na man ngag yin// zhen 'dod med pa rtogs pa yin// bde ba dngos med sgom pa yin// bsgrub bya med na 'bras bu'i mchog /gu ru a nang ga'i zhal nas/ 'khor bar snying po med pa yin// 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lus 'di la// ma rig mngon zhen dregs pa yi// dug gis bzung na bde bar 'dzin// mngon zhen dug nad sbyangs pa na// 'khor ba nyid kyang chos kyi sku// gu ru nī la k+ṣa na'i zhal nas/ dang por blo ldan rtogs pa bskyed// gnyis pa gnas lugs ma yengs bsgom// de nas nyams myong skyes pa na// spyod pa bags kyis spyad par bya// gu ru sa mu dra'i zhal nas/ skye med rtogs kyang nyams myong dang bral na// dper na srin mo'i lag tu bu khyer 'dra// nyams myong gnas lugs dag dang ma 'brel na// de yang glang chen 'dam du zhugs pa 'dra// gu ru bi ra la pa'i zhal nas/ bla ma dam pa mthong na de nyid mthong*// nam mkha'i mthongs su bsgoms na dben pa'i mchog /chos rnams yongs su rtogs na mi mthun med// nam mkha'i 'o ma 'thungs na 'tsho bar 'gyur// skal ldan dag gi don phyir bla ma rnams kyi rtogs pa'i snying po kun// tshad med blo yis legs bsdus bsod nams rgya chen bdag gis gang thob des// 'gro rnams bla ma dang 'phrad byin rlabs yang dag sems la zhugs gyur nas// gnas lugs don nyid yang dag sems rtogs rgyal ba'i sa la gnas gyur cig

/grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rtogs pa'i snying po zhes bya ba slob dpon dpa' bo 'od gsal gyis phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa rdzogs so/// / ༄༅// thugs kyi gsang ba glur blangs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis dam pa rgya gar la gnang*/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ tsit+ta guh+ya do hi nā ma/ bod skad du/ thugs kyi gsang ba glur blangs pa zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bram ze chen po sa ra has thugs kyi rtogs pa mgur du bzhengs pa/ kye hoḥ'akhor 'das kun gyi rtsa ba sems kyi rang bzhin te// rtogs na sgom du med kyi ma bcos lhug par zhog /rang la bzhag nas gzhan las 'tshol ba a re 'khrul// 'di yin 'di min med do thams cad gnyug ma'i ngang*// zhes gsung ngo*// klu sgrub kyis gsungs pa/ rtogs na gang gis 'ching bar nus pa khyod kyis smros// 'ching ba gang yin de ni ye nas gol ba nyid// gang la bcing dang 'ching bar bya ba ma grub na// nags la gnas pa'i glang po gang bder rgyug tu chug /gsung ngo*// pradz+nyāk+s+ya pha las smras pa/ rtogs dang ma rtogs gnyis kyi bar na su 'dug pa// de ni nga yin gzhan du ci yang yod ma yin// de la gang mthong de ni bde chen rang byung ste// thams cad thams cad de nyid yin par shes par bya// gsung ngo*// zhi ba 'tshos gsungs pa/ mnyam nyid dbyings las ma g.yos cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston// chu bran sna tshogs rgya mtshor gcig go lan tshwa'i ro// du ma ro gcig 'di la tha dad yod ma yin// thams cad thams cad gnyug ma'i ro yis khyab na bde// gsung ngo*// blo gros brtan pas gsungs pa/ zla rgyal mkha' la shar bas rgyu skar zil gnon ltar// gnyis med ye shes chen pos rtog tshogs nyams par byas// 'dis ni 'khor ba'i sa bon ma lus bcom zin gyi// da ni mya ngan 'das pa gzhan du ma tshol cig /gsung ngo*//

ngag gi dbang phyug gis gsungs pa/ snang srid chos dbyings pho brang na// rig pa'i ye shes lham me ba// bde gsal stong pa'i gdan la bzhugs// 'dod yon sna tshogs mchod par 'bul// dgag sgrub med par rol du gsol// gsung ngo*// rdo rje dril bu pas gsungs pa/ sems kyi de nyid mthong 'dod cing*// bdag gzhan 'dod pa sgrub 'dod na// spyi bo'i nor bu mchod par bya// dngos grub thams cad de las 'byung*// gsung ngo*// shang ka ras gsungs pa/ dri med shel sgong dag pa gcig /tshon gyi rkyen gyis sna tshogs 'char// bar snang khams su 'jog shes na// gtan gyi bde ba de las 'byung*// gsung ngo*// shān+ti pas gsungs pa/ gnas na zhog la 'gro na thong*// gnyer kha ma byed yan du chug /ched du gang 'dzin 'khrul pa yin// gzings la 'phur ba'i bya rog ltos// gsung ngo*// bir+wa pas gsungs pa/ gang gang mthong ba de de nyid// dran pa'i rtsi dang ma bral bar// ci rigs par ni nyams su long*// gser 'gyur rtsi yi mkhan por ltos// gsung ngo*// ye shes zhabs kyis gsungs pa/ snying phyung skyes bus yan lag g.yob par mi nus bzhin// sems nyid rtsa ba bral na rtog pas bcing du med// dug gi sngags can dug nyid sman du 'gyur ba bzhin// thabs dang ldan pas nyon mongs nyid ni byang chub rgyu// gsung ngo*// shān+ti de was gsungs pa/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyi rtsa ba la// byang sems rnam gnyis sdong po rgyas// 'di phyi gnyis kyi me tog shar// bdag gzhan gnyis kyi 'bras bu smin// gsung ngo*// ye shes snying pos gsungs pa/ chu shing snying po bral ba bzhin// sems kyi de nyid btsal gyis stor// sgyu mkhan ri mo ji bzhin du// sna tshogs snang la ngos gzung med// gsung ngo*// ni ru pas gsungs pa/ mar me rang gsal gcig pur zhog /chu dang rlabs ni tha dad min// bya yi rjes la btsal mi dgos// gnyid sad skyes bu blo sems bde// gsung ngo*//

tog rtse bas gsungs pa/ gang la nges shes skyes pas rtsa ba zin// de bas lhag pa'i ngo sprod gzhan yod min// snang dang srid pa'i chos rnams thams cad la// bla mar ma gyur pa ni yod ma yin// gsung ngo*// nag po zhabs kyis gsungs pa/ me tog sna tshags du ma'i ro// bung bas gcig tu sdud pa ltar// chos rnams sna tshogs du ma'i ro// rtogs dang ldan pas gcig tu bsdus// ro ni skye ba med pa'i ro// myong ni ngos gzung med par myong*// gsung ngo*// nā ga bhu su kas gsungs pa/ myong ba med pa'i nyams myong la// blo dang bral bas nyams su blangs// rtogs su med par gtan la phab// thob tu med par mngon du 'gyur// gsung ngo*// lū hi pas gsungs pa/ gnyug ma'i shes pa 'gyur med mngon du gyur nas kyang*// rtsol bas sangs rgyas logs su 'tshol ba ngal ba ste// glang po rnyed nas glang po'i rjes 'tshol ji bzhin no// nga ni sangs rgyas med par shes pas 'dod blo bral// gsung ngo*// kṛṣ+ṇa pas gsungs pa/ ngos gzung med par ngo sprad pas// stong nyid ngang du nyams su myong*// dran pa'i mel tshes srung mkhas pas// 'khrul pa'i rkun pos glags ma rnyed// rgyun chad med par nyams blangs pas// 'du 'bral med par mngon du gyur// gsung ngo*// in+d+ra bhū tīs gsungs pa/ skyes bu gnyid log 'khrul pas non gyur kyang*// gnyid sad dus na 'khrul pa yul na med// de bzhin ma rtog 'khor bar sdug bsngal kyang*// rtogs dang ldan la 'khor ba'i yul na med// gsung ngo*// rat+na kīrtis gsungs pa/ nyi ma'i 'od zer kun nas rgyas pa'i drwa ba can// mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad ngo mtshar che// rtogs ldan bla ma thugs rje'i 'od zer drwa ba can// gdul bya'i blo yi mun sel 'di ni ngo mtshar che// gsung ngo*// kau ka tas gsungs pa/ dbang bzhis smin pa'i bu la nyams kyi gdams pa yod// thos pas sgro 'dogs chod la tshig gi gdams pa yod// bla mas thugs la 'dogs la gnad kyi gdams pa yod// 'khrul pa khong du zhig la mtshang gi gdams pa yod// gsung ngo*//

sa ha dzas gsungs pa/ bu nyon khyod kyis nam mkha'i dkyil du ltos// lho sprin mi gda' 'di ni nam mkha'i cho 'phrul yin// 'ja' tshon 'di la bden par ma 'dzin par// chu bo chen po'i rgyun la zhon la shar du rgyugs// gsung ngo*// glang chen gos kyis gsungs pa/ rtsi yi rgyal pos 'bru rnams bcud du 'gyur ba bzhin// nyams myong rtsi yis snang srid bde ba chen por 'bar// gang gang mthong ba de de skye med spros dang bral// 'di la ngos 'dzin med pas stong pa btsal mi dgos// gsung ngo*// bha su dha ris gsungs pa/ 'gro ba thams cad bde bar gshegs// snang ba thams cad chos kyi sku// 'dod yon thams cad sems kyi rgyan// rtog tshogs thams cad ye shes che// gsung ngo*// he ru ka pas gsungs pa/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas// bla ma'i zhal las gsal bar rtogs// gzhan gyis brjod min gnyug ma'i don// 'di ni ma bcos rang byung ba'o// gsung ngo*// ka na ko tis gsungs pa/ srid pa'i me yis dngos po thams cad sreg pa ltar// rtogs pa'i me yis bdag tu 'dzin pa bsregs nas kyang*// 'khor ba'i bud shing ma lus gtan nas 'joms par byed// de nas 'gro ba'i don du ci bder gshegs pa yin// gsung ngo*// nyi ma'i rtsal gyis gsungs pa/ sna tshogs sems kyi cho 'phrul te// sems ni 'di zhes mtshon du med// de phyir 'khor 'das rtsa ba bral// de nyid chos skur shes par gyis// gsung ngo*// rin chen rdo rjes gsungs pa/ nges shes las ni don mthong 'gyur// mos gus las ni byin rlabs 'byung*// brtson 'grus kyis ni dgos pa 'grub// gsung ngo*// tre'u tra pas gsungs pa/ rig pa khong nas ma sad na// 'di zhes bstan pas rtogs mi 'gyur// mig nad can gyi snang ba bzhin// thog mar rang rgyud bsal bar bya// gsung ngo*// yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes gsungs pa/ mthong ba mngon du ma gyur na// mig gi dbang pos yul mthong bzhin// 'dod pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byung bas// goms par bya ba shin tu gces// gsung ngo*//

dza wa ri pas gsungs pa/ sku gsum phyi rol yul na med// rig pa'i ye shes dwangs pa las// gzugs brnyan tsam du nang nas 'char// rnam par rtog pas rnyog mi bya// gsung ngo*// gu bha ri pas gsungs pa/ snang srid ye grol chos kyi dbyings// phyag rgya chen por spang thob med// nam mkha'i bya yis gar ma phyin// byis pa'i rtsol ba sha thang chad// gsung ngo*// lwa ba'i na bza' can gyis gsungs pa/ gang du'ang ma mthong long ba'i mig /cir yang mi sems gti mug dang*// gang du ma phyin 'phye bo'i 'gros// ci yang ma thob dbul mo'i gter// gsung ngo*// dpal bshes gnyen gyis gsungs pa/ rin chen gling du phyin na dbul dang bral// bla ma'i bka' drin thob na 'khrul pa zhig /sems kyi de nyid mthong na 'khor ba med// byang sems nang du 'byongs na 'go don 'byung*// gsung ngo*//

rā dza ha stis gsungs pa/ rtogs nas gzhan don mi byed pa// de ni sa yi gter srung bzhin// 'di na tshogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// thugs rjes sems can mi 'dzin nam// gsung ngo*// bzang po dpal gyis gsungs pa/ bdag dang sems can dbyer med kyang*// 'gro ba las kyis sdug bsngal bas// rgyun chad med pa'i thugs rje yis// 'gro ba'i don la rol du gsol// gsung ngo*// li la'i bzang pos gsungs pa/ rang la yod kyang ngo ma shes// dbul mo gter gyis bslus pa bzhin// de nyid ma mthong sems can la// thugs rjes sgron me gdeg tu gsol// gsung ngo*// rnal 'byor ma dū ti mas gsungs pa/ chab dang chab rom tha dad min// snang dang stong pa dbyer mi phyed// mkha' dang rlung la bye brag med// sems dang sems byung de bzhin no// gsung ngo*// shing lo mas gsungs pa/ brag ca'i sgra 'di su yis smras// me long gzugs brnyan su yis bris// rmi lam ltad mo gang du gyes// gang na'ang med do sems kyi ngang*// gsung ngo*// dur khrod mas gsungs pa/ kun gzhi dag pa chos dbyings yin// yin ngo shes pa ye shes yin// bdag 'dzin zhig na rtsa bral yin// sgo lnga rang grol lam khyer yin// gsung ngo*// gcer bu mas gsungs pa/ rang grol blo dang bral ba la// ma bcos sgo gsum lhug par zhog /mi zhen dgag sgrub med par zhog /mi g.yo mnyam nyid chen por bzhag /gsung ngo*// ro langs mas gsungs pa/ ma yengs sgom du med pa la// nyams su len na mkhas pa yin// sna tshogs brjod med chen po ru// lam du 'khyer na grol ba yin// gsung ngo*// ma hā sid+dhis gsungs pa/ ma sgom ma sgom blo ma sgom// blo sgom rtog pa'i 'khrul 'khor yin// rtog pas 'khor bar 'ching ba ste// blo dang bral bar sgom du med// gsung ngo*// dri med mas gsungs pa/ sems nyid ye stong ye bral la// skye med sgom pas ci zhig bya// sems byung rang shar rang grol la// rtog pa spong bas ci zhig bya// gsung ngo*//

blo gros dbyangs mas gsungs pa/ nam mkha'i ye shes kun la khyab// ye grol chen po mchog gi lam// mi g.yo mi 'gyur bsam las 'das// rtog med rang rig ye shes che// gsung ngo*// bdag med mas gsungs pa/ nam mkha' nam mkha' mnyam nyid che// nyi ma nyi ma ye gsal che// chu bo chu bo rgyun chad med// 'ja' tshon rang grol bde ba che// gsung ngo*// gsal byed mas gsungs pa/ go ru med pa'i don rtogs na// brjod du med pa'i gleng gzhi 'gyur// bsam du med pa'i don bsgoms na// thob tu med pa'i 'bras bu 'byung*// gsung ngo*// bye ma lung pas gsungs pa/ gnyis med bde chen don gyi mchog /rang la yod pas gzhan du 'tshol// mi shes rtsol bas sgra phyir 'brang*// 'khrul pa'i sems can snying re rje// gsung ngo*// rdo rje gcig mas gsungs pa/ stong nyid nam mkha'i glegs bam la// rang rig ye shes yi ger bris// sna tshogs thabs kyi gdams pa bkod// rgyun chad med pa'i bstan pa sgrogs// gsung ngo*// sngo bsangs mas gsungs pa/ mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje la// g.yo 'gul 'byung ba'i cho 'phrul shar// sna tshogs skye 'gro'i bya ba byas// rang grol nam mkha'i ngang du yal// gsung ngo*// gri skor mas gsungs pa/ ming dang bral ba'i ming mang pos// der 'dzin zhig pa'i blo bral po// yongs su grol ba'i byar med po// ye yin chen po rtogs par gyis// gsung ngo*// lam skyes mas gsungs pa/ dmigs bya dmigs byed mtha' spangs te// ting 'dzin rten dang bral ba la// chu bo chen po'i rgyun bzhin du// ma yengs nyams su blang bar bya// gsung ngo*// bshes gnyen mas gsungs pa/ nam mkha'i bya lam rjes med bzhin// rnal 'byor spyod pa rjes med yin// rang rgyud 'dzin pa med gyur na// mi dge bcus kyang 'ching mi nus// gsung ngo*// ro zan mas gsungs pa/ gser 'gyur rtsi dang 'phrad pa bzhin// snang srid bde stong ngor shar bas// dngos por 'dzin pa kun las grol// snang srid spros bral ye shes che// gsung ngo*//

pad+mo shrīs gsungs pa/ gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa de// bsam sgom blo yis ma bcos na// chos sku gzhan nas btsal mi dgos// rang chas yin no lhug par zhog /gsung ngo*// pad+mo'i rgyal mos gsungs pa/ rang rig ye shes 'di rnyed na// bskal pa'i mun par sgron me bzhin// las kyi 'khrul pa gtan nas bcom// skyes bu gnyid sad ji bzhin no// gsung ngo*// mkha' 'gro ma da kar mos gsungs pa/ las zin skyes bu de ci sems// bram ze skud pa 'khal la ltos// nam mkha' gang gis za bar nus// khyod dang nga la tha dad med// gsung ngo*// lha sras dpal gzher gyis gsungs pa/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can// bde bar gshegs pa'i shul yin te// gol sa med par gsungs pas na// thabs dang shes rab ldan par bya// gsung ngo*// rdo rje bde bas gsungs pa/ mi g.yo bsam gtan rgya chen po// g.yo 'gul sna tshogs kun gyi gzhi// g.yo dang mi g.yo dbyer med pas// sgom dang mi sgom 'di la med// gsung ngo*// ye shes zhabs kyis gsungs pa/ gang du chos rnams ma mthong ba// de yis chos kun mthong ba ste// mthong bya mthong byed kun las 'das// rang rig ye shes chen po yin// gsung ngo*// gha gha dpal gyis gsungs pa/ gang du mthong tshor myong ba kun// de de'i ngo bos stong shes na// 'dod yon sems kyi rgyan yin te// 'ching bar mi 'gyur grol bar 'gyur// gsung ngo*// las kyi 'byung gnas kyis gsungs pa/ sems kyi ye shes gang mthong ba// chos kyi de nyid rtogs 'gyur te// chos rtogs pas ni bde ba thob// gsung ngo*// rgyan gyi rgyal mos gsungs pa/ dbyibs dang bral ba'i mdog med po// ming dang bral ba'i don med po// sna tshogs rig pa'i bsam med po// spangs pa med pa'i thob med po// gsung ngo*// mkha' 'gro ma lwa ba can gyis gsungs pa/ dmigs med ye shes chen po 'di// tshig gis mtshon par mi nus te// bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa las// gzhan gyis rtogs pa ma yin no// gsung ngo*//

thig le dag pa'i phreng ba zhes bya ba grub thob pho mo brgyad cu'i rtogs pa brjod pa mkha' 'gro mas yi ger btab ste gsang mdzod na gnas pa las/ dbyings kyi gtso mo rnams kyis bka' bgros nas rje dam pa rgya gar la gnang ba/ zha ma lo tsā bas legs par bsgyur ba'o// ༄༅// grub thob bzhi bcus rdo rje'i mgur thig le gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// grub thob bzhi bcus mdzad/ ༄༅// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ gang gis ma rtogs pa yis rtogs pa'i spyod pa mi bya ste// byas na rgyal po'i khrims la dmangs kyis gnod pa byas pa bzhin// rtogs pa rnams kyis ma rtogs pa yis spyod pa mi bya ste// byas na glang chen dag ni 'dam du bying ba 'dra// gsung ngo*// slob dpon sa ra ha'i zhal nas/ kye hoḥgrogs dag lhan cig skyes pa de// gzhan nas mi rnyed bla ma'i zhal la dris// don dam zhal gyi ngo bo de rtogs na// yid ni gar 'ching rlung yang chad pa med// gsung ngo*// slob dpon tog rtse pa'i zhal nas/ tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad// tshogs drug dag na bde chen rgyun mi 'chad// brtag pa thams cad don med g.yeng ba'i rgyu// sgom du med pas gnyug ma'i ngang la zhog /gsung ngo*// slob dpon sa man+ta badz+ra'i zhal nas/ phyag rgya chen po rang la lhun gyis grub pa ste// mi bsam mi rig 'bad pa med par ngang gis zhog /chad pa med de mngon du nyams myong rang gis rig /rtag par mi 'gyur mngon zhen med par zung du 'jug /gsung ngo*// slob dpon ka na pa'i zhal nas/ shing rta'i 'khor lo gcig dang mi ldan 'gro bar mi nus bzhin// sbyin sogs 'bad pa byas kyang bla ma'i man ngag med na dngos grub dam pa med// bya rgod rtsal rdzogs 'dab mar bcas pa dag ni mkha' la spyod cing rgyug /skal bzang rnal 'byor dam pa rnams ni dbang dang byin rlabs dam pa'i 'og tu chud cing bde// gsung ngo*//

slob dpon kam+pa la'i zhal nas/ zab cing rgya che rgya mtsho nor bus gang ba la// klu yi rgyal po rnams kyis mnga' mdzad ngo mtshar che// snang grag thams cad ye nas chos sku yin pa la// rtogs dang nyams myong ldan pas mnga' mdzad ngo mtshar che// gsung ngo*// slob dpon lū hi pa'i zhal nas/ khyi rgod rab tu mi srun sna la sbrang rtsi byugs na phyogs rnams kun tu za bar byed// blo dman skal ba dman pa'i gang zag rnams la dbang dang gdams ngag byin pas rang rgyud sreg /glang chen dpa' la brtan pa'i sna la ral gri bskur bas dgra dpung 'joms// skal bzang blo ldan skye med rtogs pa rnams kyis thug phrad dag gis rnam rtog 'joms// gsung ngo*// slob dpon til+li pa'i zhal nas/ ri rab gser gyi ngos la bya gnas pa// bya yi rang bzhin bor nas gser du snang*// mkhas pa gang gis skye ba med rtogs na// dngos po'i rang bzhin bor nas bde ba che// gsung ngo*// yang til+li pa'i zhal nas/ bdag nyid gdod ma nyid nas sangs rgyas yin pa la// ma rtogs dbang gis sangs rgyas nyid du ma mthong ngo*// gnyis med gang gis rtogs pa de ni phyag rgya che// rtogs pa'i dus na mthong ba med cing thob pa med// gsung ngo*// slob dpon shes rab bzang po'i zhal nas/ byis pa chung ngu gsos nas gyad kyi stobs dang ldan pa bzhin// blo chung rnams kyang bla ma'i gdams ngag dag gis brid pas theg pa che// rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i nad rnams sman gyis sel ba ltar// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i nad rnams bla ma'i gdams ngag dag gis skad cig nyid la sreg /gsung ngo*// slob dpon nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal dpung gi tshogs rnams kyis// gling rnams kun la dbang sgyur bzhin// lhan cig skyes pa'i ro rnyed pas// 'khor ba dag la dbang sgyur ngo mtshar che// gsung ngo*// slob dpon ḍom+bi pa chung ba'i zhal nas/

gser 'gyur rtsi yi nus pa yis// lcags rnams gser du 'gyur ba bzhin// rin chen dbang gi nus pa yis// nyon mongs ye shes gnyis med 'gyur// gsung ngo*// slob dpon dza wa ri pa'i zhal nas/ skye med rtogs kyang nyams myong dang bral na// de yang srin mo'i lag tu bu khyer 'dra// nyams su myong yang gnas lugs ma rtogs na// de yang glang chen lcags kyus 'phrog pa 'dra// gsung ngo*// slob dpon ba su dha ra'i zhal nas/ gang gis ma rtogs bar du ro 'di 'bras chan dag dang khyad par che// de bzhin ma rtogs bar du sangs rgyas sems can khyad par brtag /rtogs pa'i dus na 'khor ba dag kyang sangs rgyas che// de phyir rtogs dang ma rtogs dag kyang dbye bar dka' bas khyad med do// gsung ngo*// slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po'i zhal nas/ bya ba gtong ba man ngag yin// zhe 'dod med na rtogs pa yin// bsgrub bya med na spyod pa yin// smra brjod med na nyams myong yin// blang dor med na 'bras bu yin// gsung ngo*// slob dpon ḍom+bi he ru ka'i zhal nas/ rtogs pa yid bzhin nor bu la// nyams su myong bas mdog phyung la// spyod pa'i nus pas dgos 'dod 'byung*// ro snyoms ldan pa rnams kyis 'grub// gsung ngo*// slob dpon a wa dhū tī'i zhal nas/ thabs dang shes rab an dza la// bla ma'i chu bo'i rgyun gyis rab tu brgyal// lhan cig skyes pa'i dpag bsam shing dag la// 'bras bu lhun grub rang las rdzogs par 'byung*// gsung ngo*// slob dpon dā ri ka pa'i zhal nas/ rang la bde chen yod kyang ma rtogs 'khrul bas bsgribs// bde chen gsal bar 'dod na tshogs gnyis bsag par bya// tshogs gnyis ma bsags bskal pa brgya ru 'bad byas kyang*// don med don dang mi ldan bde chen rtogs mi 'gyur// gsung ngo*// slob dpon nag po pa'i zhabs kyi zhal nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo gcig

/de yi rang bzhin byang chub sems// rtogs par 'dod na ji bzhin zhog /goms par byas na mngon du 'gyur// gsung ngo*// slob dpon gcer bu lhung bzed kyi zhal nas/ bla ma dag las dang por rang gi sems rtogs bya// de nas chos rnams kun dang tha dad med byas la// gnyis med goms phyir dur khrod gnas su 'dug nas ni// mnyam par bzhag nas smyon pa'i brtul zhugs dag gis spyad// gsung ngo*// slob dpon ro langs bde ba'i zhal nas/ rta dang glang po rgya mtsho 'dra na rab tu bde// spre'u byis pa chu yi ri mo 'dra na rtog par 'gyur// chu bo nyi ma sman dang 'dra na dbyer mi phyed// gtsug phud mig dang 'khor lo lta bur 'bras bu thob// gsung ngo*// slob dpon rā ma pha la'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa'i mchog /rang gi rtogs par gnas pas na// gnyug ma'i sems kyi rtogs pa gang*// sangs rgyas thams cad des mthong yin// gsung ngo*// slob dpon kuk+ku ri pa'i zhal nas/ dbyer med sa la gnas na kun kyang skal ba bzang*// rgya mtsho'i gting du phyin na dbul dang bral// ral gri lag tu thogs na longs spyod che// phyogs med sa la phyin na gnyen dang 'phrad// gsung ngo*// slob dpon spyod pa mthu stobs can gyi zhal nas/ rnal 'byor rnams la gang snang thams cad gdams pa ste// mthong bas de yi skye med rtogs pas slob dpon mchog /byas pa kun gyis skye med rtogs phyir thabs yin te// dga' dang mi dga' bral na skyes bu de la gnyis med 'byung*// gsung ngo*// slob dpon ku mā ra trī zhal nas/ gang gis bla ma'i gdams pa la// dbang blangs lhan cig skyes pa yi// ro yis kun las khyab byas te// skye med rgyas 'debs rdo rje 'dzin// byin rlabs shar bas dbyer med rdzogs sangs rgyas// gsung ngo*// slob dpon bha ti pi zhal nas/ chos rnams kun kyang rang gi sems dang gnyis med sbyor// rtogs pa'i nyams myong nges don gdams pa'i don bral na// nor bu mching bu dag la bde chen min// chos de rnams dang ldan na re dogs med par rang sar zhog

/gsung ngo*/ slob dpon lus med rdo rje'i zhal nas/ sems ma gdungs na bde ba che// zhe 'dod med na ro snyoms yin// 'bad rtsol bral na sgom pa'i mchog /gnyis snang bral na rdzogs sangs rgyas// gsung ngo*// rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi'i zhal nas/ dus kyi sna tshe bdag byin brlab dang mi ldan na// phyi dang nang gi spyod pa byas kyang rnal 'byor 'tshang mi rgya// bde ba rang chas snang ba dag dang khyad par med// zhen pa btang nas nyams su myong bas mchog 'thob 'gyur// gsung ngo*// slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra'i zhal nas// gar yang ma blta dbus su ltos// mchog dang bral na dga' ba che// sngags rig gsang ba ltos spyod na// rnal 'byor rtags kyis bsgyur bar bya// gsung ngo*// lha lcam lak+ṣ+mī ka ra'i zhal nas/ dang po blo ldan rtogs pa bskyed// gnyis pa nags su sna rtse bsgom// nyams su myong ba skyes pa na// spyod pa'i khyad par rtogs par bya// gsung ngo*//

slob dpon pad+mo'i zhabs kyi zhal nas/ gang gang lhan cig skyes pa de// glang po che yi mig bzhin du// gze rer skyes nas zug rngur 'gyur// glod na zhen med bsam gtan mchog /gsung ngo*// slob dpon snying po'i zhabs kyi zhal nas/ chu rgyun gnas pa'i nyams brtan nas// spyod pa'i gnas kyis 'gro bar bya// bla ma dam pa'i gdams nga ga gis// chags sdang rtog pa zhi bar bya// gsung ngo*// slob dpon rdo rje'i zhabs kyi zhal nas/ bde'o bde'o gnas med bde// 'dod pa med pa'i rang bzhin bde// brtags pas thams cad der shes ba de// sgrub pa med pa'i sangs rgyas bde// gsung ngo*// slob dpon shān+ti pa'i zhal nas/ rus sbal lta bur 'khor ba yi// skyon gyis ma gos gdod nas dag /sgron mes mun bral bla ma yi// drin gyis ye shes nyi ma 'de// gsung ngo*// slob dpon dril bu'i zhabs kyi zhal nas/ la la ras nā dhā tī gsum// bdag byin brlab phyir bcing bar bya// bla ma sems dang snang ba gsum// rtogs pa bskyed phyir mkhas pas bsten// gsung ngo*// slob dpon mdung can lkugs pa'i zhal nas/ dgag sgrub bral ba'i sku bzhi dbyer mi phyed// gza' gtad med pa'i chos kun rtsa ba gcig /ma yengs pa ni sangs rgyas kun gyi lam// phyogs cha med na rnal 'byor kun gyi mchog /gsung ngo*// slob dpon ku ti bhir lba'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas mchod sogs rnams las don mi 'byung*// 'dod dang rtsol ba yod na sangs mi rgya// byin rlabs bla ma'i ngag gis nyams myong 'phel// bla ma'i man ngag cha las gzhan gyis min// gsung ngo*// slob dpon mi pham ral pa can gyi zhal nas/ rje btsun dam pa bsten na de nyid 'thob// nags tshal mthongs su bsgoms na dben pa 'thob// chos rnams sems su rtogs na mi mthun med// nam mkha'i 'o ma 'thungs na tshim par 'gyur// gsung ngo*// slob dpon zhi ba'i dbang phyug gi zhal nas/

bde ba stong pa'i mtha' dang bral rtogs na// dpag bsam shing la brten pas nyes bral te// mtsho la skyes bu rkyal bas 'gro shes na// bram ze pha dang ma las bu skye 'gyur// gsung ngo*// rnal 'byor ma dharma'i zhal nas/ go cha chen po gon nas kyang*// nor bu lta bu'i snying stobs kyis// rang gis sems la chu btang ste// mi ro'i khog par nges zhugs nas// skye ba bdun pa'i sha zos na// nam mkha' la ni bya bzhin no// gsung ngo*// slob dpon me tri pa'i zhal nas/ bde dang stong pa dbyer med snying ga'i pad+ma dag la rdzogs// skye med yid la byed pa bsam gyis mi khyab bde ba chen po'i sems// snang grags thams cad ro mnyam gsum du rnal 'byor pa yis spyod// rje btsun dag gi byin rlabs shar bas dbyer med rdzogs sangs rgyas// gsung ngo*// rnal 'byor ma gha gha'i zhal nas/ yul la ma blta sems la'ang ma blta zhig /zhe 'dod ma byed bya ba ma byed cig /dog pa ma 'cha' nyams par ma byed par// gnyug ma'i shes pa gar dga' nyid du thong*// gsung ngo*// bhu su kyu'i zhal nas/ bya ba 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal nyid du zad// bya ba gtong ba'i rnal 'byor sems rtogs byed// gang du'ang mi gnas rtag chad mtha' las 'das// sgom du med pas bsam gyis mi khyab nyid// gsung ngo*// rnal 'byor ma kang ka ra'i zhal nas/ gnyis med shes pa chu la chu bzhag 'dra// rang bzhin ma bslad glang po lta bur zhog /nyams myong spre'u gang ltar byung yang rung*// rtogs pa'i nam mkhar ji ltar khyab par bya// gsung ngo*// slob dpon tha ga na'i zhal nas/ ji ltar rna bar chu zhugs pa// chu nyid kyis ni dbyung ba ltar// thams cad ye nas rdzun pa la// rdzun par bsgoms pas bden pa mthong*// zhes gsung ngo*// dpal o rgyan du tshogs 'khor byed pa'i dus su rnal 'byor pa grub pa thob pa bzhi bcus rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa nyams kyi man ngag thig le gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so/// /
