shes pa bden med du longs pas 'khrul pa'i rkyen las grol ba shrī ta ri'i zhal snga nas/ thub pa'i spyan gyis rlung sems bcing*// snang ba ma dmigs der 'dzin grol// de tshe shes pa yul mi 'phrog /dus gsum chig chod 'gro 'ong med// ces gsung ngo*// bde chen rgyal mo bu kha dha'i zhal snga nas/ mi g.yo rtse gcig dang ba'i ngang*// rtog pa rang grol chos kyi sku// rig pa gcer bu sgrib g.yogs bral// shes pa rang lugs phyag rgya che// zhes gsung ngo*// 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i rtsis 'bras bu la 'dod blo bral ba ghu bhe ri pa'i zhal snga nas/ sku bzhi thob tu mi ster ba'i// gegs de 'dod pa'i blo yin no// 'di yod sgrib pa mi 'dag pas// zhing khams gsal bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsung ngo*// dpal gyi sgron me su kha tsan+dha'i zhal snga nas/ 'dod pa'i blo bral bde chen gyis// dus der sdug bsngal bral bar byed// 'dod pa'i blo rnams log pa yis// zag pa'i 'dam rdzab bskam par 'gyur// zhes gsung ngo*// nges pa'i shes pas the tshom gyi dri ma sel ba shrī pā ra nā'i zhal snga na/ kun la khyab pa chos kyi sku// rang bzhin ma skyes ma 'gags pa'i// spros dang bral ba'i mtshan nyid de// ye shes rang gnas rgyun chad med// ces gsung ngo*// bde ba'i mdzod 'dzin ma dha nu ro ha'i zhal snga nas/ nam mkha'i mdangs can gdod nas dag /mtha' bzhi las ni rnam par grol// 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi// dus kyis ma bsdus phyag rgya che// zhes gsung ngo*// nyon mongs pa rang thog tu grol bas gnyen po'i bya ra zhig pa sa ra dhi pa'i zhal snga nas/ shes pa ngar chen der ltos dang*// nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas pa ra// rig pa dri med lam gyi mchog /thig le grol na rnam par mthong*// zhes gsung ngo*// bde ba'i sgrol ma ma dha la'i zhal snga nas/ sems la ye shes skye 'gyur ba// rig pa grung pa khro bo'i spyan// sor bzhag rnam rtog rlung mi bskyod// rten 'brel gyis ni yang dag 'grub// ces gsung ngo*//

nyams myong snang ba las grol bas sgom thun 'jog zhig pa nā ga badz+ra'i zhal snga nas/ bla ma'i byin rlabs ma zhugs pa'i// rgyud la rtogs pa 'char ba min// nges pa'i shes pa ma skyes par// de nyid zab mo'i don mi mthong*// zhes gsung ngo*// 'bar ba'i gtso mo a ma ka pā li'i zhal snga nas/ gnyug ma ras su ma chud pa'i// rten 'brel che ba bla ma'i brda// 'di la nges par stor ba na// mtshon byed yi ge mang du 'gyur// zhes gsung ngo*// dus gsum skye 'gag gis stong pa'i rig pas rnam rtog rang sar dwangs pa pad+ma badz+ra'i zhal snga nas/ bden pa mthong bas 'khrul pa'i blo// yang dag bden pa de shigs shig /'di yis glo mtha'i lta ba grol// des ni gnyis snang mi gnas so// zhes gsung ngo*// legs pa'i dpal mo si ri ti ra'i zhal snga nas/ rten 'brel rtsa ba phyin pa yis// 'khor ba'i sa bon mi gnas te// ma rig pa nas rga shi'i bar// rten cing 'brel bas 'khor ba stong*// zhes gsung ngo*// spros bral gyi don dran pas gzung ba'i rjes la yul rjes mi 'brel ba badz+ra dz+nya na'i zhal snga nas/ tha mal rnam rtog nub pa yi// rten la thabs kyi lam mi dgos// 'khrul pa dag pa'i shes pa la// 'di la lta ba dgos pa min// zhes gsung ngo*// dpal gyi rgyal mo su ka ra li'i zhal snga nas/ rtog pa'i spu ris spangs pa yi// shes pa la ni sgom mi dgos// rang snang grol bar gyur pa la// sgrub pa nyams su blang mi dgos// zhes gsung ngo*// yul snang sgyu mar ngos zin pas shes pa la der 'dzin zhig pa bi ma la ghi ti'i zhal snga nas/ tshogs drug yul la ma 'phros pas// dus gsum rang sar grol bar 'gyur// bde chen go 'phang mchog 'dod pas// rtse gcig brtan las 'da' mi bya// zhes gsung ngo*// rdzu 'phrul gyi 'od zer can pad+ma wa ti'i zhal snga nas/ yengs na de nyid mthong mi 'gyur// ma yengs pa ni thabs kyi gnad// bde gsal stong pa'i rang bzhin can// 'di yis rab tu rnyed par byed// ces gsung ngo*//

brda don khong du chud pas 'khrul pa yul thog tu chod pa gīrti dz+nya na'i zhal snga nas/ le lo 'khrul snang grong khyer dang*// 'dres pa 'dis ni thar pa'i lam// dus gsum nam yang rnyed pa med// brtags na 'khrul pa gzhi yod min// zhes gsung ngo*// dpal gyi bde ster ma sa ri dha ri'i zhal snga nas/ 'di ni rang snang glo bur ba// rtsa bral rang bzhin med pa yi// mtshang der ltos dang rnal 'byor pa/ de mthong 'khrul pa 'jig par 'gyur// zhes gsung ngo*// rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid rab tu snang ba rdo rje'i mgur las/ mi zad pa'i rin po che'i gter mdzod rnam par rdol ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste/ bdun pa'o/// / ༈ mi mthun pa lam du bslangs pas 'gal rkyen grogs su shar ba shrī badz+ra ba la'i zhal snga nas/ 'khor ba'i sa la bde ba med// chu yi gnyer ma ji bzhin du// sdug bsngal gcig phyir gcig gis sleb// tshe 'di'i ci byas sdug bsngal rgyu// zhes gsung ngo*//

bde ba'i ros myos pa mo bhu ga la mi'i zhal snga nas/ blta ru med pa de mthong na// gzung du med par ngos zin te// des ni rtsol ba'i nad las grol// bde chen rgyal ba 'thob par byed// ces gsung ngo*// rtog pa snga phyis long ma brtags pas ma bsgoms pa'i shes pa spros bral du gyur pa dz+nya na tsakra'i zhal snga nas/ rtogs na yon tan ma rtogs skyon// gang gis gos par mi 'gyur ba'i// rang byung ye shes 'dus ma byas// gnyis med shes pa dngos po'i gshis// zhes gsung ngo*// nyon mongs pa'i skyon gyis ma gos ma bha nu ha ri'i zhal snga nas/ rtog pa 'dzin pas nyer len byed// des ni srid pa'i 'khor lor bcug /chos rnams thams cad stong pa ru// ma rig pa yis bdag tu gzung*// zhes gsung ngo*// don gyi gnad rig pas 'dzin rtog grol ba pradz+nyāk+s+ya tsan+d+ra'i zhal snga nas/ gnyug ma don gyi lhan cig skyes// ma bcos rnal ma rang ga la// dran pa'i spu ris bsten mi bya// blo dpyad zhugs na rtog pa'i gzhi// zhes gsung ngo*// 'khrul pa'i sgrog las grol ba mo su ka le'i zhal snga nas/ las dang nyon mongs bag chags kyis// rten de grub pa ma yin te// 'khor ba gzhi med rang grol la// mya ngan 'das pa ji ltar bsgrub// ces gsung ngo*// 'khrul pa'i sgrog chad pa las ye shes shar ba shrī rat+na ma ti'i zhal snga nas/ chos rnams gzhi med rang gi ngo bos stong*// don dam kun rdzob gang gis gnyis su dbye// 'khor 'das rmi lam nyid du'ang med gyur na// grub mtha' zhig pa'i lta ba ji ltar smra// zhes gsung ngo*// brdas go ba longs pa mo ra li dha ri'i zhal snga nas/ spros pa med cing skye ba med// rnam par mi rtog ma bcos pa// snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin te// lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bor rtogs// zhes gsung ngo*// snang ba'i mtshang mthong bas shes pa rkyen dang bral ba ka mo ro'i zhal snga nas/

sna tshogs snang ba'i gzung 'dzin de// ma bcos lhan cig skyes pa yi// ngo bo las ni ma 'das te// chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin can// zhes gsung ngo*// bzang mo don gyi dpal 'dzin ma gha dzu dha ri'i zhal snga nas/ rigs pa'i dngos por snang ba kun// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin te// cer cer snang ba'i dus nyid du// phyag rgya chen po mthong nas yod// ces gsung ngo*// gnyug ma'i rang ngo mthong bas rtog pas bcing du med pa rā dza me tog ha li'i zhal snga nas/ dngos po 'di ltar snang ba kun// phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo ste// rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid can// chu zla'i dkyil 'khor ji bzhin no// zhes gsung ngo*// zag med bde ba'i mdangs ldan ma ru ka li'i zhal snga nas/ mtshon byed dpe yi lhan skyes kyis// mtshon bya don gyi lhan skyes rtogs// de ni 'gro 'ong med pa'i bdag /sems nyid gnyug ma'i rang bzhin no// zhes gsung ngo*// zag med kyi shes pa yul gyis ma 'phrog pa shrī dzha na'i zhal snga nas/ snang ba'i bla mas dngos rnams gdams par bstan// sngar 'dris mi de mthong bas ngo shes bzhin// bla ma'i ngo sprod gnad la zug pa yis// chos rnams rang bzhin skye ba med par rig /ces gsung ngo*// rang rig 'od gsal gyi mdangs can ma gaṅgā le'i zhal snga nas/ dbang po drug gi spyod yul du// gang gang snang ba'i dngos po la// rang bzhin bden pas dben pa'i phyir// stong nyid ci yi phyir mi gzigs// zhes gsung ngo*// tshe 'dir zhen pa log pa tsan+d+ra sidha'i zhal snga nas/ bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mthus// e wam̐ snying gi dkyil du zhu// nge yis snang ba'i dngos po 'di// rtogs pa skye med ngang du 'jug /ces gsung ngo*// dpa' mo ye shes kyi mdangs 'phrog ma bha ga dha ra'i zhal snga nas/ tshogs drug yul snang sgyu ma la// ngos zin 'khrul pa yul las ldog

/gzhi med rang bzhin stong pa'i mtshang*// mthong bas bag chags gnas su 'joms// zhes gsung ngo*// rang gi bde sdug khyad du bsad nas gzhan don 'dzin pa pradz+nyā pha la'i zhal snga nas/ rjes la gnyen po'i bya ra bshig /bde ba'i ro la chags pa na// sgom pa nyams kyis 'ching ba ste// lha ni bdud du 'babs par 'gyur// zhes gsung ngo*// bzang mo dpal gyi 'od zer can rat+na ro ha'i zhal snga nas/ re ba dang ni dog pa yis// mtshan ma'i chos la rtog pa ni// nyams su ma myangs skyon yin pas// gnyis med rtsi yis zin par bya// rang snang rang sar grol bar bya// zhes gsung ngo*// snang ba'i mtshang gis gnyug ma'i ngo bo mthong ba de wa shrī sūr+ya'i zhal snga nas/ gang zag lam pa'i rgyud la ni// re dog gnyis su byung gyur na// lta ba ma rtogs skyon yin pas// 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// rang gi sems su blo thag gcad// ces gsung ngo*// dpal mo lha'i sgrol ma bha ga dzu lu'i zhal snga nas/ blang bya dor bya gnyis byung na// spyod pa goms par ma byas pa'i// ro ma snyoms pa'i skyon yin pas// rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// 'khor 'das med par shes par bya// zhes gsung ngo*// shes pa rkyen dang bral ba las rtog pas mi 'ching ba dā na shrī rā dza'i zhal snga nas/ 'phags lam bgrod pa'i dus der ni// bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis byung na// gnas lugs ngo yis ma zin pa'i// rkyen gyis dri ma 'thas pa yis// sems ngo skye med shes par bya// zhes gsung ngo*// spros bral gyi rgyan dang ldan pa bha ba de wa'i zhal snga nas/ mchog gi 'bras bur rer gyur na// ma rtogs skyon gyis gol ba yin// kye ma gang la re ba de// ma spangs dri ma mi 'dag pas// re ba med pa bde ba'i mchog /ces gsung ngo*// phrin las kyis gdul bya'i re ba skong ba badz+ra rasmi'i zhal snga nas/ snang ba la ni chags gyur na// lam khyer ma shes skyon yin pas// bden rdzun dngos po'i chos la blta// gang la mngon par zhen pa yis// 'ching ba'i rgyu de bor te bsgrim// zhes gsung ngo*//

phyir mi ldog pa'i phyag rgya can rat+na kha dha'i zhal snga nas/ lam du mthong ba'i rtags rnams la// bdag brod re bas sngon bsus nas// dmigs med rtsi yis ma zin pa'i// blo bral ma dag skyon yin pas// shes pa'i phug thag gcad par bya// zhes gsung ngo*// thos pa'i mtha' tshig gi thog tu chod pa tsan+d+ra hṛ da'i zhal snga nas/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal du mthong ba'i// dog pas skyo na gol ba ste// yul ma 'byongs pa'i skyon yin pas// mkhas pas dog pa spangs pa na// bde ba'i tshang du tshud pa yin// zhes gsung ngo*// 'khrul pa chos nyid du shar ba mo ha ra dha na'i zhal snga nas/ rtsol ba med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// ngos gzung bral ba'i nyams myong bskyang*// bying rgod la sogs byung gyur kyang*// de yi skyon ngo shes byas la// de kho na nyid la blo gzhag /ces gsung ngo*// don gyi gnad rig pas bsam pa'i mtha' chod pa badz+ra dha li ba'i zhal snga nas/ kye ma kye ma tha mal gyi// ma bcos shes pa ngos gzung dang*// rang gi rang bzhin nyid la blta// 'di yi dus su rang snang gi /chos la brtag dpyad spang bar bya// zhes gsung ngo*// 'dod par blo log ma ra sa bhi'i zhal snga nas/ cir snang ngo bos rang grol ba// nyon mongs bag chags kyis mi 'go /chos dang sems su ro mnyam pas// sna tshogs gzugs med rtsa bral du// grol bas smyon pa lta bu'o// zhes gsung ngo*// byin rlabs kyi nyams 'bar bas sgom thog babs su 'char ba rasmi sūr+ya'i zhal snga nas/ thams cad sgyu ma las ma 'das// rang bzhin med pa'i mtshang go bas// nang gis phyi rol byin brlabs nas// mtsho las 'khyags dar zhig pa bzhin// snang ba rang sar grol bar 'gyur// zhes gsung ngo*// rig pa snyems las grol ba mo bha ka da nu'i zhal snga nas/ 'khor 'das ro gcig rtogs pa la// des ni gnyis 'dzin shes pa grol// 'bad rtsol med par gdul bya yi// don 'byung yid bzhin nor bu ltar// 'bras bu rang las rnyed par 'gyur// zhes gsung ngo*//

tshe 'di'i rtsis bshig pas ci byas chos su song ba rat+na pa li pa'i zhal snga nas/ gzhi la gnas pa'i 'bras bu ni// e ma rang byung bsam mi khyab// rang sems skye med ngo shes pas// sku gnyis sgrub pa'i 'dun ma grol// thob bya'i 'bras bu phyi na med// ces gsung ngo*// nyon mongs pa rang thog tu snyil ba mo ra bhi na da'i zhal snga nas/ 'di ni gzugs can ma yin pas// dus gsum 'gyur ba med par gnas// 'khor ba dang ni myang 'das kyi// chos rnams phyag rgya chen po las// ma 'das kun la khyab pa'i bdag /ces gsung ngo*// lta stangs kyi gzengs smad pas 'jam rlung thog babs su zin pa gīrti sidha'i zhal snga nas/ gdod nas stong zhing bdag med pa// rin chen sems ni phyag rgya che// rgyu las ma byung skye 'jig med// ma skyes ngo bo de mthong bas// 'khor ba'i thog mtha' chod par 'gyur// zhes gsung ngo*// dus gsum rang sar grol ba mo bha ga ta'i zhal snga nas/ sems nyid 'od gsal ngo bos dben// sangs rgyas dang ni sems can gyi// khyad par yod pa ma yin te// mar me dang ni 'od bzhin no// 'di shes 'khor 'das 'dzin rtog bral// zhes gsung ngo*// rtogs pa byin brlabs las 'khrungs pa tsan+d+ra pradz+nyā zhal snga nas/ yid la mi byed don 'di la// skye dang 'gag dang 'gro 'ong med// rang snang ba ni rang gi sems// tha dad par ni mi rtog go /gnyis 'dzin bral na phyag rgya che// zhes gsung ngo*// rtog pa rang grol ba ra bhi na'i zhal snga nas/ stong pa nyid la bden pa yi// blor 'jog bdag 'dzin mdud grol 'gyur// byed mkhan ngos zin 'khrul pa 'jig /de ni gnad kyi gdams pa yin// zhes gsung ngo*// ngo sprod kyi gnad la nges pa'i shes pa skyes pa rat+na bo dha'i zhal snga nas/ rtogs pa'i don la mchog 'dzin spang*// 'dag par dka' ba'i dri ma ni// ngo bo mthong ba'i rang nyid de// mtha' dang bral bar blta ba yin// zhes gsung ngo*//

dbang gi nyams kyis bzi ba mo bha tsa la'i zhal snga nas/ glo bur rkyen las skyes pa yi// dran rig rnam par rtog pa ni// de nyid ngo bo gzhi med de// rang bzhin ma skyes pa yi gzhi// de mthong 'khrul pa'i snang ba 'jig /ces gsung ngo*// 'od gsal gyi rang ngo mkha' 'gro ma'i brda las 'phrod pa kad+dha ri pa'i zhal snga nas/ rnam par rtog pa chos nyid du// ma shes dbyings kyi ye shes ni// mtshang ma mthong bas ngos ma zin// e ma de nyid ltos dang kye// zhes gsung ngo*// mi rtog pa'i gnyid log ma siṅgā dha na'i zhal snga nas/ de nyid ngo bo 'dus ma byas// 'gro 'ong med pa'i bdag nyid can// spros pa nyer zhi 'od gsal ngang*// gdod nas dag pa der ltos dang*// zhes gsung ngo*// gnyis snang gi shes pa grol ba bīd+ya dza la'i zhal snga nas/ ma skyes mi skye skye ba med// stong nyid las byung skye ba med// skye med skye ba'i ngo bos stong*// rgyu rkyen byed pa por ma grub// ces gsung ngo*// bde ba'i ros myos pa mo gha dzu li'i zhal snga nas/ skye med dbyings las shar ba yi// chos rnams skye ba med pa'i bdag /rang bzhin las ni ma 'das te/ dngos rnams skye ba med pa'o// zhes gsung ngo*// dge ba'i dpal 'dzin bi li ta'i zhal snga nas/ bya ba btang ba'i skyes bu bde// 'jig rten pa la sdug bsngal du// ma song ba yi dngos po gang*// de ni 'phags pas gzigs mi 'gyur// zhes gsung ngo*// rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi de kho na nyid rab tu snang ba grub pa rnams kyi rdo rje'i mgur las/ dpal gyi be'u'i bcud rnam par 'jigs pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste/ brgyad pa'o/// / ༈ snang ba rgyud la nges shes skyes pas rdza na'i zhal snga nas/ las kyi phyag rgya mtshon byed de// chos kyi phyag rgya sgom pa'i lam// phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu ste// dam tshig phyag rgya phrin las so// zhes gsung ngo*//

seng ge'i rtsal dang ldan pa sid+dha na'i zhal snga nas/ mtshon byed med na don mi mthong*// bsgom bya med na lam dang bral// 'bras bu med na sgrub nas ci// phrin las med na dgos pa stor// zhes gsung ngo*// don rgyud la sgro 'dogs chod pa de wa sha ri'i zhal snga nas/ bde ba nyams myong dga' ba ste// 'dzin grol nyams myong mchog tu dga'// bde stong dbye ru med pa ni// lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'o// nyams las grol na dga' bral lo// zhes gsung ngo*// bde ba'i 'od zer can bi ma la dha na'i zhal snga nas/ myong bas lus sems rnal du gsol// zhen med nyams myong 'dzin pa grol// spros bral stong pa bde ba'i nyams// shes pa der 'dzin bral ba can// zhes gsung ngo*// byin rlabs kyi brgyud pas bar chos sol ba shrī sa ra ba'i zhal snga nas/ rang gnas rtsa ba 'dus ma byas// skad cig ma yi mtshang gis rig /tol skyes shes pa snga phyi bral// der ni gnyis snang mdud pa grol// zhes gsung ngo*// bzang mo nor bu'i 'od ldan ma dha na la'i zhal snga nas/ dran rig rnam par rtog pa ni// dmigs pa med par ma chod na// bdag chags gnas pa'i rten mi 'jig /mtshan ma rang grol der ltos shig /ces gsung ngo*// blo rten ma bcas pas mtshan ma rang sar grol ba ga dzu dha ra'i zhal snga nas/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga// sgyu ma lta bur mtshan nyid med// gang la rang bzhin med pa ni// mtshan nyid med pa'i mtshan nyid gcig /ces gsung ngo*// rdzu 'phrul gyi 'od zer can ra tri ta'i zhal snga nas/ chos rnams sgyu ma'i ngo bo la// rang bzhin yid la ma yin kyang*// lam du 'khrul pa ma bsal na// sgyu mar mthong bas grol ba min// sgyu mas sgyu ma 'ching bar 'gyur// zhes gsung ngo*// dus gsum ma dmigs pas rtog pa chad pa tha rin+dha pa'i zhal snga nas/ gcun rjes bshig pa shes rab lam// chos nyid spros bral 'char ba'i sa// rig pa sgrim glod thabs kyi mtshang*// ma rig sgom gyis gnad mi rtogs// zhes gsung ngo*//

dpal gyi bde ster ma su ka ri'i zhal snga nas/ ma gcun gnad du 'chum mi 'gyur// ma bshig rjes kyi ngos mi zin// ma bsgrims log shes tshar mi chod// ma glod spros bral 'char ba'i lam// zhes gsung ngo*// rtsa ba gzhi med du mthong bas gnyis 'dzin grol ba ga ga dha ra'i zhal snga nas/ chos rnams ming du shes par gyis// de yis bden par 'dzin pa grol// gnas lugs gzhi med mthong bar gyis// 'di yis zag pa'i zug rngu grol// zhes gsung ngo*// dpal gyi sgron ma ka na li'i zhal snga nas/ 'khor ba'i rang mtshang mthong bar gyis// de yis myang 'das 'dod pa grol// dran rig ye shes ngo bor mthong*// 'di yis sangs rgyas sgrub blo 'jig /ces gsung ngo*// 'dod pa yid la zhig pas zag med kyi bde ba 'bar ba shrī sūr+ya'i zhal snga nas/ ji ltar til gyi 'bru gu la// mar gyis khyab par gnas mod kyang*// skam la ma gcun khu ba med// ting gyis mar gyi don mi nus// zhes gsung ngo*// bum 'dzin ma dha na ru'i zhal snga nas/ rigs drug 'khor ba'i sems can la// bder gshegs snying po yod gyur kyang*// ma bsgrubs grol ba 'thob mi 'gyur// zhes gsung ngo*//

rnam rtog gzhi med du mthong bas gnyen po'i bya ra las grol ba su ka de wa'i zhal snga nas/ rig pa mdung khyer sgom gyi gnad// ma bsgoms shes pa gnyug ma'i ngang*// bsgoms dang ma bsgom gnyis med pas// shes pa zung 'jug ngo mtshar che// zhes gsung ngo*// bde ba'i mdangs ldan ma a bha ra dha'i zhal snga nas/ shes pa mtha' bral lta ba'i gnad// tha mal shes pa blo rtog bral// ma bcos pa ni chos kyi sku// sgrub blo zhig pa ngo mtshar che// zhes gsung ngo*// lam la gang phan grogs su ston shes pas snang ba dpe char shar ba bha na sūr+ya'i zhal snga nas/ ji ltar sol ba'i sdong po la// lo 'bras me tog mi 'byung ltar// de bzhin dad pa med pa la// yon tan nor bu 'byung mi 'gyur// zhes gsung ngo*// ye shes spyan ldan ras ma dha na'i zhal snga nas/ mngal du 'phyes pa'i glang po yis// 'dam bu'i tshal du mi rtol ltar// rang bzhin brtson 'grus mi ldan pas// thar pa'i grong khyer phyin mi 'gyur// zhes gsung ngo*// seng ge'i lta stangs las rig pa dwangs pa da ra tsa li'i zhal snga nas/ ji ltar rmi lam sgyu ma bzhin// kun rdzob snang ba'i rang bzhin stong*// dri za'i grong khyer ji bzhin du// skye dang gnas pa de bzhin no// zhes gsung ngo*// lha'i mdangs 'phrog ma ma ni la'i zhal snga nas/ 'di dag yang dag ma yin pas// khams gsum ngo bos rnam par dben// chos rnams don du ma grub pas// rang bzhin dag pa ngo mtshar che// zhes gsung ngo*// dran pa'i rtsal las ngo bo skyes pa tsaṇ+ḍa li'i zhal snga nas/ chos rnams rang bzhin rnam par dag /rgyu med 'khor ba mthong mi 'gyur// ma mthong mya ngan 'das pa'i gnad// de rtogs nas ni grol ba thob// e ma mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i gnad// ces gsung ngo*// 'bar ba'i ga tsa mo bha nu hi ri'i zhal snga nas/ blo yig mtha' bral gnyug ma'i ngang*// sgom dang bsgom bya las grol te// phyag rgya che la bsgom du med// ma byas shes pa ngar dang bcas// rig pa rten med nam mkha' 'dra// zhes gsung ngo*//

shes pa yul la ma 'phros pas rtog pa chad pa a su ra dha'i zhal snga nas/ rtogs pa mthar phyin 'bras bu'i sa// re dog gol sa dbyings su dag /don rtogs rnal 'byor nyam nga bral// 'khor ba rang grol ngo mtshar che// zhes gsung ngo*// ye shes kyi spyan ldan ma bha nu ha ri'i zhal snga nas/ bden gnyis ngo bo tha mi dad// snang stong dbyer med zung du 'jug /snang stong grol ba'i rnal 'byor pa// 'khor 'das med pa ngo mtshar che// zhes gsung ngo*// rtsa ba'i gnad kyis rang ngo brda las 'phrod pa gha tsa li pa'i zhal snga nas/ nges pa'i shes pa skyes pa la// the tshom som nyi yid gnyis bral// ye shes rgyun chad med pa la// skad cig ma yi chos mi gnas// zhes gsung ngo*// dpal gyi 'dod 'jom su ka dha na'i zhal snga nas/ bar do med pa'i chos nyid la// 'gro dang 'ong ba'i chos mi gnas// blo dang bral ba'i ye shes la// 'khrul pa'i dri ma rnam par dag /ces gsung ngo*// shes pa so la bzhag pas 'khrul pa'i snang ba la sgrog chad pa tsan+dhe ba'i zhal snga nas/ rtsi yis zin pa'i lcags bzhin du// ngo bo gser du 'gyur ba bzhin// bde gsal mi rtog pas zin pa'i// dran rig ye shes nyid du 'gyur// zhes gsung ngo*// dbyings kyi gtso mo bha ta ha'i zhal snga nas/ gang tshe gnad kyi ngo bor rig /de dus ma rig mun pa dwangs// gang du 'khrul pa'i snang ba dag /de ni sku gsum zhing zhes shes// zhes gsung ngo*// ā li kā li'i gnad kyis bka' brgyud kyi don grol ba sho po ri pa'i zhal snga nas/ gang la gter gyi khron yod na// de la chags pa'i blo 'byung gi /gter med pa la chags blo med// so bya nags kyi khrod mi bsnyag /ces gsung ngo*// rdzu 'phrul gyi rgyan dang ldan pa tha na mo'i zhal snga nas/ rtsi med sbrang ma bde bar gnas// nya btang skyar mo sems ngal sos// chog med blo ni dbul po yin// zhes gsung ngo*//

dka' thub kyi srang tshar bas 'phags pa'i brgyud pa zin pa rat+na de wa'i zhal snga na/ rgyu yi rnal 'byor rkyen las byol// lam pa'i rnal 'byor rkyen dang bral// 'bras bu'i rnal 'byor rkyen thog 'babs// rtogs pa'i rkyen du gang ma song*// zhes gsung ngo*// thugs rje'i 'od ldan ma su ri dha na'i zhal snga nas/ rgya mtsho'i nang gi sems can las// chu srin zas su ma gyur med// de bzhin brtan pa thob pa la// grogs su ma gyur gang yang med// ces gsung ngo*// 'khrul pa ngos zin pas tshogs drug rtogs pa'i rkyen bskul du shar ba a mo gha tsan+d+ra'i zhal snga nas/ lta med lta dang bral ba la// lta ba 'di yin ji ltar smra// gzhon nu ma yi bde ba ba bzhin// nyams myong brjod par nus ma yin// zhes gsung ngo*// bde ba'i stobs ldan ma sa na li'i zhal snga nas/ gang gis mkhur bar chu blugs nas// smra brjod nus pa ma yin no// don gyi rtsi 'thungs rnal 'byor pas// phyag rgya chen po brjod mi shes// zhes gsung ngo*// gnad kyi rang mtshang go bas rig pa'i rtsal 'byor pa su kha dzha na'i zhal snga nas/ chu rnams thams cad rgya mtsho ru// lan tshwa'i ro ru gcig pa ltar// gdams pa'i gnad kyi ngo sprod du// chos rnams don gcig go bar 'gyur// zhes gsung ngo*// sems la dbang thob par nu dha ra'i zhal snga nas/ mig ser gyis ni gzir ba'i mis// sa gzhi gser du mthong ba bzhin// de ltar don gyi rtsi 'thungs pas// cir snang gdams par mthong bar 'gyur// zhes gsung ngo*// ye shes bshig rjes la ngos zin pa bi ma de wa'i zhal snga nas/ skyes bu bdud kyis khyer ba ni// de tshe bdag bstod gzhan la smod// rmongs pa'i grub mtha' mngon zhen can// 'di ni lta ba'i bdud yin no// zhes gsung ngo*// dpa' mo khyung bya'i ldem ru can ba li ba da'i zhal snga nas/ mkhas pas khas len spang bar bya// thos pas rang rgyud dul ba yi// 'di yis yon tan dgos pa stor// rig byed mthar phyin zhi zhing dul// zhes gsung ngo*//

sna rtser yid bcings pas 'gyu ba srang du chud pa ra nu tsan+da'i zhal snga nas/ ji ltar yol bas bcad pa'i rgyab// bum pa la sogs mi mngon bzhin// de ltar 'dod pa'i mig btsums pas// zag pa phyi ru mthong mi 'gyur// zhes gsung ngo*// yid 'phrog rma bya'i ldem du can bha ga su na'i zhal snga nas/ gang du gnyis 'dzin grol ba'i tshe// de dus 'khrul pa rang sar dag /chos nyid snang ba rang shar la// bden pa mthong zhes rab tu brjod// ces gsung ngo*// ngo sprod gnad la phog pas phyag rgya chen po thog babs su shar ba mo ci ra de wa mo li'i zhal snga nas/ blo mtha' ma mthong lta ba ni// shes bya mu las grol bas zhig /snang stong rkyen dang bral ba las// skye ba med pa'i phyag rgya bcing*// zhes gsung ngo*// bde ldan ma dung gi thor cog can pa ta mi'i zhal snga nas/ 'dzin blo thong la rtog pa chod// chos rnams gzhi ru mnyam pa la// brgyad dang bral ba rnal 'byor yin// ye shes sku ni las las grol// zhes gsung ngo*// ngo sprod gcig gi thog tu chos rnams kun gyi don rig pa gha ju de wa'i zhal snga nas/ ji ltar dbang po dwangs pa'i mig /long na gzugs rnams mi mthong bzhin// de ltar 'dod pa'i blo med na// sgrib pas mthong bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsung ngo*// gtum mo 'brug gi slag pa can bi ta la'i zhal snga nas/ gang zhig gzugs med bar du ni// de la grib ma 'ong ba bzhin// de ltar 'dod pa'i blo yod phyir// sgrib pa spang bar 'gyur ma yin// grogs dag 'dod pa'i blo dang phrol/ zhes gsung ngo*// nyams kyi man ngag mar me gcig nas gcig tu spel ba'i lugs/ de kho na nyid rnal du mtshon pa las/ bdud rtsi'i char rnam par dbab pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste// dgu pa'o/// / rgyal sras mi'i seng ge dam pa rgya gar rin po che'i zhal snga nas rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'i/ phyag rgya chen po dum bu khrigs// tshig tu nyung la don du 'dril// nyams myong skyes pa rdo rje'i mgur// ma rig mun sel sgron me 'di// skal ldan mig gi dbang po yis// blta bas mi ngoms blos mi 'khyud// sgro 'dogs bklags pa tsam gyis chod// o ma ngo re mtshar rdzogs so/// /sems can thams cad kyi don du gyur cig

/dge'o// ༄༅// phyag rgya chen po rdo rje'i glu rin po che gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'khyor pa dang paṇ+ḍi ta mang pos gsung pa rnams rje btsun mnga' bdag mai tri pas gzhung gcig tu bsdebs pa'i gdams pa bzhugs so// mnga' bdag mai tri pas gzhung gcig tu bsdebs/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ma hā mu dra ka na ka mā le nā ma/ bod skad du/ phyag rgya chen po gser phreng zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ljon shing me tog 'dab rgyas 'bras bu mngar mang zhing*// chos ldan rgyal po stong gsum zhing 'dul rgyan gyis mdzes// nam mkha' nyi zla'i gar dang rgyu skar gar dang bcas// klu rgyal spyi bor nor bu rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// mdzes ldan yid 'phrog skyes bu mu tig phra yis spras// mtshan ldan sangs rgyas lha mi 'khor gyi tshogs na gsal// nor bu rin chen yon tan mang ldan yang*// ded dpon dang bral rgya mtshor bgrod mi nus// thos mang sde snod yon tan kun ldan yang*// byin rlabs dang bral skye med don mi rtogs// dbyar gyi dus na sngo rnams skye 'gyur yang*// zhing la ma btab lo tog 'byung min ltar// 'gro drug sems can sangs rgyas rang bzhin yang*// ma bsgom rnam grol ye shes don mi mthong*// mig yor the tshom lam gyi 'grul chad de// 'dod pa'i yul du phyin par 'gyur min ltar// yid ches ma gyur the tshom blo can gyis// bde chen byang chub go 'phang rnyed mi 'gyur// sgom dang mi sgom rtog pa blo yi yul// sgom min snyam bral yengs su med pa'i sa// yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po'i lam// kye hoḥbya bral skye med blo las 'das// gsal stong 'od rig chos nyid ye shes sgron// bde stong zag med bde chen rgyal po la// snang stong rtog med chos nyid spyan pa yis// e ma ngo mtshar chos nyid bden pa mthong*// sgyu ma 'od gsal chos skur 'od drang zhing*// sgyu lus 'od gsal chos sku'i snang ba zung*// gnyis med lhan skyes chos nyid mjal 'phrad kyis// kye ma bla ma sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas// nā ga sa ra tsar ya pa// sa wa sa ra ka ma ya/

shān+ti bhu su bi rū pa// de ki u na mi na pa// pu dh+ri tsa dra bha dra pa// ār+ya me ka ka ru pa// ra pi di to kon+dha li// bha ga ba ra ni lo pa'i// kaṃ ka ko ki a na ha// tsadha sarba ko ta li// bha de ka na kam+bha li// ḍom+bhi he ru dā ri ka /kṛṣ+ṇa nā ga pra bhā ka /ku ku tsa nu ghaṇ+ḍa pa// gang gis ma rtogs rtogs pa'i spyod pa mi bya ste// byas na rgyal po'i khrims la dmangs kyis gnod pa bzhin// rtogs pa rnams kyis ma rtogs spyod pa mi bya ste// byas na glang chen brtan pa 'dam du tshud pa bzhin// kye hoḥgrogs dag lhan cig skyes pa de// gzhan nas mi rnyed bla ma'i zhal la dris// don dam zhal gyi ngo bo de rtogs na// yid ni 'chi med rlung yang chad pa med// chos nyid 'od gsal bde chen gyi// zag med mya ngan 'das kyi sku// gang gis ma rtogs rtog med lam// bstan par mi nus snying po'i mchog /bdag lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la// thar lam srog gcod phyi nang gi /rdul med rdul tshon la sogs kyi// dkyil 'khor 'bad rtsol ci yang med// bde stong gnyis med nyams myong bla ma yi// byin rlabs sgron ma chos nyid rang byung la// ma rtogs mi rtogs bsgom du med pa la// 'di dang 'di zhes smra med lkugs par spyod// gang nas ma 'ongs gar yang ni// mi 'gro skye med gnyug ma'i lam// chos nyid byang chub chos sku yi// nyi ma ma rig mun dang bral// rus sbal lta bur 'khor ba yi// skyon gyis ma gos gdod nas dag /sgron ma mun bral bla ma yi// drin gyis ye shes nyi ma 'di// ma blta bltas pas mthong ba med// ma rtogs rtog dpyod yul min gyi// ma sems bsam du cir yang med// ma re re dog yul las 'das// bltas pas mthong ba'i yul min phyir// sgom pa bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis// chos nyid don mthong cir yang ni// mi sems ngos gzung med par grol// bya ba btang ba'i skyes bu la// bya bral byar med gzung 'dzin med// re dog dang bral nyams len la// mi rtog bsgom du cir yang med// e ma ngo mtshar chos nyid bden pa mthong*// e ma byin rlabs nyams myong sgron ma 'bar// e ma bla mar dad gus yengs pa med// e ma 'bras bu rang gsal byin rlabs gsal// rang rig gdod ma ma skyes pa// stong pa ma bcos lhun gyis grub// sems nyid rang rig rang gsal gyi// nor bu gsal dwangs go ma 'gags// sgom dang mi sgom rtog bcas kyi// rang bzhin 'od gsal rnyed mi 'gyur// bsgom med yengs su med pa la// ma bcos yengs med lhug pa nyid// rang rig lhan cig skyes pa yi// chos nyid bde chen smra med la// bdag gzhan bde sdug blo las 'das// chos nyid bden mthong chos sku'i klong*// rang rig rang gis rtogs pa la// chu khams gser dang nam mkha' bzhin// sangs rgyas sems can 'khor 'das dag

/spang blang tha dad cir yang med// drug gsum rang grol chos kyi sgron ma yi// rtsa rlung bde stong gnyis su med pa la// tha mal rnam rtog dngos por 'dzin pa yi// chags sdang mdud pa rang sar gzung 'dzin grol// ye shes lus can chos nyid gsal dwangs la// mtha' bral rten med dmigs su med pa'i phyir// 'khrul dang ma 'khrul 'khrul gzhi 'khrul pa yi// rtsa ba skye med bya bral ngang du chad// 'ja' tshon lta bu sgyu ma'i sku// dam tshig phyag rgya zhen med kyi// dbang po rang snang thug phrad kyis// chos nyid bden pa mthong ba yin// zag med bde chen chos nyid nyi ma yi// las kyi phyag rgya chos nyid ye shes sgron// skye med byang chub kun rtog bral ba yis// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bde chen klong du sang*// bdag lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong ni// phyag rgya rtsa rlung byang chub sems// gnyug ma dmigs su cir yang med// sems nyid bde stong chos nyid kyi// don rtogs phyag rgya chen po'i lam// dmigs bya dmigs byed dmigs med la// cir yang bsam du med pa nyid// bdag med seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa'i// stong nyid ting 'dzin sgron ma yis// bde sdug rtag chad la sogs kyi// sgrib pa ma lus sel bar byed// dge dang mi dge'i las rnams ni// 'dzin med gnyug ma'i ngang du yal// chos nyid bde ba chen po'i sku// rang rig gnyis med ngang du 'phrod// pi wang sgra bzhin dam tshig gi /sgron ma bral na bde med phyir// dam tshig nyi ma ye shes kyis// nyi ma chos nyid nyi mar mthong*// dbang bzhi bgrod pas lam bzhi mthong*// sku bzhi phyag rgya bzhi ru grol// thabs ldan zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku// bdag lus rgyal ba'i ngang du rdzogs// bag chags ye shes rang grol la// rtag chad spang blang sgro skur cir yang med// gdod nas dag pa chos nyid gnyug ma la// sgrib byed bying rgod re dog cir yang med// bsam gyis mi khyab rang rig 'od gsal la// dran pas gzung dang gzung 'dzin cir yang med// nyon mongs rang dwangs rnam rtog chos sku la// dus gsum sangs rgyas btsal du cir yang med// gser 'gyur rtsi ltar khams gsum nyid// bde chen chos nyid ros gang ba// don dam 'khor ba kun rdzob dag

/mtha' bral chos nyid dbu ma'i lam// gtsang dang mi gtsang rtog pa yi// sme sha gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i chos// 'khrul pas bde chen mthong ba med// ma mthong rnal 'byor de mi rnyed// tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad// tshogs drug dag na bde ba rgyun mi 'chad// brtags pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu// bsgom du med pas gnyug ma'i ngang la zhog /phyag rgya chen po rang la lhun gyis grub pa ste// mi bsam mi rig 'bad pa med pa'i ngang la zhog /chad pa med de mngon du nyams myong rang gis myong*// rtag par mi 'gyur mngon zhen med par zung du 'jug /shing rta'i 'khor lo gnyis dang mi ldan gar yang 'gro bar mi nus ltar// sbyin sogs 'bad pa byas kyang bla mar mi ldan dngos grub dam pa min// bya rgod rtsal rdzogs 'dab mar bcas pa dag gis nam mkha' gcod cing rgyu// skal bzang rnams ni dbang dang byin rlabs gdams pa khong du chud pas bde// rgya mtsho zab cing rgya che dag gi nang na nor bus gang ba la// klu yi rgyal po rnams kyis mnga' mdzad gang yin de ni ngo mtshar che// snang grag thams cad ye nas chos sku 'gyur med yin pa la// rtogs dang nyams myong ldan pa'i rnal 'byor rnams kyis longs spyod ngo mtshar che// gser 'gyur rtsi yi nus pa yis// lcags rnams gser du bsgyur ba ltar// rin chen dbang gi nus pa yis// nyon mongs ye shes gnyis med bsgyur// rtogs pa yid bzhin nor bu la// nyams su myong ba'i mdog phyung bas// spyod pa'i nus pas dgos 'dod 'byung*// ro snyoms ldan pa rnams kyis 'grub// rang la bde chen yod kyang ma rtogs 'khrul pas bsgribs// de bsal 'dod pas bsod nams ye shes tshogs gsag bya// tshogs gnyis ma bsags bskal pa brgya ru 'bad byas kyang*// bla mar mi ldan bde ba chen po rtogs mi 'gyur// dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo gcig

/de yi rang bzhin rang gi sems// rtogs par 'dod na ji bzhin zhog /goms par byas na mngon sum 'gyur// bla ma dag las dang por rang gi sems rtogs bya// de nas chos rnams kun dang tha dad med byas la// gnyis med rtogs shing dur khrod gnas su 'dug nas ni// nyams rtogs smyon pa'i brtul zhugs ngang gis spyad// rta dang glang po rgya mtsho 'dra na mnyam nyid bde// spre'us chu yi ri mo bris pa 'dra na spros par 'gyur// chu bo nyi ma sman dang 'dra na dbyer mi phyed// gtsug phud dmigs dang 'khor los sgyur rgyal lta bu 'thob// sa la gnas pa kun kyang skal ba bzang*// rgya mtsho'i gting du phyin na dbul dang bral// ral gri lag tu thogs na longs spyod che// phyogs med sa la phyin na gnyen dang 'phrad// sems ma gdungs na lta ba che// zhen pa med na ro snyoms yin// 'bad rtsol bral na sgom pa'i mchog /gnyis snang bral na rdzogs sangs rgyas// la la ra san dhū tī gsum// rang byin rlob cing bcing bar bar bya// bla ma sems dang snang ba gsum// rtogs pa bskyed phyir bsten par bya// phyag rgya chen po gser phreng las// tshogs 'khor dang po byin rlabs shugs 'byung gi le'u ste/ dang po'o//

lā hi dz+nya lan bir+wa pa// ka ma in+d+ra kha ra bha// bi ku nā tha gho ra kha// to ka bhe ṇi bi na si// ghū na an dzo kan tha ri// bha bu ta pa bo te le// o tra sa ga ni dra ya// kaṃ ka sa na ga na si// tsa pa su ku si ya li// su ta dharma ku ru na// rā hu ku su ku ma dri// la kha dha kha pa ra pu// dho ka bi ḍa ṇe ra pa// tsa ma dha kha snying po pa// khyi rgod mi srun sna la sbrang rtsi bskus na phyogs rnams kun tu za bar byed// blo dman skal ba med pa'i gang zag dag la gdams pa byin na rang rgyud sreg /glang chen brtan la dpa' ba'i sna la ral gri bskur na dgra dpung thams cad 'joms// skal bzang blo ldan skye med rtogs pa'i snang ba thug phrad dag gis rnam rtog 'joms// skye med rtogs kyang nyams su myong bral na// de yang srin mo'i lag na bu khyer 'dra// nyams su myong yang gnas lugs ma rtogs na// glang chen sna la lcags kyu brgyabs pa 'dra// sangs rgyas mchod sogs rnams las don mi 'byung*// 'dod dang rtsol ba yod na sangs mi rgya// byin rlabs bla ma'i ngag gis nyams myong 'phel// blo yi cha la yin gyi don ma yin// gar yang ma blta dbus su ltos// mchog dang dga' bral bde ba che// sngags rig gsang ba smyon spyod nas// rnal 'byor rtags kyis bsgyur bar bya// dus kyi sna rtse bdag byin rlabs dang mi ldan na// phyi dang nang gi spyod pa dag gis sangs mi rgya// bde ba rab rgyas snang ba dag dang khyad med na// zhen pa btang bas nyams su myong ba mchog 'thob 'gyur// rje btsun dam pa bsten na de nyid mthong*// nags tshal mthongs su bsgoms na dben pa 'thob// chos rnams sems su rtogs na mi mthun med// nam mkha'i 'o ma 'thungs na tshim par 'gyur// bde dang stong pa mtha' bral nyid rtogs na// dpag bsam shing brten pa yis mnyan byas te// mtsho la skyes bu rkyal bas 'gror shes na// bram ze pha dang ma las bur skye 'gyur// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis// gzung 'dzin chags sdang rang sar chad// rmi lam sgyu 'dra zhen med kyis// nyams myong gsal stong go ma 'gags// gsal lo gsal lo bde chen gyi// bla ma byang chub lam mkhan gsal// gnyis med chos dbyings gsal dwangs kyi// nyams myong gnyug ma'i ngang du gsal// bde'o bla ma bde chen bde// bde bar mi 'dzin cir yang mi rtog bde// gzung ba rang grol 'dzin pa rang dwangs bde// bya bral skyes bu byar med blo 'das bde// stong ngo stong ngo tha mal lus// sgyu lus zhen med dbyings su stong*// zung 'jug skye med ngang du stong*// rang rig lhan skyes sku ru stong*// rig go rig go rang gi sems// cir yang mi 'dzin rtog med ri ga

/gar yang mi dpyod smra med rig /rtog dpyod yul las 'das par ra rig /mi rtog rtog med rtog dpyod yul las 'das// mi sems bsam med bsam du ci yang med// rten dang brten med 'gro 'ong gnas dang bral// 'khor 'das bde sdug bde chen klong du sad// ma bcos yengs med rang bzhin lhug pa la// sems byung rgyun chad 'od gsal 'gro 'ong bral// snang ba smra med slob dpon yengs su med// chos nyid rang gsal rig pa chos skur 'phrod// sems nyid ma mthong ci yang med// da lta bltar med bstan du med// ma yengs yengs med yengs su med// bsgom med sgom du med pa yin// bral lo bral lo 'khor 'das bral// bde chen chos nyid klong du bral// rig pa smra med ngang du grol// sgom pa zhen med dbyings su bral// bya ba byar med skam sar gnas// e ma chos nyid chos nyid mthong*// kye ma sangs rgyas kye sangs rgyas// kye hoḥbyang chub go 'phang 'thob// e ma ngo mtshar 'chi rgyu med// snang srid mi bden gdod nas rdzun// dgra zin ye med 'khrul snang yin// byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal ngang*// chags sdang bral na sangs rgyas yin// bya ba thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu// byar med bde'o rnal 'byor rtsol med bde// ci la bsams kyang dgos 'dod mi 'byung bas// bsam du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang du bde// sems nyid bde chen thig le'i sku// bde stong dbyer med sems kyi rgyan// nam mkha' lta bur brjod med kyis// chos nyid bltar med bstan du med// e ma ngo mtshar bla ma'i sku// stong nyid spros bral rtog med ngang*// snang stong dbyer med stong pa'i dbyings// chos sku skye med rgyun du ldan// snang sems sangs rgyas sems can dag /nyi ma dang ni 'od zer bzhin// spang thob las grol zhe 'dod med// gang la med pa de sangs rgyas// shes bya snang la rang bzhin bral// shes pa gsal la rtog med de// sems nyid bde chen zag med la// yengs med bsgom du ci yang med// sems nyid bla ma sangs rgyas sku// snang sems 'dus byas dge ba'i gzhi// chos sku ngan song ting 'dzin lam// nga rgyal gnyis med byang sems ldan// chos nyid ma bcos 'khor ba yi// thog mtha' re dog mnyam dang bral// bsgom bya sgom byed blang dor spang*// 'bras bu rang gsal rang rig mchog

/rang rig lhan cig skyes pa'i sku// ngo bo rig pa rang gsal gyi// 'gro drug sangs rgyas snying po la// dam tshig rtog med rgyan dang ldan// snang sems chos nyid chos kyi ni// sku can mnyam bral rtog med kyi// dag pa'i sgyu lus byang chub lam// zung 'jug skye med bde 'gro'i rgyan// snang sems rang rig bde chen spros dang bral// sgyu ma rtsa rlung rlung sems brjod du med// rmi lam 'od gsal bde chen zung 'jug la// sku bzhi ye shes gsal snang go ma 'gags// bltar med blta ru med pa yi// rang sems rnam dag bla mar snang*// snang ba stong pa bde chen sku// bde stong dbyer med byin rlabs rgyan// sems nyid bltar med blo 'das kyi// rtsa ni gsal stong mkha' 'gro'i gsang*// snang ba stong nyid bden med sku// snang stong dbyer med mkha' 'gro'i rgyan// bya bral rtog med rlung sems kyi// snang ba stong pa spros dang bral// stong nyid bde chen brjod du med// bde stong mtha' bral rlung gi rgyan// rang sems bde chen byang chub sems// zag med bde chen chos kyi sku// snang ba 'od gsal stong pa'i klong*// bde stong ye shes byang chub rgyan// snang ba rmi lam bden pas stong*// gzung 'dzin chags sdang 'khrul snang yul// brtags pa chu shing snying po med// zhen med gang snang lam gyi rgyan// gang nas ma 'ongs gar yang ni// mi 'gro mi rtog sems nyid la// bltar med bstan du med pa yi// chos nyid ngo bo mthong gi rgyan// 'khor ba sdug bsngal bde med kyang*// bla ma'i byin rlabs ngo sprad la// bying rgod sgom pa nyams kyi dgra// rang rig 'od gsal mthong gi rgyan// nyams myong bya bral blo 'das kyi// sgom pa dmigs rtog gzung 'dzin bral// cir yang rtog med lhun grub la// re dog dgag sgrub rang grol rgyan// ye shes lus can stong pa nyid// snying rje'i rgyan ldan zung 'jug lam// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med phyir// bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i sku// bde ba shugs 'byung zhen med kyi// blo 'das nyams myong gnyug ma'i klong*// sgom pa yengs su med pa yi// chos nyid ye shes rgyan ldan bde// gang yang mi rtog cir mi sems// cir yang mi 'dzin rtog dpyod bral// byar med rig pa rang gsal ba// bcas bcos mi byar rang grol rgyan// bde'o ci bder rtog med nyams// stong ngo chos nyid blo 'das ngang*// spyod do ro snyoms shugs 'byung lam// grol lo re dog rang grol rgyan// cir yang med do snang srid yul// gar yang stong ngo ngos 'dzin sems// rtog dpyod med do 'khor 'das lam// mi sgom mi dpyad gnyug ma'i rgyan// chu rgyun gnas pa'i nyams brtan na// spyod pa bags kyis 'gro bar bya// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis// chags sdang rtog pa zhi bar byed// phyag rgya chen po gser phreng las/

tshogs 'khor gnyis pa bsgom don nyams kyi le'u ste/ gnyis pa'o/// / tai lo nā ro bha su tra// gos can dhū tī ra ma ya// spyod pa ra tri mai tri pa// bho ta legs sbyin pad+mo'i zhabs// badz+ra dharma jo ki ni// kah+ṇa me kha ma hā la// ri ri rang ga ka sa ri// 'bar ba tsin+dha bi rū pa// dz+nya na badz+ra me dha pa// ḍom+bi bha ta ri bo pa// ka ma kri ta pra dzha ru// badz+ra ka na na ma se// ho ra si ti ka ra na// bhū ti ma ta bra ma na// ri rab gser gyi ngos la bya gnas pa// bya yi rang bzhin bor nas gser du snang*// mkhas pa dag gis skye ba med rtogs nas// dngos po'i rang bzhin bor na bde ba che// bdag nyid gdod ma nyid nas sangs rgyas yin pa la// rnam rtog dbang gis sangs rgyas nyid ni ngas ma mthong*// rtogs pa'i dus na mthong ba med cing thos pa med// gnyis med gang gis rtogs pa de ni phyag rgya che// byis pa chung ngu ma yis gsos pas stobs dang ldan pa bzhin// blo chung dag kyang bla ma'i gdams pas rim gyis theg pa che// rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i nad kun sman gyi nus pas sel ba ltar// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i nad rabs thams cad bla ma'i gdams pas sa sreg /long ba'i tshogs kun mig ldan gyi// skyes bus 'khrid par byed pa ltar// ye shes lam stor bla ma yi// spyan pas byang chub 'khrid par byed// 'khor los sgyur rgyal dpung gi tshogs// gling rnams kun la dbang byed bzhin// lhan cig skyes pa'i ro rnyed nas// 'khor bar dbang sgyur bde ba che// rigs ldan rigs mchog rigs kyi dbang*// bla ma mkha' 'gro chos nyid grogs// lta spyod sgom don lhan cig skyes// dpe don ye shes bden pa mthong*// las can rnal 'byor dbang gi lam// sku gsum chos nyid 'od gsal me// sems nyid gsal dwangs sgyu ma'i sku// rnam grol phyag rgya zung du 'jug

/'gro drug skyes pa sdom gsum rgyan// lta sgom spyod pa zhen med skas// rang las bde chen ngo bor rig /dgag sgrub spang blang nyams dang bral// re dog rang gsal bla ma'i drin// bdag ma rtogs pa'i gong na 'bras chan dag dang ro 'di khyad par che// rtogs nas mngar ba'i 'bras chan dag dang rul ba'i ro 'di khyad par med// de bzhin ma rtogs dus na 'khor ba dag dang sangs rgyas tha dad brtags// rtogs pa'i dus na 'khor ba dag ni ye nas sangs rgyas chen po'i sku// bya ba btang na man ngag yin// zhe 'dod med na rtogs pa yin// bde ba dngos med sgom pa yin// bsgrub bya med na spyod pa yin// thabs dang shes rab a dzan lta// bla ma chu yi rgyun gyis rab tu khyab// lhan cig skyes pa'i dpag bsam shing dag la// 'bras bu lhun grub ngang la rab tu rdzogs// sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa'i mchog /rang yid rtog la mi gnas pas// gnyug ma'i sems kyis gang rtogs pa// sangs rgyas thams cad des mthong yin// rnal 'byor pa yis gang thos thams cad dam pa ste// mthong ba de yis skye med rtogs phyir slob dpon mchog /byas pa kun gyis gnyis med gsal phyir thabs yin te// dge sdig 'bras bu skyes bu de la gnyis mi 'gyur// gang nas bla ma dam pa las// dbang las lhan cig skyes pa yi// ro yis kun la khyab pa ste// skye med rgyas thebs rdo rje 'dzin// bde dang stong pa dbyer med snying gi pad+ma dag la rdzogs// skye med yid la byed pa bsam gyis mi khyab bde chen sems// snang grag thams cad ro snyoms rnam gsum rnal 'byor rnams kyis spyod// rje btsun dag gi byin rlabs shar bas dbyer med rdzogs sangs rgyas// chos rnams kun dang rang gi sems rnams du mar dpyod// rtogs pa thams cad nyams myong gdams pa dang bral na// nor bu mching bu dag la rang bzhin du bde na// chos rnams de dang ldan na re dog med pas rang bde zhig

/dang por blo ldan rtogs pa bskyed// gnyis pa nags su sna rtse bsgom// nyams su myong ba skyes pa na// spyod pas khyad par 'gro bar bya// gang gang lhan cig skyes pa de// glang po che yi mig bzhin du// gze rer bskyed na zug rngu 'byung*// glod na zhen med bsam gtan mchog /bde'o bde'o gnas med bde// 'dod pa med pa'i rang bzhin bde// brtags pa thams cad der shes bde// sgrub pa med pa'i sangs rgyas bde// go cha chen po bgos nas kyang*// nor bu lta bu'i snying stobs kyi// rang gi sems la gru btang na// mi ro'i khog par bde chen zhugs// gang gis gang du gang la ni// rtog cing dpyod pa'i blo las ni// dngos 'dzin gdon gyi dbang song phyir// cir yang mi 'dzin blo gros mchog /snang ba chos nyid nyi ma la// gzung 'dzin khri mon smag tu tshud// sems nyid 'od gsal chos sku nyid// ma rig mun pa'i drwa bas btums// gnyis med bde chen bla ma'i drin// shugs 'byung zhen bral nyams kyi klong*// rang grol rang bzhin spyod pa'i 'gros// re dog las grol chos kyi sku// skye med kun rtog spangs pa yis// byang chub lam chen rtog dang bral// mi rtog 'dzin med blo las 'das// gang du btsal yang rtog med ngang*// rang bzhin dri med thabs dang shes rab kyis// rang bzhin sems gang las ni sangs rgyas kyi// yon tan rin chen rin thang med kyi mdzod// dam chos nyi ma bla ma'i drin gyis ltos// 'khrul bcas bden las 'das pa yi// nyon mongs 'ching ba gcod mdzad kyi// chos nyid bden par mnga' brnyes pa'i// bshes gnyen skye med 'od gsal mthong*// shes rab mig bral dngos po yi// gdon 'joms bdag gzhan bde chen sku// cir yang rtog med bya bral gyi// nyams myong ye shes sgron ma gsal// gang gis dngos dang dngos med du// 'dzin de mar me lta bu ru// blo yi yul min spang dka'i phyir// blo 'das bcas bcos rgya mdud shigs// thabs bral shes rab sgron ma nyid// nam mkha'i me tog shes rab lam// ri bong rwa ltar don med kyi// spang bya mthar 'dzin blo dang bral// gang gis gnyis med don rtogs na// chos nyid ma mthong chos sku yi// chos nyid nyi ma yengs su med// de nyid phyag rgya chen po yin// shes dang shes bya las grol gyi// 'khor 'das stong nyid 'od gsal ba// bltar med bstan du med pa yi// blo 'das shes rab sgron ma nyid// snying rje rgyun ldan gru gzings kyis// 'gro rnams 'khor ba bzod med kyis// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho chen po las// ma lus sgrol mdzad thabs kyi skas// snang sems gnyis med thabs dang ni// shes rab dbyer med byang chub lam// chu dang 'o ma lta bu ru// ro mnyam nyams myong dbyer mi phyed// yod med gzung 'dzin mtshan nyid dang*// mtshon bya rang bzhin dri med kyi// gnyis med ye shes chos nyid sgron// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang*// 'gro rnams bde sdug skyon yon gzhi// nam mkha' la ni sprin bzhin du// ma lus sems can thams cad la// yid bzhin nor bu lta bur gnas// dgag sgrub re dog las grol gyi// nyams myong bltar med bstan du med// yang dag don gyi de nyid la// yang dag don mthong rnam par grol// rigs drug sdug bsngal sems kyis ni// snang ba nyams myong bde chen la// snang ba mthun snang med pa ru// bla ma'i drin mthong rnam par grol// don chen nyi ma byang chub kyi// chos nyid ye shes spyan pa yis// nyams myong sgron ma thams cad kyi// bde chen smra med don mthong bde// kun rtog 'ching ba gcod mdzad kyi// bla ma'i drin thob zhen med nyams// gang gis bya ra mi byed par// gnas pas 'khor bar bde mi rnyed// sgra don 'bral med thos dang ni// shes rab yul las 'das pa'i phyir// bla ma'i drin gyis sems dang ni// nor bu rin chen yon tan ldan// dad gus yengs med dam tshig gi

/sgron ma bdag lus rgyal ba'i mdzod// bde chen yon tan 'byung gi gnas// bltar med don mthong ngo mtshar che// gang nas ma 'ongs gar yang ni// 'gro 'ong las grol gnyug ma yi// nyams myong smra med yengs su med// sgom pa 'bral med blo las 'das// chos nyid 'od gsal dag pa'i sems// byang chub gsal snang chos kyi dbyings// bde chen ye shes sku can gyi// sems kyi nor bu dri med rnyed// ma brtas bde chen mthong du med// ma rtog nyams myong blo las 'das// ma sems rtogs pa chos nyid klong*// cir yang byar bral yengs su med// de ring mchog la gnas pa'i nyams myong rin po che// brtag pa ma yin gnyug ma yengs su med pa'i ngang*// yengs med gzugs kyi bdag 'dzin dngos po 'joms mdzad pa'i// gnas lugs dge sdig spang blang ci yang bsam du med// dmigs med yid la mi byed dran pa yi// kun rtog 'ching ba gcod mdzad ye shes sgron// rgyu ba chos nyid chos sku'i klong du chad// ma bsgoms dmus long mthong ba'i yul min phyir// bsgoms pas bdud rtsi'i ro tshor bla ma'i drin// byin rlabs brgyud pa gnyug ma'i nyams myong la// bde ba'i ro tshor ngos gzung ci yang med// 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// rtog med rtog dpyod yul las 'das// sgom dang bsgom pa cir yang med// mi 'dzin 'dzin rtog 'khrul pa spang*// chos kyi spyan can chos kyi ni// sku can chos kyi sgron ma yin// tshogs gnyis chos kyi rnga bo che// byang chub lam chen chos kyi dung*// bdag med 'od gsal sgra sgrogs dung*// nor bu rin chen 'dod 'jo'i ba// 'chi med bdud rtsi bcud kyis len// ljon shing me tog 'bras ldan gyi// rgya mtsho ri rab bum pa bzang*// nam mkha' nyi zla glu gar rtse// mngon sum dang ni rjes dpag shes// brtags pa don shes don mthong gi /yid ches nges dang bcas pa yis// sngar 'dris ma bu dam tshig mjal// chos dang chos min mnyam nyid las// tha dad 'gro rnams rdzun blo yis// thar pa'i srog gcod tshe 'di yi// rnam rtog thar med chu srin kha// snying rje dang ni stong pa nyid// ya bral tha dad don mi mthong*// stong dang snying rje dbyer med lam// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das mi gnas// zhen pa'i blo can rtog pa yis// yul gyi rgya mdud su mi 'dod// 'dod yon lhan cig skyes pa yi// bde ba'i ros gang skye med lam// rang bzhin dge ba'i sems nyid ni// gnyug ma'i bde chen mngon sum gyi/

lhan skyes ro tshor brjod med na// rtags kyis de nyid don mi rnyed// bde chen 'khor 'das rtog pa yi// blo can rmongs rnams 'ching ba'i phyir// gang dang gang du bltar gyur kyang*// de nyid blo yi yul las 'das// rang rig bde chen mtshon du med pa'i lam// lhan cig skyes pa'i yid can gnyug ma'i ro// bla ma'i dri rtogs skye med bsgoms pa yi// nyams las don mthong skye med ngo mtshar che// 'gro rnams 'ching byed las las ni// rnam grol don shes rang rig gi /sems rtogs mya ngan 'das kyi mchog /de nyid spros pa'i yul dang bral// sems nyid nor bu rin chen mdzod// 'khor 'das srid zhi mya ngan 'das// dge sdig sa bon bag chags rtsa// thar lam byang chub rnyed kyi sku// rang sems chos nyid nam mkha' yi// klong du grol na 'gro rnams kun// rnam dag ye shes nyi ma ste// rnam grol byang chub gzhan 'ga' med// 'khor rnams bde chen ros gang yang*// thabs bral de nyid don mi mthong*// thabs ldan bya bral skyes bu la// 'chi med 'gro 'ong yul las 'das// gang gang 'dzin de dngos po yi// gdon gyi dbang gyur rmongs rnams la// 'ching las thar lam med pa'i phyir// thar pa'i lam ston 'dzin med ltos// rlung gi rtar zhon rtog bcas yid kyi bu// gzung 'dzin sbrang ma 'dod yon rjes su snyegs// gang snyegs bde med 'khor ba'i rgyu 'grul gcad// ye shes byang chub rtsa rlung chos nyid zung*// gang gang rig 'dzin rtog pa yi// dbang song 'dod yon ltad mo nyid// bdag gzhan ltos med mthong ba las// rang rgyud ma mthong 'dod mi tshim// dngos med dngos dang bral ba yi// chos rnams dngos dang dngos min phyir// gang dang gang du 'dzin de nyid// blo yi yul yin 'dzin rtog phyir// stong dang stong nyid 'bras bu rung*// dngos por 'dzin pa'i gdon chen gyis// gzhan dbang bran ltar ma bkol na// gang la gnas pa de mi mthong*// mos pa'i blor ldan gus pa'i blo gros mchog

/las kyis mtshams sbyor bag chags rtsa ba can// yid kyi lus can chos nyid don mthong gis// gzhan don nor bu dpag bsam shing ltar mthong*// ting 'dzin bying rgod las grol rtog pa yi// rlung gis mi bskyod rtog med chos kyi ni// sku can bla ma chos nyid chos sku yi// ri bo nyi ma ma rig mun bral mdzod// 'gro la brtse ba'i blo can thugs rje yi// rgya mtsho mi g.yo dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag thugs kyi dkor mdzod nas// ye shes sgron ma byang chub lam mkhan mdzod// me tog 'bras ldan 'gyur med dpag bsam shing*// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i ros gang ku sā li// bdag med bde chen spros bral rtsed mo yis// 'gyur med don ston dngos po'i gdon 'joms mdzod// skye med 'od gsal stong nyid 'od 'phro ba'i// nor bu rin chen yon tan kun ldan gyi// dpal ldan dpal gyi 'byung gnas ā tsār+ya// gnyis med spros bral stong nyid sgra sgrogs mdzod// bde chen bde ba'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang*// mi 'jigs seng ge 'jigs bral ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta// bung bas me tog bcud ldan sbrang rtsi len bzhin du// rang bzhin rtog med blo 'das sgron ma'i don ston mdzod// bsod nams mchog gis brgyan pa yi// nam mkha'i yon tan mi zad gter// sangs rgyas ye shes dharma bzhi// dhā tu byang chub chos thob mdzod// skye med blor ldan nam mkha' lta bu yi// chos rnams stong nyid 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// mtha' bral bdag med spros bral chos sku yi// tshogs ldan nyi mas ye shes don rtogs shog /rang bzhin lhan skyes 'gro rnams lhan cig skyes kyi sku// chos rnams rnam dag mya ngan 'das kyi dbyings// rnam rtog dang bral tshogs gnyis lhun grub sangs rgyas spyan// tshogs rje tshogs kyi bdag po chos nyid don mthong shog /sangs rgyas kun sdom bcom ldan mkha' 'gro ma yi sdom// bde ba'i 'byung gnas bde chen nyi ma bde ba kun gyi dpal// bla ma'i gsang mdzod gdams ngag snying po'i don gyi gsang ldan mdzod// bde chen bdag med bde ba chen po'i tshogs dang ldan gyur cig

/srid dang zhi ba rnam dag ni// ro mnyam dkyil 'khor ldan gyi gtso// tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshogs kyi mchog /tshogs rje tshogs bdag dpal ldan shog /gnyis med 'dzin dang bral ba yi// chos rnams dngos med stong pa nyid// chos nyid 'od gsal tshogs kyi ni// 'khor lo byang chub don mthong shog /bsgom bya sgom byed dmigs pa yi// kun rtog 'ching ba gcod mdzad kyi// tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshogs kyis ni// byams mgon rgyun dang ldan par shog /zhi ba'i blo gros bdag med mya ngan 'das kyi dbyings// ji srid bde chen byang chub mchog gi sems// snying rje'i rgyun ldan gsang sngags snying po'i don gyi bcud// sgyu ma byang chub lam chen sangs rgyas byang chub 'od// dngos dang dngos med brtan g.yo gnyis dang gnyis 'dzin gyis// lam stor khyab bdag bcom ldan mi yi seng ge ni// sangs rgyas grong khyer tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i grong mchog tu// byang chub sgron ma ye shes sgron ma'i 'od ldan zhing*// sems can rnam dag gdod nas sangs rgyas rang bzhin yang*// rigs drug rmongs rnams ma rig mun pa'i sprin tshogs kyis// yang dag lam bral bder gshegs nyi ma nub rnams la// tshogs kyi 'khor lo ye shes 'od 'bar me bo che// chos rnams rang bzhin spros bral mya ngan las 'das pa'i// chos nyid bde chen byang chub lam gyi rtsa ba can// gnyis med 'od gsal ma nyams zag med myang 'das kyi// bder spyod 'gro mgon thugs kyis 'dzin par shog /ma rig mun bsal ye shes nyi ma'i byang chub 'od// dpal ldan chos kyi byang chub chos kyi sgron ma yi// ye shes byang chub bshes gnyen ād+ma ta kṛ ta ni// chos kyi blo gros chos nyid gzungs kyis 'dzin par shog /dge ba'i blo can yon tan kun gyi gnyen gcig pu// thugs rje'i rtsa brtan mi yi seng ge byams pa yi// ljon shing bshes gnyen nor bu rin po che// mi zad gter chen grib mas skyong bar shog

/dpal ldan 'jig rten srid gsum yon tan kun gyi gtso// mi mchog rgyal po lha dang lha min kun gyi ni// gtsug gi nor bu yon tan kun ldan dam pa'i rje// zhing skyes nor bu rin chen rgyan dang ldan par shog /rnam rtog las grol bcom ldan lhun grub chos kyi ni// sman pa nyon mongs zug rngu 'byin mdzad 'gro ba yi// mgon gyur rje btsun las can las las grub pa yi// las kyi nyon mongs zug rngu mi bzad dbyung du gsol// bder gshegs nyi ma chos nyid chos kyi spyan can gyi// zla ba'i 'od zer dri med shel sgong dwangs gsal gyi// bla ma'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'chi med sgron ma yis// sngags skyes 'khor ba'i dri ma ma lus dag par mdzod// dpa' khyod thugs rjes 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus sel mdzad sgron ma'i pha// dpal ldan dri med thabs dang shes rab bdag gzhan phan pa'i rgyur gyur pa// brgyud ldan bla ma mtshungs med dpa' bo yon tan kun gyi gter gyur pa// srid mtsho las sgrol 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rgyun gcod dpa' chen rol mdzad pa// dpal ldan rgyal ba'i tshogs kyi mchod pa chos kyi spyan dang ldan pa'i bu// tshogs rje tshogs kyi mchod pas srid mtsho ma lus skem byed bu// bder gshegs mchod pa dpag bsam shing chen yon tan kun gyi rgyan lta bu// mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig sangs rgyas thams cad skye med tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bu// ma ma ma gcig bcom ldan yum gyur tshogs kyi 'khor lo bde chen ma// gnyis med byang chub lam mkhan tshogs 'khor bdag med chos kyi spyan can ma// gang zhig gang gi drin gyis bdag blo'i pad+mo kha 'byed nyi ma'i 'od// mthong thos dran gyi sgron ma ma rig mun sel ye shes byang chub sgron// rnal 'byor nyams myong mkhas pa rtogs tshad spel legs mu tig rin chen phreng*// 'gro drug nor bu rin chen yon tan med kyi dus// bder gshegs chos kyi spyan mnga' sangs rgyas sras po yon tan rin chen gdung brgyud ldan// yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po byang chub lam gyi bag chags rtsa ba chad// chos nyid chos kyi don ldan chos mchog lam chen yid 'ong gser gyi phreng bar ldan// gnyis med ye shes las byung khyab bdag 'gro mgon nor bu rin chen chos kyi mdzod// don yod lugs gzigs sde snod rnam grol don mthong rnam dag thugs de'i dgongs pa nyid// gang gi drin gyis ma mthong mthong phyir mthong ba'i lam ltar bde chen don mthong zhing*// the tshom blo bral yid ches sgron ma byang chub gsal dwangs dri med rtog dang bral// gnyug ma'i nyams myong zhen med chos nyid 'od gsal nyi mas ma rig mun pa sangs// 'dir 'phrad smon lam mtshams sbyor bag chags las kyi rtsa ba can// bsam pa'i sdong po rnam mdzes sgrub pa'i me tog 'bras ldan gyi// byang chub ljon shing las 'bras yid ches bsil grib la// sngar 'dris ma dang 'phrad bzhin smon lam bu dang cis mi mjal// phyag rgya chen po gser phreng las/

tshogs 'khor gsum pa gnyis med yid ches rang gsal gyi le'u ste/ gsum pa'o// phyag rgya chen po rdo rje'i glu rin po che gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang paṇ+ḍi ta mang pos gsungs pa rnams rje btsun mnga' bdag mai tri pas gzhung gcig tu sdebs pa'i gdams pa rdzogs so/// /paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur ba'o//

༄༅// shes rab kyi phrin yig ces bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon pad+ma rdo rjes mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ pradz+nyā le kha nā ma/ bod skad du/ shes rab kyi phrin yig ces bya ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang lha mo sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// de nyid gsum gyi rin chen rnam par dag gyur pa// gsung las shin tu gsang gyur mkhas dang btsun par snang*// lha mo kun 'gro bde ba mchog gi sa gzhir gyur// shes rab don dam gyur pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas go 'phang grub don thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /yid bzhin nor dang bum pa bzang po ltar snang ba// de yi shin tu gsang ba'i phrin yig mnyan 'os pa// de nyid don gyi go 'phang bshad sbyar spring bar bya// de nas sgrub pa por phan phyir// shes rab phrin yig pad rdo rjes// gsang las shin tu gsang gyur pa// de kho na nyid rab gsal bya// swa sti dag pa kun grol ba// nam mkha' lta bur skye ba med// rang rig tsam gyi shes bya dang*// mchog tu dga' bar byed pa mo// mtshan ma med cing snang ba med// dngos dang dngos med rnam par spangs// chos dbyings rang bzhin zhes bya ba// mchog tu dri ma med pa'i gnas// mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs// mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs// bdag med dri ma med pa'i gzhi// rdo rje gsum byung dri ma med// 'dod pa'i don gyi gnas gyur pa// yid bzhin nor bu bzhin du 'byung*// lha yi dpag bsam shing lta bur// mchod pa mchog gi gnas gyur pa// de na gnas pa'i lha mo de// shes rab lha mo bla na med// rdor gsum mi phyed sbyor ba yis// de kho na nyid pad+mar ldan// nang gi gnas kyi rang bzhin gyis// mchog tu dga' bar byed ma la// dngos dang dngos med rang bzhin gyis// 'bad de yang dag mkhyen par gsol// rba rlabs med cing snang ba med// rang gi lus la gnas gyur kyang*// 'bar ba chen mo de nyid kyi// dus su bdag gis ma shes so// mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs can ma// rang bzhin med pas mdzes pa ste// skye ba med pas kun rtogs pas// thams cad du ni khyab byed ma// 'dod pa'i yon tan bzang lngar ldan// lus dang lus la kun tu gnas// dmyal ba la sogs thams cad la// gsang ba'i spyod pas rol pa ste// mdog dang yan lag rnam par spangs// gsang las shin tu gsang gyur 'di// dpal ldan bde chen zhal snga yi// bka' drin gyis ni bdag gis rtogs// dri ma med cing khyab pa mo// rang rig mtshan nyid gcig pu ste// skye ba med la rtogs bya'i phyir// ji bzhin du ni rnam par gnas// dngos dang dngos med mchog 'dzin pa// zad par bya phyir ji bzhin gnas// bla ma'i zhal snga'i bka' drin gyis// dge ma ji bzhin shes nas ni// yang dag gus dang bcas pa yis// nus pa ji bzhin bsgom pa'ang byas// de lta na yang da bar du// gcig tu mi 'gro ci yi phyir// yang na bdag la skal med dam// ci ste bdag gi sems rgyud la// yang dag pa yi sbyor ba yis// ji skad gsungs bzhin mi gnas sam// rang gi rang bzhin gyis dag pa// mngon par byang chub byed pa mo// phung lnga rdo rje gsum sogs la// ji bzhin yang dag gnas pa ni// slob dpon dpal ldan zhal snga nas// snying rjer zhugs pa'i thugs kyis ni// 'bad de de bzhin rtogs bya'i phyir// yang dag ji bzhin bdag la gsung*// dpal ldan bde chen mgon po yis// khyod kyis dngos la bdag blo bskyed// bka' lung stsal zhing gnas pas na// de la 'dir ni the tshom med// de nyid gsal bar shes nas su// nyin dang mtshan du bsgom byas kyang*// gang phyir bden pa gsal ba ru// mi snang bas de stong ngam ci// yid bzhin nor bu mkha' mtshungs ltar// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs so lo// de ltar gsungs pa'i tshig de dag

/bden pa dang ni mi bden yin// mkha' mtshungs gang yin bden pa ste// gang zhig shes nas bsgoms gyur kyang*// gang dngos gsal bar mi ston pas// yid bzhin nor mtshungs rdzun pa yin// bdag gis khyod ni don dam gyis// kun tu 'char bar shes pa ste// de lta na yang mi dmigs pas// sgyu ma tshogs kyi gzugs 'dzin yin// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis don dam du// nges par skyon dang yon tan dag /grogs 'dus pa las ji bzhin 'gyur// gsungs pa'i ngag de bden pa ste// shes rab bden par smra ba khyod// gang gis rtogs pa'i rang bzhin yang*// bdag med bzhi yang 'dus pa yis// de dang mtshungs par de gnas so// bzang mo dri ma med 'bar ma// 'on kyang gang gis bdag shes nas// yun ring dus su rnam dpyad kyang*// ma dmigs pa de gang du yib// mchog tu dga' bar byed pa'i gzugs// mngon par byang chub byed pa'o// ye shes sgron me'i snang ba ni// phyogs bcur gsal bar bteg nas su// dri dang phreng sogs na bza' dang*// bza' bca' ston mo de bzhin gzhan// gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba yis// rgyun mi 'chad par rtag tu ni// bdag gis shes rab bsten gyur kyang*// skad cig kyang ni 'gyur ba med// mngon rtogs dri med 'jug pa po// de bzhin nyid shes dag pa yi// khyod kyi dam tshig spyod pas ni// byang chub lam ni ston pa po// rgyud las ji skad 'byung ba bzhin// rgyun du bar chad med par ni// 'dod yon lnga po bsten pa yis// bdag gi byis pa nas bzung ste// shin tu bdag nyid rig pa yis// bsten pa dang ni bsgoms gyur pas// dge ba yi ni sa gzhi khyod// bdag la ci phyir yid mi rton// sems gnyis ldan pa'i bud med la// su zhig yid ni rton byed ces// yang dag mgon pos gsungs pa gang*// de ni bden par nye bar gnas// sgyu ma dag ni thams cad las// bud med sgyu ma khyad par 'phags// rnam pa du mas phan btags pas// gang gis rnam kun bsten byas shing*// khams gsum ma lus par bltas kyang*// mi snang gcig pur gang na gnas// khyod kyi gnad ni dran med par// byis pa gang gis khyod bsgoms na// de rnams don med phung 'gyur zhing*// byang chub rgyur khyod gnas pa min// gnad ni legs par shes ldan pa// gang gis khyod ni bsgoms gyur na// byang chub snying po'i bar du yang*// de rnams sangs rgyas bya phyir gnas// bzang mo khyod dngos shes gyur nas// gang gis ma bsgoms de la yang*// grogs mos lag pa bsdoms te song*// rigs ngan dang ni mtho ba'ang rung*// gnad shes na ni mdzar gyur nas// bzang mo nang du'ang snang byed cing*// lan 'ga'ang mdza' ba'i ngo med cing*// ma rabs rnams kyi rang bzhin ni// mtshang brtol na ni nges pa ru// skye bo de yi gdong gi ni// pad+ma blta zhing dbang du 'gyur// cho 'brang can gyi skye bo yang*// 'jug pa'i lam ni 'di nyid de// tshig tsam chad pa byas na yang*// 'chi ba na yang 'gyur ba med// gnyis ka dag pa'i rigs las byung*// cho 'brang can du skyes pa yin// bya ba dang ni bya min dang*// snod dang snod min 'dir khyad med// khyed la bdag gis rnam kun tu// mchod byas lan 'ga' 'ang mi blta bas// shes rab khyod kyi rigs spyod yul// da ltar bdag gis khong du chud// bud med rnams kyi rang bzhin ni// shin tu 'phyar la g.yo ba yin// mchu rkan la sogs skam pa ste// mtshang 'bru mang pos ci zhig bya// khyod ni nyin dang mtshan dag dang*// skad cig gcig kyang ma yengs par// bsgoms na skad cig nyid kyis ni// bla na med pa'i gnas 'thob byed// gang gis nye bar bsgoms pa yis// sangs rgyas go 'phang rgyu yin pa'i// khyod kyi spyod pa 'di lta bur// ji skad gsungs bzhin sngar ma shes// mang po smras pas ci zhig dgos// yid brten rung ba 'ga' yang med// 'gyod dang gnyis dang rmugs pa yis// rmongs pas khyod ni mi shes na// khyod kyis rang gi rang bzhin gang*// gsal ba ru ni de smros shig

/rdor gsum sa bon las byung bas// gsum gyis bskyed par the tshom med// 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs dri mas// sems can thams cad rmongs pas na// bye ba du ma'i nang nas kyang*// gang gis khyod shes su yang med// mang du smras pas ci zhig dgos// smad 'tshong g.yon can gyis bskor bzhin// don dam du ni grub med pas// sgyu ma mchog gi gzugs 'dzin ma// bskal pa bye ba grangs med par// rmongs pas khyod ni ma shes te// bza' dang btung sogs chags pa yis// srid pa'i btson rar lhung bar 'gyur// de la shin tu chags pa yis// 'byor ster khyod ni brjed par 'gyur// phyag rgya'i chags la 'jug pa yis// rgyal 'gyur rdo rje can mchog ma// bla ma'i zhabs kyi bka' drin las// bzang mo khyod kyi rang bzhin ni// ji ltar yang dag gnas pa bzhin// thams cad bdag gis shes par 'gyur// khyod kyi rang bzhin ma lus pa// thams cad bdag gis shes pas na// rmi lam na yang slu mi nus// de bas bdag la blo gtod cig /khyod kyi lam ni gcig pu nyid// mkhas pas cho ga bzhin sbyangs te// gang zhugs sangs rgyas nyid 'phrad par// rgyal ba rnams kyis yang dag bstan// zab mo de yang bdag gis ni// ji srid sbyang ba ma byas pa// de srid khyod kyi lus reg las// byung ba'i bde ba rnyed ma yin// gti mug 'obs kyi 'khrigs pa dang*// zhe sdang gi ni sdong dum ldang*// 'dod chags tsher ma nyam nga bas// byang chub lam ni bgrod par dka'// phung po'i shing ni thog mtha' med// 'dod yon yal ga gyen bgrengs pas// nam mkha'i mthongs ni g.yogs pas na// lam de dam por bkag ste gnas// phung po nyon mongs de bzhin du// 'chi bdag lha bdud chom po pa ra// sdang ba mang pos bskor nas su// rnam rtog chen po las byung ba'i// srid pa'i rtswa dang lcug ma dang*// rdo rgyal la sogs ldan pa'i nags// shin tu rgya chen brgal dka' bar// phung po'i shing rta bsten nas su// gti mug 'obs ni brgal dka' gnas// kun rtog rtswa dang ldum sogs pa'i// skyibs su 'bad de yib par byed// lha bdud la sogs chom po pa// de lta bu yi phyogs na gnas// yang dag lam zhugs 'gron po dag

/sems kyi nor bu 'phrog pa yis// rab tu sdang bas 'joms par byed// dkon mchog gsum gyi mdzod po che// yon tan nor gyis yongs bkang ba// byang chub lam la gnas pa yi// mel tshe pa yis de mthong nas// ye shes rdo rje'i s+t+wa re ni// so ni rnon por bdar ba yis// byang chub kyi ni lam 'gog pa'i// phung po'i shing ni kun bcad nas// cho ga bzhin du gtubs nas su// yid kyi shing de las byung ba'i// nyon mongs sdong dum tsher mar bcas// bdag med me la bsreg par bya// nga rgyal rdo yi tshogs de ni// shes rab rdo rjes phye mar byas// gti mug 'obs ni 'khrigs pa dag /byang sems rgyun mi 'chad pas dgang*// yang dag lam zhugs 'gron po la// 'tshe byed gdul bar dka' ba yi// 'chi bdag bdud sogs chom po pa// bcom pas de dang de 'bros 'gyur// byang chub lam ni yangs pa na// byang chub 'gegs bya'i phyir gnas pa// phyogs bcur gnas pa'i sdang ba rnams// thabs kyi lus ni dri med pas// shes rab ral gri rnon po yis// 'bad pas de dag bcom nas su// lam bzang de ru zhugs nas ni// thams cad der ni ci gar 'gro// byang chub lam ni sbyangs pa yis// kun tu shin tu dri med pas// rmad byung bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// grogs mo khyod ni sbyangs pas na// rang bzhin dri med dag cing zhi// rang rig bdag med mnyam pa nyid// 'dod pa'i don gyi 'bras ster ba// go 'phang bla med 'thob par 'gyur// khyod kyi rang bzhin ro myangs na// 'di ni 'di 'dra zhes bya ba// sangs rgyas kyis kyang brjod mi nus// rang rig skye ba med pa nyid// sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag byas pa// dbang po las 'das gang yin 'thob// mchog tu dga' ba las byung dag /shin tu rnyed dka'i go 'phang ni// bsam gyis mi khyab bla na med// mya ngan 'das gnas zhes bya ba// mngon par byang chub byed pa'o// bla ma'i zhal snga'i bka' drin ni// nyin dang mtshan du bsgom pa yi// chos gcig gis ni 'thob par 'gyur// shin tu gus pas bsgoms pa las// gzhan du de ni thob pa min// de ni rang bzhin dag pa ste// dus kun tu ni 'dus ma byas// rtag dang chad pa rnam par spangs// thabs dang shes rab dri ma med// skye ba med par rtogs pa yis// sems can kun la yang dag gnas// sangs rgyas byang chub bsam mi khyab// bla na med par de shes bya// sangs rgyas kun gyi gnas de ni// sangs rgyas nyid ni 'thob byed pa'o// de ltar sems dang sems byung gis// don gyi rang bzhin rtogs nas nas ni// rdo rje dri med gsum sbyor bya// ci ste shes nas rnam bsgoms nas// ye shes rdo rje rab dran pas// dngos grub don kun bdag la byin// gal te de ltar ma gyur na// de tshe bdag ni sma phab pas// ji ltar byed pa ltos shig dang*// ji bzhin rgyud kyi de nyid kyi// thag pa yis ni bcings nas su// yang dag pa yi khyim du ni// dge ma kun nas bcug nas ni// skye ba med par rtogs pa yi// sems dang sems byung rang bzhin gyis// 'bad de bsrung ba byas nas su// de nyid sangs rgyas sa mchog tu// thabs kyi lcags sgrog gis bcings te// ye shes rdo rje'i gzer btab la// bdag med rdzong du bzhag nas ni// de nas bdag gis bsgrub par bya// de ltar khyod la spring bya ba// ji ltar gyur pa bdag gis spring*// 'dzem dang ngos dga' spangs nas su// bzang mo la ni kun bzlas kyi// gal te byams par mi byed na// de tshe ci zhig smra ru yod// 'on te min na than 'di dag

/rdo rje 'dzin ma'i snying la zhog /khyod kyi lam dang sbyang ba yi// bye brag dag kyang ngas shes la// rigs dang gzugs kyi rang bzhin dang*// bdag gis khyod kyi kun 'byung dang*// don dam gnas kyang shes pas na// de bas bdag la blo gtod cig /bla ma'i zhal snga'i bka' drin gyis// thabs kyi mchog dang bcas pa ru// shes bya'i thag pa rab sra bas// de dang de ru rgyug byed pa// bdag gis bzung ste bcings zin pas// da ni 'bros sa ga la yod// de bas lha mo bdag dga' bas// dbang gyur dam tshig la mnos la// dpal ldan bde chen zhal snga'i bka'// yon tan rgya mtshos bskyang bar gyis// khyod kyi rang bzhin gzung med cing*// rmad byung ji bzhin rig nas ni// dpal ldan bde chen spyod pa ni// bka' yi de bzhin 'jug par bya// rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig ldan pa'i// shes rab phrin yig mnyam med pa// dpal ldan bde chen zhal snga yi// bka' drin gyis ni bdag gis byas// shes rab ri bo'i srub shing gis// shes bya'i 'o mtsho bsrubs las byung*// ye shes bdud rtsi rang byung ba// mngon sum sangs rgyas byed pa po// shes rab phrin yig la 'bad de// skyes bu gang gis de rig nas// 'bad de rnam par bsgoms pas na// de ni rdo rje 'dzin dngos 'gyur// shes rab kyi phrin yig slob dpon chen po pad+ma rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shān+ta bha dra dang*/ bod kyi zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o//

༄༅// rnal 'byor pa'i rtogs pa'i gegs sel ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad/ ༄༅// rnal 'byor pa'i rtogs pa'i gegs sel ba zhes bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnams dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// ci phyir zhe na gang gis gang la gang ltar bsgom// rtags dang yon tan bar chad gegs skyon bsal// de dag shes nas goms pas byang chub 'thob// ma thos mi shes mi 'grub yang na 'gyangs// dang po ci phyir bsgom pa gzung 'dzin gnyis// ma spangs ji bzhin ma bsgom rnal 'byor pas// phyag 'tshal mchod bshags sbyin pa ma byas kyang*// bsod nams 'phel yang ye shes rdzogs mi 'gyur// gnyis pa gang gis rnal 'byor dang ldan pa// thos mang brtson zhing dam tshig sdom gnas shing*// mchod dang sbyin mos byang chub sems ldan pa// de ni theg chen gsang ba'i snod yin bsgom// gsum pa gang la zhe na rang gi sems// ji bzhin ma bcos ye nas rnam dag cing*// spros bral yod med rtag chad mthar spangs pa// de la g.yeng ba med par rtag tu gnas// bzhi pa gang ltar sgom pa bsgom bya dang*// sgom pa gnyis med rang gi ngo bo la// ci yang med la cir yang snang gsal bar// bying rmugs spros pa'i rtog pa med par bsgom// lnga pa de rtags rnal 'byor brtson ldan la// dang po gnyid dang 'dod sred chung bar 'gyur// de nas rim gyis rmi lam 'dod la sogs// rtogs pa ji bzhin cho 'phrul gzugs kyang ston// drug pa de yi yon tan bsam brjod pa// mngon sum tshe sring nad rnams gso ba dang*// gegs sel la sogs yon tan mang po 'byung*// de bzhin rim gyis byang chub lam la 'jug /bdun pa bar chad bgegs ni rnal 'byor pa// gnas spangs gnas 'tshol gzhan du 'gror 'dod na// gnod sbyin gzhan dang gzhan du 'gro 'dod de// rnal 'byor sems la zhugs nas gnas gzhan 'phen// gal te rnal 'byor bsgom zhing gnas bzung bas// smra bcad bar skabs nang du gzhan 'jug dang*// phyir 'byung khengs dregs 'dod brkam zas nor 'tshol// yi dwags 'dod sred can gdon de sems zhugs// gal te rnal 'byor sems 'khrugs 'thabs 'dod cing*// 'khor la gshe dang gzhan la spyo byed na// 'byung po'i bdag po ya ba sho na pa// sgrub pa de yi snying la zhugs pa yin// gal te rnal 'byor 'phres shing nyal la dga'// zas skom sred cing bzlas la mi brtson na// lto 'phye nyal brtson snyom byed ces bya ba// rnal 'byor sems la zhugs nas gnas par byed// gal te rnal 'byor rang gi longs spyod rkyen// yo byad srung zhil so 'dzugs srung ma sko// gsog phyir 'dod 'chol gzhan du gtang 'dod na// gnod sbyin nor srung zhes bya sems la zhugs// gal te rnal 'byor pha ma spun tshogs la// chags nas smon lam rim gros srung byed na// lhan cig skyes pa'i bag chags ma byang bas// nyon mongs ma spangs byang chub ring bar 'gyur// gal te rnal 'byor gza' skar 'jug phod dang*// dus dang lo zla bzang ngan brtsi byed na// dbyer med mnyam pa nyid dang 'gal bas na// byang chub 'thob par rab tu dka' bar 'gyur// gal te rnal 'byor thos mang rtogs che zhing*// sgom brtson snyems pas bdag bstod gzhan smod na// nyon mongs ma spangs nga rgyal 'phel 'gyur bas// phyir yang lhung zhing byang chub ring bar 'gyur// gal te rnal 'byor bdag la gzhan dag gis// sngon dang da ltar ma 'ongs gnod byed ces// zhe sdang skyes nas rig sngags gsod gtong na// zhe sdang dbang gis byang chub ring bar 'gyur// gal te bdag la gzhan gyis mchod bkur zhing*// bsngags pa mang brjod bstod la sems dga' na// 'gro la phyogs char gyur te chags sems kyis// byang chub lam la 'dis kyang ring bar 'gyur// gal te rnal 'byor 'khor mang 'du long dag

/rgyal po lta bur mang por bsten na ni// khengs dregs yin pas sgom pa g.yeng ba'i rgyu// byang chub lam las shin tu ring bar 'gyur// brgyad pa skyon bsal thabs ni rnal 'byor pa// sems la bar chad mtshan ma de byung na// 'di ltar bsams nas mtshan rtog bsal bar bya// chos su ci snang sems las gzhan med cing*// sems kyi rang bzhin chos nyid ngo bo la// bzang ngan spang len 'dod sred byams sdang sogs// rtog dang rtogs pa'i dbang gis bgegs byung na// sems la bltas na gang yang mi snang bas// snang med sems rtog mtshan ma ga la yod// bdag rtog mtshan mar sems la gzung nyes pas// rtog pa thams cad spangs shing rtog med gnas// rtog pa med pa la yang gnas pa med// de ltar ring du gnas na rtog bgegs ni// myur bar zhi nas ji bzhin bsgom pa la// bar chad sems kyi rtog pa 'byung mi 'gyur// byang chub 'bras bu myur du 'thob par 'gyur// rnal 'byor pa'i rtogs pa'i gegs sel ba zhes bya ba dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon mkhas pa chen po sangs rgyas gsang ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so/// / ༄༅// dug lnga sbas pa'i lam mchog tu gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon 'phags pa lhas mdzad/ ༄༅// dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo// byis pa'i rjes su byis pa 'greng*// byis pas byis pa 'jigs 'gyur bas// 'dir/ byis pa dgrol bar bya ba'i phyir// byis 'tshing lam du dgyer ba bshad// ces pa 'chad par bsam mo// de la 'dul ba don yod par grub pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las/ gang gis rmongs pa 'ching 'gyur zhing*// ngu 'bod mthar ni nges 'gyur ba// de nyid kyis ni grol 'gyur zhing*// shes rab stobs kyis bde ba 'thob// ces gsungs pa'i don mkhas pas mngon du bsten par bya ste/ gang de la mchog tu gdams par bya ba yin pas thog mar rgyud brtag par bya'o// de la cha mnyam pa ni 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa yun ring por skye bar mi 'gyur yang*/

dngos po des de la 'dod chags la sogs pa mi 'byung ba ma yin no// nyon mongs pa chung ba ni 'dod chags la sogs pa'i dngos po chen po dang*/ mang po dang*/ lhag pa dang phrad cing mngon du gyur pa la ni nyon mongs pa bul bar skye la/ 'bring dang chung ngu la ni shin tu cha phra ba'o// gang zag 'dod chags spyad pa ni chags pa'i dngos po chung ngu dang*/ ngan pa la'ang chags pa chen por 'gyur na/ de las ldog pa la lta ci smos te/ yun ring du chags pa'o// dbang po mnyen pa dang*/ de bzhin du 'jam pa dang*/ mi brlang ba dang*/ lus ngag gis gzhan la mtho 'tshams pa ma yin pa dang*/ dpral bar dka' ba dang*/ dman pa la mos pa dang*/ spro ring ba dang*/ de la 'du ba dang*/ yid mi bde ba med pa dang*/ kun dga' ba mang ba dang*/ khro gnyer med pa dang*/ mdog gsal ba dang*/ 'dzum pa sngon du gtong ba dang*/ sha rtsi dmar zhing 'gro bar mgyogs pa dang*/ 'khun bur smra zhing mi brtan pa'i bsam pa sna tshogs su rgyu ba'o// zhe sdang dang ldan pa'i gang zag ni sha rtsi nag cing stobs che ba/ drag por 'gro zhing brlang por smra ba/ thams cad mnar sems dang ldan pa/ zhe sdang ba'i dngos po chung ngu la khong khro bas kun nas dkris pa stug po dang*/ mang po skyed par byed na/ 'bring dang chen po la lta smos ci dgos te/ yun ring du gnas par byed do// dbang po mi mnyen/ ci 'jam/ gzhan la mtho 'tshams/ dpral bar sla/ yid dbyung bar sla/ mu cor smra/ spyi brtol che/ mi mos pa mang*/ las kyi mtha' dam brtan/ brtul zhugs dam brtan/ yid mi bde ba mang*/ 'khrug pa mang*/ bzlog dka'/ gnod bzhin du gnas/ khro gnyer dang ldan/ bzhin gyi mdog mi gsal ba'o// gti mug dang ldan pa'i gang zag ni rmongs par 'gyur ba'i dngos po chung ngu la'ang gti mug gis kun nas dkris pa stug po dang*/ mang po skyed par byed na/ gzhan lta ci smos te/ yun ring du gnas par byed do// dbang po bul ba dang*/
