blun pa dang*/ zhan pa dang*/ lus kyi las kyi mtha' lhod pa dang*/ ngag gi las kyi mtha' lhod pa dang*/ nyes par sems pa dang*/ nyes par smra/ nyes par byed pa'i las byed/ le lo che/ sgrub mi phod/ smra ba zhan/ yid mi 'jug /brjed pas shes bzhin du mi spyod/ log par 'dzin/ dbral bar dka'/ yid dbyung bar dka'/ dman pa la mos/ glen dig lkugs/ lag pas brda byed/ legs par gsungs pa dang*/ nyes par bshad pa'i chos rnams kyi don kun shes par mi nus/ rkyen gyis 'phrog /gzhan gyi dring la 'jog /sha mdog nges pa med/ dal bar rgyu ba'o// gang zag nga rgyal dang ldan pa ni khengs par gyur pa'i dngos po chung ngu la'ang nga rgyal gyi rgyus kun nas dkris pa stug po dang*/ mang po skyed par byed na/ 'bring dang chen po la lta ci smos te/ yun ring du gnas par byed do// dbang po rgod pa dang*/ dbang po 'dam bu ltar mtho/ khengs/ lus cher brgyan pa la sbyor ba'i rjes su brtson/ btsan ngag tu smra zhing mi 'dud/ pha ma nye du bla ma lta bu dag la dus gsum du rkyen du 'babs pa'i mchod pa mi byed/ lus mi 'dud/ gsong por smra ba dang*/ phyag 'tshal mngon du ldang*/ thal mo sbyar zhing 'dud par byed pa'i ngang tshul can ma yin pa dang*/ bdag nyid kun tu 'dzin/ bdag bstod/ gzhan la smod/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti 'dod/ grags pa 'dod/ tham thom gyi snod gyur/ dbral zhing yid dbyung bar dka'/ rgya chen po la mi mos/ snying rje chung*/ bdag dang*/ sems can dang*/ srog dang*/ gso ba dang*/ gang zag tu lta ba shas che/ khro gtum che/ 'khrul pa dang ldan pa yin te/ de lta bu dang mthun pa ni nga rgyal gyi rtags so// phrag dog dang ldan pa'i gang zag ni sha mdog sngo nag pa/ 'dus pa'i yul med par rgyu ba/ gzhan la gnod par smra zhing*/ nges pa med pa'i bsam pa sna tshogs su rgyu ba'o// zhes gsungs pa 'di dag nges par slob dpon gyis brtags la nges par gdams par bya'o// de'ang gsungs pa/

bsregs bcad bdar ba'i gser bzhin du// yongs su brtags te nga yi bka'// blang bar bya yi gus phyir min// zhes gsungs pas/ dngos su sgrol ba la bsam gyis mi khyab par 'dod pa dang*/ rgyu ma dag pa la bsam gyis mi khyab par 'dod pa dang*/ phyogs tsam la bsam gyis mi khyab par 'dod pa dang*/ rab tu thal ba la bsam gyis mi khyab par 'dod pa ste/ 'di dag ni rmongs pa rnams kyi don rtags yin te/ mkhas pas kun tu spang bar bya ba yin no// blang bar bya ba ni mchog tu gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste/ de'ang gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ bzod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ gnyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ 'pho ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ 'bras bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang drug go /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni bla na med pa'i gdams pa'o// bzod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni dug lnga sbas pa'i lam du khyer ba'o// gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sogs pa kha cig kyang dug lnga 'dus mod kyi/ dgongs pa can yin no// dug lnga lam du ji ltar 'khyer na/ gcig gi stong nyid gang yin pa// de ni kun gyi stong nyid yin// zhes gsungs pas/ 'dod chags kyi stong nyid ji lta ba bzhin du zhe sdang la sogs pa la'ang ngo*// de la phyi nang gi gzugs la sogs pa yid du 'ong ba gcig la chags pa skyes pa/ de'ang kha dog la sogs par ma grub pas na rtag pa'i mtha' bsal ba'o// rlung rjes su dpag pa las shes pa de bzhin du shes rig ma 'gags pa'i sgo nas chad pa ma yin no// de gnyis kyi bar de gnyis ka'i bdag nyid can gyi dngos po'ang yod pa ma yin te/ de bas na bzhi pa ni rjes thob kyi shes pas dpag par bya ba'i de nyid dus su spras pa cir yang yod pa ma yin no// de la 'dod chags ma spangs rnam par dag pa'o// zhe sdang la sogs pa la'ang smras te/ de ni phan tshun spangs te 'gal ba ma yin no// chos kyi dbyings rtogs pas ma lus pa'i yul dug med par bya'o// zhes gsungs so// sngar smos pa ltar stong pa nyid ni kun tu sbyar bar byas la/

dug lnga'i btsal thabs ni zhe sdang btsal ba bzhin du kun tu blta bar bya'o// de la nangs par ldang ba'i dus su/ de ring ni bdag gis zhe sdang gi dngos po bdag gis skyes pa'am/ phas rgol ba'am/ gzhan dag phan tshun 'thabs pa'am/ zhe sdang skyes pa gang yang rung ste/ de dag ni mchog gi dngos grub 'thob par byed pa'i yan lag yin pas/ zhe sdang ci byung chor bar shog cig par smon lam btab la/ nam tshor ba'i dus su zhe sdang de nyid bsam gyis mi khyab par bya'o// gal te de'i nyin par zhe sdang ma byung na/ sngar bdag nyid zhe sdang skyes pa'am/ phan tshun sdang ba'am/ gzhan gyis phan tshun zhe sdang skyes pa la dran pa bskyed la/ de nyid rang bzhin med par bya'o// de ltar nangs gcig bzhin smon lam btab la bya'o// de ltar byas pas zhe sdang gi dug gis mi tshugs par bya'o// zhe sdang skyes so cog lam du shes tsa na/ dug gzhan la'ang de bzhin du shes par bya ste/ zhe sdang yid kyi gang zag gis zhe sdang yi dam du byas pas de las su rung ba dang*/ 'dod chags la sogs pa la sla bar 'ong ba de bzhin du gang gis zhad che ba de thog mar yi dam du bya'o// de nas gzhan la sbyar ba ni snga ma bzhin no// cha mnyam pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa chung bas kyang thog mar gang yang rung ba zhig yid dam du byas la/ de las su rung ba dang rim gyis spo bar bya'o// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ las dang po pa'i gang zag khal cig la mchog tu ma gdams na dug lnga mang du 'byung bas yid gtod snying mi 'dod de/ gzhug lhod pa skye bar 'gyur ro// de dag ni sngon du bstan par mi bya ste/ nam sgom pa'i dus su gzod gang la de gdams pa zhes sngon du bstan pa'i don de ni de nyid yi dam du gdams pa'o// dug lnga'i 'jigs pa btul nas mi 'jigs pa la zhugs pa 'di nyid ni mchog tu gsang ba'o// snod shin tu bzang ba la gdams par bya'o// snod ngan tshig tsam la brten nas bag med du spyod pa la ni ma yin no// thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/

gtor ma dang ni bzlas pa dang*// dkyil 'khor me dang chu yi las// phyag rgya gdugs sogs mchod pa dang*// phyag dang bskor ba bya ba dang*// lugs ma'am bris pa la sogs dang*// gsung rab 'bri sogs rtsom pa dang*// thams cad dus su rnal 'byor pas// thams cad rang bzhin rtog med bya// gnyid ni bag med mi log ste// ji ltar pad+ma kha zum pa// grib mas non pas zum pa ste// grib sel stobs kyis rgyas pa ltar// gsal ba 'das nas ma rig pa// srab mthug gyur pa'i stobs kyis te// dbugs dag me long dkyil 'dus ltar// rim gyis bsdus te ma rig pa// shes rab kyis ni sbyang byas nas// cig shos la ni nges 'dus pa// ma goms pa las yid mi 'byung*// goms pas yid gnyis med par ni// rab tu 'bad pa'i sems goms yin// gsang ba 'dus pa las/ 'pho ba'i dus su bsam mi khyab// las kyi shugs kyis 'pho ba dang*// rnal 'byor lcebs pa'i man ngag go /bsgom bya smig rgyu la sogs pa// mthong 'og de nyid gnas pa dang*// rang bzhin gyis grub rdo rje'i lus// bdun gyi 'pho ba spangs nas su// srid mi 'jug ste mtha' gnyis spang*// sbyor sems sngon du btang ba yis// mthong nas ldang 'gyur mi 'jug byed// 'da' bar mi 'gyur mchog grub pa'o// rkang pa dang ni kha dang lte// snying ga spyi gtsug mig rnams te// rlung ni gang nas 'phor 'gyur ba// rim pa bzhin du skye zhing 'thob// dmyal ba yi dwags byol song dang*// mi dang lha dang ye shes so// de nas sgo gzhan dgag byas la// mig nas rlung ni 'phul bar bya// bla ma'i zhal la gnas pa'o// de bzhin lcebs pa'ang zhal la gnas// rnal 'byor mi shes gang zag gis// mi dang lha yi skye ba ru// blang ba'i sems ni rtse gcig bya// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i nang nas kyang*// 'chi ka'i sems ni gtso yin pa// gang ltar bsam pa de ltar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// 'o na sdig pa can yang de ltar 'gyur ram zhe na/

mi 'gyur te/ sdig chen las kyis bskal nas ni// man ngag 'dod dang mi 'phrad de// gal te phrad kyang klad gzer dang*// smyo 'bogs sogs pas mi dran no// 'o na tshogs bsags pa la 'da' ka'i sems med kyang bde 'gro ru skye'o zhe na/ tshogs du ma bsags kyang 'chi khar sems ngan skyes na rgyal po ma skyes dgra lta bu'o// de bas na 'da' ka ma'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa la shin tu 'bad par bya'o// 'bras bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni sku dang ye shes te/ gsir ni mi gtsang nang du bcug gyur kyang*// 'bar ba'i rang bzhin nam yang mi 'bri ltar// des pa gang zhig 'jig rten chos spyod kyang*// bsam pa'i rang bzhin nam yang de mi spong*// zhes gsungs pas/ gzugs skus 'gro ba'i don byed pa na'ang 'jig rten gyi bya ba ngan pa dang bral ba'o// de ltar rgyu dang 'bras bu thams cad du gnyis su med pa kho na yin zhing*/ dug lnga shin tu btsal bar bya ba yin yang*/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas phyin ci log la goms pa'i dbang gis shes rab dang bral nas log pa'i shes rab rgyu bas dben pa ru gnas te/ mi rtog pa'i nus pa rnyed nas tshogs kyi gseb tu phyin kyang zhe sdang la sogs pa gang byung yang dran pa dang mi 'bral zhing*/ gzhan gyi dbang du mi 'gro na dus la bab pa'o// yang na kun tu rgyu nyid bya ste/ gnas gcig tu yun ring du gnas par mi bya ste/ mi dang khyi 'dra ba/ khyi'ang rang gi gnas na stobs che la/ yul gzhan du dul bar 'gyur ro// de bzhin du mi'ang rang gi gnas na nyon mongs pa gdul bar dka' ste/ yul gzhan du nyon mongs pa thul bar sla bas kun tu rgyu'i tshul la gnas par bya'o// gang zhig bdag gis byas bsod kyis// kun kyang 'tshe ba med par shog /gang gi lam nas 'gro ba yis// sangs rgyas nyid du grub par shog /dug lnga sbas pa'i lam mchog tu gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba slob dpon 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /

༄༅// rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid bden pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon byang chub bzang pos mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ yo ga lak+ṣa ṇa sad+ya/ bod skad du/ rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid bden pa/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs dus kun gyi sangs rgyas dang*// chos dang dge 'dun tshogs bcas la// thal sbyar gus pas phyag 'tshal nas// rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i man ngag 'di// rin chen sna tshogs tshogs pa ltar// rnal 'byor pa rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// mdor bsdus nas ni bshad par bya// nam gyi cha smad gnyid las sad// bdag ma gtogs pa'i sems can la// thog ma nyid du snying rje bsgom// de nas bdag nyid la bltas nas// deng gi nyin zhag 'di la ni// slong ba'i sems can dag la ni// ji srid 'ongs kyang ser sna yi// dri mas mi 'gos nyid du bya// gal te bslab pa las 'gal ba'i// yid la 'gyu ba phra mo yang*// bsam pa nyid du mi bya na// ngag dang lus kyis smos ci dgos// bdag la de ring khro ba dang*// brdeg pa la sogs 'byung bar shog /des kyang 'khrug par mi bya yi// le lo byung na shes bzhin gyis// mgo la me 'bar bzhin du dor// bdag gis 'gro'am nyal 'dug rung*// spyod lam ji ltar gnas 'dug kyang*// yid ni lha yi nga rgyal dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral bar// rang nyid yin par rtag tu bsam// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa yi// shes dang shes bya bdag gis ni// de ring nyid nas bdag gis brtag /bstod dang smad pa grags ma grags// gzhan dag ji ltar zer yang ni// de nyid brag ca lta bu dang*// 'on pa lta bur bdag gis bya// chags pa'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg /'dod yon lnga la gang du yang*// rnam shes 'phro ba'i yul byung yang*// ngag tu ma 'thon bar du bzlog /gzugs su snang rnams sku nyid yin// sgra rnams gsung du bdag nyid brtag /sems can byang chub rgyu yin phyir// de yi shes pa ye shes yin// sems can ji ltar mthong gyur kyang*// de dag nyid la blos phyag bya// 'di dag nyid la brten nas bdag

/sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub pas na// dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa yin// mang po tshogs par gyur pa na// ro dang dur khrod 'du shes bskyed// grong du 'jug par byed pa na// btson ra khri mon 'du shes bskyed// rgyal po'i pho brang 'gro ba na// ngan 'gro nad dang 'ching ba dang*// g.yang sa chen po'i 'du shes bskyed// gal te bud med tshogs mthong na// mi gtsang rdzas ni sum cu dang*// 'khor ba'i lam 'dren yin par bsam// nye du pha ma bu tsha rnams// de la chags spangs btang snyoms bsam// dgra rnams mthong na 'di dag gis// bzod rdzogs byang chub yin par bsam// bdag gi longs spyod rdzas la yang*// 'dir ni rtsod pa'i rgyu dang ni// phyi ma ngan 'gror 'khrid par bsam// bdag la bstod pa brjod na yang*// 'dis ni nga rgyal 'phel byed pas// ngan 'gror 'khrid par byed pa yin// gal te smod pa byung na yang*// 'di la bzod sgom byang chub kyang*// mtshan ma rdzogs par rab tu bsam// gnas la zhen pa byung gyur na// rmi lam grong khyer ji bzhin du// rnal 'byor pa yis rab tu bsgom// bdag gis deng gi nyin zhag la// ngag la bzlas brjod kha thon bya// klog sogs bslab las mi 'gal bar// de ring bdag gis smra bar bya// lus kyi g.yo ba thams cad kyang*// mchod dang bskor ba la sogs pa// ngal bso don yod nyid du bya// rnam rtog gnyen pos ma bsdoms na// tshig tu brjod pas ci zhig 'grub// de bas rnam pa thams cad du// gnyen po'i dpung tshogs bskyed nas ni// nyon mongs rnams ni dpyis phyin bya// bza' btung zhim po za ba'i tshe// ro la zhen pa spang bya zhing*// mi gtsang rgyu las byung ba dang*// tha mar mi gtsang 'gyur bar bsam// reg bya 'jam po tshor ba'i tshe// reg bya ji bzhin yin par bsam// 'dir mang smos pas ci zhig dgos// gang du nyon mongs 'phel ba yi// khyim pa'am rab tu byung yang rung*// de dag rab tu spang bya zhing*// nyon mongs rnam par mi 'phel ba'i// sgrub pa'i grogs mchog gang yang rung*// de dag bsten pa mig ltar bya// bdag ni de ring nas brtsams te// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag tu rab tu byung ba dang*// tshangs pa spyod pa nyid du bya// nyin mtshan dus las ma yol bar// thun mtshams gsum du bsgom par bya// srog dang rtsol ba dgag pa dang*// rlung med pa yi mar me ltar// rtag tu spros bral bsgom par bya// de nas ldang tshe nga rgyal gyis// mtshan dang dpe byad skur ldan pa'i// lha yi nga rgyal brtan por bsam// mtshan mo'i thun la bab pa'i tshe// bder gshegs ji ltar gzims pa ltar// 'jig rten rtog spangs bdag nyid nyal// mdor na chos rnams thams cad kun// rmi lam lta bur brtag par bya// rnal 'byor bsgom rnams gtsor bya yi// lus ngag dge la gtsor mi bya// chos spyod rnam bcu la sogs la// nyon mongs pas ni ma g.yeng bar// bsgrims nas bdag gis 'bad pas bsgrub// rtag tu 'chir bsam ma chags blo// dngos po ci la'ang ma chags par// spyod lam ji ltar gnas kyang bsgom// bsod nams sems can kun la bsngo// byang chub bzang po bdag gis ni// rnal 'byor bsgom pa brtsams pa yi// dge ba zla zer dri med de// bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus pa// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang 'grub shog

/rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid bden pa mkhas pa chen po dpal byang chub bzang po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so/// / ༄༅// shes rab brtsam pa dus kyi gtam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal ldan gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ pradz+nyā ta ng+sha ga na bho shi pā ri ka thā nā ma/ bod skad du/ shes rab brtsam pa dus kyi gtam zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo// bde chen 'khor lo zag med spros pa rgyas pa'i sku dang chos// tshogs pa'i zhing dang dngos grub rtsa ba rnams la phyag 'tshal te// gal te brtson 'grus pha rol phyin pa'i dus min gyi// yin pa'i rtags dang ldan dus dag tu bzod med brtsam// slob dpon slob ma 'tshol ba dang*// rin chen rnyed par bsgrub pa dang*// slob ma don drin slar ldon dang*// dbang bskur med par slar 'dod dang*// re ba'i gos kyis 'gro ba dang*// lci ba'i zas kyis 'tsho ba dang*// mi phyed rnyed sogs rtsod pa dang*// drag pos gzhan zil gnon 'dod dang*// sku gzugs rtsod pas 'jig pa dang*// mig can 'gran zlas rtsod gyur dang*// dge slong gnas la rtsod pa dang*// grub mtha' skur pas sun 'byin dang*// 'gro rnams spyod par blta ba dang*// mkha' 'gro 'bras bur 'pho ba dang*// rin chen grags pa 'das pa dang*// mi rnams g.yo sgyus 'tsho ba dang*// shing rnams g.yab mo g.yob pa dang*// ri rnams cho nges 'debs pa dang*// chu rnams me yi 'od 'byin dang*// skal ba can la grags min brjod// rtsod rtags nyi shu rdzogs pa yis// bram ze mo yi mar me 'dra// kye/ lha dang drang srong 'tsho ba'i dus 'das sam// snying rjes dman pa rjes 'dzin zla 'byung dus// skyabs su 'gro ba dam pa'i rten bral na// 'chi ba'i dus tshe sdug bsngal sogs 'byung 'gyur// kye/ skye ba bzang thob skyes pa bud med kyis// lus dang ngag yid sdom pa mchog gsum la// brtser ldan dmigs med 'brel ba mi gnas pa// dam par 'gyur tshul bral na nges par 'ching*// kye/

dngos grub nye bar rnyed par ma btsal na// rang gi bde chen 'bad pas rtogs mi 'gyur// 'od gsal ma rnyed nyon mongs lam mi 'gyur// ngag dang mi ldan chos nyid rgyas gdab bral// dben pa bral bas nges 'byin rnyed mi 'gyur// brtul zhugs brtun te ma byas gsal mi rnyed// sems kyi mel tshe bral bas mchog thob min// dbang po ma yengs skye ba rnal 'byor rnams// 'dod pas ma g.yeng bya ba la mi 'jug /man ngag 'gro la ma g.yeng gnyid mi ldog /dam pa'i brgyud pa ma bskams 'bras ma bcad// kye/ kye ma rtag tu phyi nang mnyam par blta// dus ni yun thung 'di la ma rdzogs na// dus 'gyur ba yis dus rab rnyed mi 'gyur// de bas brtson 'grus dus la bab kyi byos// rtog pa'i sangs rgyas bram ze ste// 'dod la rab chags bha bhi ti// ngom med nyams bral bhe lo sha/ da ni dus 'das nyi ma 'dra// bdag gis gdams pa 'di bris pas// rim gyis lam la rtsol 'gyur shog /shes rab brtsam pa dus kyi gtam zhes bya ba bhaṅgā la'i mkhas pa dpal nges par sbyangs pa dpal ldan gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes bram ze bha lo la gdams pa rdzogs so/// / ༄༅// ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi le'u zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ sa mā dhi sam+bha ra pa ri wat+ta/ bod skad du/ ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi le'u/ 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal la lo// dang po snying rje'i stobs las byung*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems brtan bya// srid pa'i longs spyod bder ma chags// yongs su 'dzin la rgyab kyis phyogs// dad sogs nor ni phun sum tshogs// bla ma sangs rgyas dang mnyam gus// des bstan dam tshig spyod pa ni// yongs su bskyang la rab tu brtson// bum pa gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba// bla ma'i drin gyis yongs su thob// lus ngag sems ni rnam dag pa'i// sgrub pa po de dngos grub snod// ting 'dzin yan lag las byung pa'i// tshogs ni yongs su rdzogs pa las// myur du dngos grub 'thob 'gyur ba// de dag gsang sngags tshul gnas yin// ting 'dzin yan lag nyams gyur cing*// de yi mi mthun phyogs gnas na// skye ba bye ba stong gis kyang*// ting 'dzin rab tu 'grub mi 'gyur// ting nge 'dzin ni rab grub phyir// gsang sngags spyod gnas rnal 'byor pas// de las gzhan pa'i sems spangs te// g.yeng med brtson pas 'bad par bya// ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag dang*// mi mthun phyogs gang nges bya'i phyir/

ting 'dzin yan lag mi mthun phyogs// de ni mdor bsdus nas bshad bya// tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa dang*// longs spyod rnams la ltos med nyid// bzod ldan dam bca' brtan pa dang*// skye bo'i 'du 'dzi rnam par spang*// lus dang ngag nyid las rnams la// shes bzhin dang ni ldan pa dang*// sangs rgyas skur 'dogs dran pa yis// lus kyi rjes dran yang dag ldan// dus gang du ni gang bya ba'i// rjes dran de la brtan pa dang*// sgrib pa lnga ni spang ba dang*// zas kyi tshod rig spyod lam ran// 'jig rten chos 'di thams cad la// rtag tu sems ni btang snyoms dang*// yo byad bsnyung 'di yan lag ste// go ldog pa ni mi mthun phyogs// ting 'dzin tshogs kyi le'u bkod pa'i bsod nams des// 'gro bas ting 'dzin rdo rje lta bu 'thob par shog /ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi le'u slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// ༄༅// 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ lo ka a tī ta sab+ta ka bi dhiḥ bod skad du/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal rdo rje sems dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag gnas phyag byed phyag rnams ni// gang tshe tha dad mi dmigs pa// de 'dir bsngags pa'i phyag yin te// rdo rje'i phyag ces brjod pa yin// mchog gnas mchod byed mchod pa rnams// gang tshe sna tshogs mi dmigs pa// de tshe mchod pa chen po ste// rdo rje'i mchod pa zhes brjod do// bshags bya 'chags byed bshags pa rnams// gang tshe rnal 'byor pas ma mthong*// rang bzhin dag par yang dag mthong*// de 'dir bshags pa'i mchog yin no// rjes yi rang bya thams cad dang*// bdag dang rjes su yi rang ba// rnal 'byor pa yis mnyam par mthong*// rjes su yi rang dam pa yin// sgyu mas sprul pa'i sangs rgyas la// sgyu mas sprul pa'i lus can phyir// brag ca lta bu'i chos rnams ni// bstan par yang dag bskul 'debs pa// sprul pa dag dang mtshungs par ni// thal mo sbyar nas skul byed cing*// rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mnyam par mthong*// skul bar byed pa'i mchog tu 'dod// mya ngan 'dar bzhed sangs rgyas rnams// 'khor bar sprul pa bzhin du ni// sems can sprul pa'i don gyi phyir// bzhugs par gsol 'debs de nyid rig

/'jig rten 'das pa nyid kyi phyir// de 'dir gsol 'debs mchog tu 'dod// dmigs pa can du 'jug pa nyid// thams cad 'jig rten pa nyid yin// rdzogs pa'i byang chub rmi 'dra la// de nyid rig pas rmi 'drar rig /rmi 'dra'i srid par gnas pa yi// sems can rnams la phan btags pas// chos dbyings bzhin du dpag med par// dge ba thams cad yongs bsngo na// de 'dir bsngo ba dam pa ste// sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags// 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por mdzad pa rdzogs so/// / ༄༅// bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i gru bo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// paṇ+ḍi ta a dzi ta mi tā gub+tas mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ su ga ta shā sa na rat+na bha hi da dra nā ma/ bod skad du/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i gru bo zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// brtser ldan rtogs bcas lung gis phyug /smra mkhas skyo ba med yid thul// sbyangs sdom dbang po rab zhi ba'i// bla ma la btud des bstan bshad// shin tu rnyed dka'i dal ba sprin 'dra las 'bras rjes 'brel sdug bsngal can// gnas la rab dad 'gro la brtse dang chos rab rnam 'byed brtson 'grus dang*// gus pas mchog gsol cho ga bzang ldan mnyam par 'jog brtson legs bsngor bcas// bsam bya bsgrub bya rnal 'byor mchog spyod srid zhi'i rgya mtshor sgrol ba'i gru// rus sbal gyis ni gnya' shing dang*// yungs 'bru khab kyi bu gar dang*// rtsis ngos la ni sran 'bras ltar// dal ba shin tu rnyed dka' gsungs// gang phyir lus can kun gyi las// rgyun ltar thur du lhung phyir dang*// der yang mi dge 'phel phyir dang*// min yang legs spyad bya dka'i phyir// rten 'di thob dka' de bzhin du// ci tsam rnyed dka' de tsam gyis// snying po med pa'i lus 'di las// snying po dam pa btsal bar bya// de phyir bdag la legs 'dod pa'i// skyes bus don bsgrub bya ba'i phyir// rgya mtshor bying bas rnyed pa yi// gru pa lta bur lus 'di spyad// srog 'di 'dus byas yin phyir dang*// mi sdod phyir dang rkyen mang phyir// de bzhin snying po med pa'i phyir// 'chi bdag gis bdag myur za nges// lus dang longs spyod sdug pa yi// mdza' rnams rjes 'brang mi 'gyur zhing*// mgon med gcig pu gyi nar ni// 'jig rten pha rol 'dong bar byed// re zhig tshe rabs 'ga' lta zhig

/nyon mongs mi 'gyur gdeng thob pa'ang*// bdag la yong yer mi snang na// ci phyir bdag yid bde bar 'dug /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis// tshe 'di'i dgos pa khyad gsad cing*// mgo la me shor bsgrim pa bzhin// mkhas pas slad ma'i don bsgrub bya// mthong dang ma mthong myong ba yi// rnam smin rgyu mthun dbang gis las// mngar skyur kha la rang rgyu bzhin// bslu med las 'bras 'brel bar 'dod// mkha' ltar 'gag med sems nyid la// sna tshogs bag chags sprin tshogs 'khrigs// smin 'gyur char gyi rgyun babs pas// rjes myong lo thog sman par byed// chos kun rten cing 'brel 'byung zhing*// rtog med de yi rten yin te// brten pa'i rgyu 'bras gshis yin phyir// dkar nag las 'bras 'brel ba nyid// bslu med so sor nges phyir dang*// chung las che nyid 'byung phyir dang*// sngon byung da dung myong 'gyur phyir// blo ldan blang dor 'bad par rigs// de ltar las de dang de yi// 'bras bu sdug bsngal bsam yas kyis// skye rgu kun tu gdung ba yang*// me lce yis ni sol mal bzhin// de ni 'du byed 'gyur ba dang*// sdug bsngal gyi yang sdug bsngal sogs// skye rga na dang rgud dang 'chi// 'phrad bral bsrung dka' 'tshol la sogs// ji ltar bkra shis rna nag dang*// dri mi zhim dang mi gtsang bzhin// sdug bsngal nye bar len pa la/ lhan skyes rtag tu 'brel ba yin// rmongs rnams sdug bsngal gyis skrag bzhin// de yi rgyu la dga' mgur spyod// mi gang nad la dug bzhin du// shes pas gnyis spong de mkhas pa// bskal mang rnyed dka'i dal ba legs rnyed brag rum u dum wā ra bzhin// gang thob srog 'di'ang brtan du mi rung ri gzar khrod kyi klu rgyun 'dra// lus can rnams kyi dkar nag las kyang sa bon dang ni lo tog mtshungs// 'di dag tu ni sdug bsngal gdung ba'ang me 'obs 'bar ba'i me lce bzhin// zhes bya ba ni bsam par bya ba'i gnas gzhi'i chos mdor bsdus pa'o//

skyabs gsum thar pa las 'bras la// rab dang mngon 'dod yid ches dang*// rnyog med yid gzhungs rnam par nges// gus sbyor the tshom med par rgyu// yon tan shes pa nyid dang de// cig shos skyon mthong yid 'byung bcas// rtags myong khong du chud gyur la// brten nas dad pa 'thob par 'gyur// bya ba kun sngon 'gro phyir dang*// byed pa yi ni rgyu nyid phyir// sa bon 'tshigs las myu gu bzhin// chos kun spro ba med la min// 'di ni gang la rab dad yod// de yis dngos gang bsgrub dka' ba// de yang gzhan gyis bya sla bas// rab tu sla bas 'grub par 'gyur// sems can chos dang chos nyid la// brtser rtogs mtshan ma med snying rje// mi bzod mngon du byed rtog med// don shes dri ma zad sbyor rgyu// gnyen tshogs sdug bsngal mthong dran dang*// gang zag chos bdag med nyid dang*// rig lung man ngag gis phye bas// mthong phyir gzhan zhugs brtse ba skye// sku gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i rgyu// rin chen sems kyi rgyu phyir dang*// ji ltar khab la khab len bzhin// 'gro ba sdud par bya phyir te// de bzhin de yi khyad par gyis// rgyal sras mdzad pa mthar phyin phyir// sman shing ljon pa lta bu yi// phun tshogs snying rje bskyed par byos// sgyu mas sprul pa'i grong khyer du// skyes bu de dag dga' dang gdung*// yul dus rnam kun shin tu ba// snang mtshungs don ma grub rtogs shes// ma 'gags mu mthar thug min dang*// skye ba med las skye phyir ni// snang 'gyur gang skyes skye med dang*// rten 'brel rtsa ba zad phyir stong*// de la gang snang la sogs phyir// 'khor ba de nyid de tshe der// dpyad na mkha' ltar dben pa ni// rang bzhin mya ngan 'das par brjod// de ni mi rtogs rtogs dka' zhing*// rtogs na nges par grol 'gyur phyir// rab zab zab cing ngo mtshar che// mkhas pas 'dzin pa rnam par gzhig

/'bras bu bzang rnams mthong nyid dang*// 'grub pa 'bad pa la rag phyir// rgyun 'brel goms pas don thob shes// bsam rtsom phyir mi ldog brtson 'grus// gzhan skyon 'di yis yon tan rig /gnyid sogs snyom bral zhum med dang*// thabs sbyangs snying brtan brtul phod dpa'// skal ldan spro ba rnam par 'phel// rlung med rnam g.yo mi 'byung bzhin// brtson bral legs spyad ga la yod// spro ldan skad cig nyid la yang*// ri rab thal bar brlag sems bskyed// kye ma hoḥgazhan du yid brtan med// nying mtshams tshe na long med de// gson tshe'ang bsil khang mar me bzhin// ci phyir bdag blo dal bar gnas// bdag nyid pad+mo dmar gsal rab dga' dri med dad pa'i nyi zer 'bar bas rnam phye ba// mtha' yas 'gro la brtse ba'i chab brlan rjes chags ut+pal mig gi rdzi rab sprugs nas ni// sna tshogs snang sems shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rten cing 'brel 'byung rang bzhin stong pa nyid rig dang*// srid pa'i dgra tshogs skyon mang gis skrag pang du sbrul 'ongs rtsol ba bzhin du brtson par bya// zhes bya ba ni bsgrub par bya ba'i gnas gzhi'i chos mdor bsdus pa'o// srid zhi'i skyon yon dran byas nas// bdag dang gzhan gyi don bsgrub phyir// yid bzhin nor la byi dor bzhin// de nas dngos grub mchog gsol bya// gang phyir bskal pa brgya phrag tu// 'bad kyang phyogs tsam mi rnyed pa// gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la thob byed phyir// rgyun gyi rnal 'byor cho ga yis// ji bzhin mngon du byas nas su// re ba nyid dang gdung ba dang*// gus pas rten gnyis gsol ba gdab// gang tshe lhar bcas bla ma yi// byin rlabs snying la gang babs pa// de tshe shel ltar dwangs pa yi// sems thob spro bas rnon par 'gyur// rnam dag gsum gyis bsgyur byas nas// 'od gsal gyis ni dri med bya// zung du 'jug pas ye shes te// dbang phyug sbyor bas phrin las bsgrub// lha dang sngags dang ting 'dzin nyid// snang grag dran pa nyid med nyid// sna tshogs bral ba kun snang zhing*// gang snang gzhan gyi dbang can no// 'di dag lus ngag yid rim bzhin// dri ma 'khrud par byed phyir dang*// mchog byed ro gcig byed pa'i phyir// don sgrub byed phyir rnam par gzhag

/bdag nyid rtogs par byed phyir dang*// rtogs pas grol phyir grol ba nyid// gzhan don rnam par 'phrul ba'i phyir// lam 'di theg gzhan las khyad 'phags// rnal 'byor chen po rang gi sems// dri med rab dang sim byed phyir// mkha' dang zla 'od bden mthong bzhin// mi rtog 'di gsal bde chen brjod// sgyu ma nyid dang der snang dang*// de bdag ji bzhin chos rnams kun// sems yin de nyid 'od gsal phyir// blo mchog rnam par mi rtog go /rang bzhin kun tu ma 'gags shing*// rnam pa sna tshogs rang snang ba// kun khyab rnyog pa med mtshan nyid// skal bzang 'od gsal ting 'dzin bshad// mchog mthong phyir dang rdul med phyir// dngos bral dngos la byang chub phyir// chags bral zag pa med rab zhi// sim gyur bde ba chen por 'dod// de ltar 'dir skyes dge ba yang*// mtshan ma med cing rgya che nyid// stong nyid snying rjer bcas sems kyis// mchog spyod sku gnyis legs bsngor bya// rmi lam yul gyi 'du byed bzhin// gang phyir gang du gang gis gang*// ji ltar bsgrub pa mi dmigs phyir// dge ba mtshan ma med par gsungs// dmigs med dmigs par rab gsal ba// ngo ba ngo bo med rjes 'brel// rnam lnga yan lag snang ba'i gzhi// rgyal sras rnams kyi tshogs rab yin// gang gis chos shes gang zag shes// shes rab thabs bcas chags bral chags// mi gnas mya ngan 'das bsngo ba// bdag nyid chen po'i ngo mtshar rmad// gang snying cod pan chu skyes dmar rgyas lha mchog gis mtshan rdzogs sangs stong ldan mgon pos brgyan// phyi nang gsang bdag dri med ye shes lhan cig skyes rol 'od kyi sbyor bas rnam par rtsen// sprin bral mkha' dang zla rgyas zer ltar dag cing rab gsal bde chen yid rab sim pa dang*// gang skyes dge tshogs rin chen mda' de'ang brtse ba'i gzhus bskyod 'gro la yongs 'phen de dpa' bo// zhes bya ba ni rnal 'byor du bya ba'i gnas gzhi'i chos mdor bsdus pa'o//

srid mtsho rab gnag nyon mongs chu srin kha gdengs gnas// sdug bsngal rlabs 'khrugs gting mtha' med mngon 'jigs pa dang*// zhi ba mching bu'i mtsho chen dkar 'khyil gnyis ka las// sgrol byed bstan pa rin chen gru mchog bzang 'di yin// legs sbyar bdag blo rab dang dga' ba dang*// snying brtse yid gzhungs 'bad byas dge ba 'dis// 'gro rnams sngon gyi rgyal bas ma bsgral ba// de dag legs sgrol ded dpon mchog bdag gyur// bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i gru bo zhes bya ba grub pa brnyes pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po a dzi ta mi tā gub+tas mdzad pa rdzogs so/// / ༄༅// dpal 'ching ba rnam par grol ba'i bstan bcos zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal niṣ+ka laṅkas mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ shra ban+dha bi muk+ta shās+t+ra/ bod skad du/ dpal 'ching ba rnam grol gyi bstan bcos/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig ma rtogs rtogs dka' rtogs na de nyid dus// 'ching ba mi bzad shin tu grol dka' 'grol 'gyur ba// bdag dang gzhan don phun tshogs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lam// ngo mtshar de ni 'gro ba bsgral phyir bdag gis bshad// gyad kyi nor bu la sogs bzhin// snying po de ni gzhan mi gnas// gang phyir thams cad rang gis rang*// 'ching dang grol bar 'gyur ba'i phyir// 'dir ni 'ching ba gang yang med// 'ching ba gang yin des grol pa'o// de ni stong dang rten 'brel 'jug /de phyir rmongs pas mi rtogs so// dman dang log pa'i bshes gnyen gyis// zin gyur bsod nams brtson 'grus zhan// sbyangs stobs blo gros chung ba yi// skye bo rnams kyis rtogs dka' 'o// rtogs ldan snying brtse man ngag mkhas// bshes gnyen dam pa btsal bar bya// de ni srog lus longs spyod sogs// rnam kun dri med gus pas bsten// ji srid bdag sems brtan gyur pa// de srid lus dang grib ma bzhin// de yis rjes su bstan pa ni// rten 'brel stong nyid bdud rtsi'i chu// skom pas gdungs la chu bsil bzhin// dga' mgu mi zad dang bas btung*// lam gzhan phun tshogs nges 'byung med// de shes thabs dang shes rab yin// de ni chos sgo kun gyis sgo// rtogs dka' rtogs byed dam pa'i lam// ji ltar rten 'brel tsam nyid phyir// de ni ji ltar stong ma yin// gang phyir stong pa nyid yin na// de ni mkha' ltar 'gag med phyir// ci phyir rten cing 'brel mi 'byung*// de phyir de gnyis gnyis ma yin// de la rten 'brel ji lta bu// de yi stong nyid gang zhe na// nyon cig 'di ltar snang ba'i dngos// dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab gsal ba// sna tshogs bde dang sdug bsngal sogs// 'di dag rang byung rgyu med min// rgyu gzhan ma yin ma nges min// mngar skyur kha la rang rgyu bzhin// sems nyid rten cing 'brel bar 'byung*// ji ltar mkha' la sprin bzhin no// kye ma srid pa'i nags tshal du// sdug bsngal lo 'bras cher lhags shing*// nyes par spyod pa'i yal ga can// 'dzin pa'i me tog rab gsal ba'o// de rgyu chags sdang tshul min sdong*// bdag tu lta ba'i rtsa brtan te// mi shes bag chags bcas drod gsher// sa chen 'byung ba las bskyed pa'o// mkha' la snod kyi 'jig rten ltar// e ma hoḥrten med brten gyur pa// rten bral brten pa rnams kyi mchog

/re zhig rten ni ma grub na// brten pa ji ltar rnams gzhag rung*// bdag med de ltar bden min na// des bskyed chags sogs las rnams sogs// gang du ji ltar nges par bya// de ma grub na sdug bsngal gang*// de myong nyid kyang su zhig brjod// ji ltar sdong po'i rtsa byung na// gcad pa'i bya ba grub pa ltar// gzhir gyur bdag rtog rnam ldog pas// mkhas pas de bzhin srid pa gzhig /bsregs bcad bdar ba'i gser sogs bzhin// 'di ltar bdag dang gzhan pa zhes// bya ba ji ltar rten dang gnas// ngo bo mtshan nyid brtag par byos// de la lus ngag rlung dang yid// phyi nang bar sogs 'di dag ni// nam yang rten byed gnas gyur pa// sus kyang nges par mi nus so// gang phyir bdag de snang rung na// dmigs gyur dmigs pa med pa'i phyir// mi snang sems dang sems min smros// sems ni rang bzhin stong bdag nyid// sems min mi rtag rten 'brel bdag /rnam par dpyad na spros med do// brtag par bya ba 'gal ba'i phyir// gang na ci 'dra bdag bstan byos// mdor na 'dir mang smra mi bya// bdag de rang gi sgo gsum las// gzhan na 'dir gnod ci zhig bya// mtshon gyis rma ltar nyes pa yang*// byis pa rnams kyi rang rtags dang*// log sred skye bo'i rtsod par zad// gzhan min de dag rnam dpyad na// ji ltar gang zhig bdag tu 'gyur// de min de rten de gnas gang*// gang yang 'di dag de rten dang*// de gnas phyogs kyang rnam dpyad kyi// tshul 'dis bdag dngos bdag mtshan nyid// sgyu ltar legs grub bstan pa yin// ltos shig lus 'di chu shing 'dra// ngag ni brag ca mkha' 'dra'i yid// rdul tsam dmigs pa yod min na// 'di la ji ltar bdag tu brtag /phyi ni phyi rol nang yang gzhan// des na par yang de bdag min// gang yang de ni dkar sogs dang*// ring dang thung dang sbom dang phra// mthug dang srab ces bya la sogs// mtshan nyid nges par nus ma yin// ci ste shing la 'khri shing bzhin// de ni kun gzhi'i bag chags la// brten te mi mngon gnas she na// snang dang mi snang rnam dpyad dang*// de nyid sems dang sems min zhes// sngar bzhin brtag pa mtshungs par 'gyur// 'on te sems ni gang yin pa// de nyid bdag ces bya zhe na// sems 'di dmigs med 'od gsal phyir// da ni bdag de bdag med gyur// e ma'o shin tu rtogs dka'i gnas// e ma'o shin tu rmad// e ma'o mkhas pas shes par rung*// e ma'o shes bral shes pa'i dbyings// de ltar 'gro ba 'di na bdag

/med kyang nga dang nga yir zhes// gzung dang 'dzin pas brlabs pa yi// skye bo smyos pa 'di dag ci// 'on kyang 'jig rten log pas mig /bsgribs nas gzung dang 'dzin par ni// ji ltar snang ba ji bzhin gzhag /snang la snang ltar rab chags srid// sdug bsngal 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyu// bdag cag de las 'da' min nam// gal te bdag nyid ma grub kyang*// de 'dzin nyid du bden zhe na// 'di nyid e hoḥ'agro kun gyi// log par 'ching ba mi bzad pas// mgo la me shor bsgrim pa bzhin// rings par myur du ldog par bya// grogs dag 'di ltar mngon sum du// yang dag rig pa'i mig nyid kyis// bdag de ma grub des na 'dir// gzhan zhes bya ba'ang yod min na// yu bu thams cad nga snyam dang*// nga'o snyam dang gzhan snyam dang*// gzhan gyi'o zhes log rtog pa// 'di dag ji ltar gang du dog /dper na rmi lam bu shi ba// bu nyid med na de shi yang*// bden par yod pa ma yin pa// de bzhin yu bu'i 'dzin pa yang*// e ma'o shin tu ngo mtshar gnas// gang zhig gcig nyid rtogs pa yis// thams cad rnam par grol 'gyur ba// 'di la the tshom su zhig skrag /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// phung po khams dang skye mched sogs// theg gsum theg gsum nges 'byung lam// ma lus bdag min gzhan gyi min// bdag med stong pa'i mtshan nyid de// med phyir med la med nyid du// tshul bzhin nges par byas pa la// kye ma khyod la skyon ci yod// gang gang bdag dang bdag gir zhes// 'dzin pa'i 'ching ba thams cad kyang*// phyi min nang min bar yang min// de bzhin lus ngag yid ma yin// de dag las min der gnas min// de bzhin chags dang sdang sogs kyis// ma lus yid la byed pa yang*// dpyad na re zhig gang la yang*// gang la gang gis chags pa dang*// sdang bar gyur pa'ang ga la yod// gzugs sdug sgra snyan dri zhim dang*// ro mngar reg 'jam yid bde'i rkyen// 'di dag gang gis de shes la// ci zhig phan btags 'brel ba yod// de shes pas kyang de dag la// chags dang rab tu chags 'gyur gang*// de ni phyi nang bar dag dang*// lus sogs dngos po gang zhig yin// de min de la de brten dang*// skye dang gnas dang 'gag 'gyur ba// sgyu ma yi ni rta glang ltar// don du grub pa yod ma yin// gang gis bdag la brnyas sogs dang*// smad sogs brdeg sogs byas pa'i rgyu// sdang dang rab sdang sems 'byung ba// 'di yang sngar bzhin bdag sems dang*// gang yang pha ral de yi sems// mkha' 'dra mtshan ma med pa yin// de bzhin gzhan de'i ngag nyid dang*// lus ni gri sgra shing lta bu// yin na sgyu mas sgyu ma la// brgyabs ltar des 'dir bdag bsnad gang*// bdag gi'ang de bzhin ngag dang lus// de ltar lus can thams cad kyi'ang*// mtshungs phyir 'di dag skye ba dang*// gnas dang 'gag 'gyur mi dmigs so// gang phyir phan tshun 'brel med phyir// dpyad na thams cad spros med phyir// yul dus rnam kun dri med phyir// mkha' la 'phur ba'i bya rjes bzhin// de ltar stong pa'i spyod yul 'dir// rmi lam sgra dang 'ja' bzhin du// gang la gang zhig ji ltar chags// de bzhin sdang ba'ang gang du dog

/pha dang ma dang chung ma bu// gnyen dang bshes pa de bzhin dgra// sgyu ma ji bzhin de bzhin pas// 'dzin pa thams cad gzhig par bya// de nyid kyis na chags sogs kyis// las byed de yang ji lta bu// yang yang shes rab brtan po yis// mkhas pas sngar bzhin brtag par byos// de phyir bde dang sdug bsngal yang*// bem pos rnam par myong min la// rig par dngos po yod min te// thog med dus nas log sgyangs pa// 'khrul pas 'dzin pa nyi tshe ba// de yang dngos po med pa nyid// de ltar med la med nyid du// blo bzang rnams kyis goms byas na// smyos pas gnyen la dgra bzhin du// mi bzad 'ching bas bcings pa de// sbrul mdud rang gis grol ba bzhin// nges par rnam par grol bar 'gyur// rnam grol rnam grol las byung ba'i// 'bras bu lhun gyis grub pa gang*// don gnyis phun tshogs ngo mtshar ba// de ni bum pa bzang po bzhin// dpal 'ching ba rnam grol gyi bstan bcos rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen po grub pa brnyes pa'i dpal niṣ+ka laṅkas mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shrī dza ga ta mi twa a nan+da'i zhal snga nas kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bud+dha shrī bha dras gtan la phab nas/ bod kyi lo chung gnubs tshul khrims shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o//

༄༅// lta spyod rnam dag gi man ngag ces bya ba bzhugs so// kha che paṇa chen gyis mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ bi shud+dha dar+sha nā tsar+ya u pa de sha nā ma/ bod skad du/ lta spyod rnam dag gi man ngag ces bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo// rmi lam lta bur phyi rol med// sgyu ma lta bur bden don med// nam mkha' lta bur mtshan nyid bral// chos kun rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o// 'gro 'ong gnas med byang chub sems// rgya chen sems can don la mkhas// tshogs gnyis dbyer med lam gyi mchog /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po bsgom// lta spyod rnam dag gi man ngag ces bya ba kha che'i rigs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dpal chos kyi rje shākya shrī bha dra'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /mkhas pa chen po de nyid kyi spyan sngar lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis khro phu bzang lung du bsgyur ba'o// ༄༅// sems rin pa che sbyang ba'i lam 'bras zhes bya ba bzhugs so// paṇa chen bud+dha shrī dz+nyā nas mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ tsit+ta rat+na bi sho dha nāṃ ma mārga pha la/ bod skad du/ sems rin po che sbyang ba'i lam 'bras/ rje btsun mi pham mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo// rnyed dka'i dal 'byor myur du 'jig /las dang de 'bras sdug bsngal yin// de spong shes rab snying rje bsgom// skyes gsum lam gyis don gsum thob// dam pa gsum gyis bsod nams bsag /rgya chen thabs kyis yang dag spel// shes rab zab mos rnam dag bya// zung 'jug bsngo bas rgyas gdab bo// kha che'i rigs las bal yul du sku 'khrungs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dpal gnas lnga rig pa'i mchog bud+dha shrī dz+nya na'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa'i sems rin po che sbyang ba'i lam 'bras zhes bya ba rdzogs so/// /mkhas pa chen po de nyid kyi spyan sngar lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bal yul yam 'gal gyi gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba'o//

༄༅// 'ching ba rnam grol gyi man ngag ces bya ba bzhugs so// shrī dza ga ta mi tra a nan+das mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ban+dha bi muk+ta u pa de sha nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'ching ba rnam grol gyi man ngag ces bya ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// kye hoḥgang gis 'ching bar byed pa'i rgyu// de nyid grol bar byed pa'i lam// 'di na 'ching ba gang yang med// 'ching ba gang yin des grol ba'o// 'dod chags bde ba chen por dag /zhe sdang 'od gsal me lce 'bar// gti mug rnam par mi rtog nyid// dug gsum sku gsum lhun gyis grub// 'ching ba rnam grol gyi man ngag ces bya ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shrī dza ga ta mi tra a nan+da'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa rdzogs so/// /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug de nyid kyi spyan sngar lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bal yul gu lang gser khang du bsgyur ba'o// ༄༅// grub pa dam pa'i lam nges pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mdzad pa mi gsal/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ sid+dha sata mārga nirna laṃ ta/ bod skad du/ grub pa dam pa'i lam nges pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// kha sar pā ṇi 'jig rten dpal// thugs rje chen po ston pa'i mthus// gdul dka'i rang sems 'dul ba la// snying po bla med rnam gsum thob// kye ma'o 'dzam gling skye bo nyon// 'gro ba'i bshes gnyen 'di skad smra// gang zhig 'ching bar byed pa'i rgyu// de nyid grol bar byed pa'i lam// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho sgrol ba'i gru// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che// de yi ngo bo lam dang thabs// bshes gnyen kun dga'i gdams pa yin// e ma hoḥ mi lus rin chen rnyed par dka'// rnyed dka'i dal 'byor sprin ltar g.yo// 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal te// rang sems mya ngan 'das pa yin// rgya mtshor bying bas rnyed pa'i gru// chu rgyun drag po'i dpa' dang ni// dug can sbrul gyi tshang bzhin dang*// ston gyi nam mkha'i dgung bzhin no// longs spyod ci 'dra khyim gyi sbra// shes pa ci 'dra tshong khang mi// rang lus ci 'dra sbrul gyi pags// tshe srog ci 'dra ri gzar chu// kye ma'o mi rtag srin po yi// khar chud ma gyur de srid bar// grags dag srid pa ru ldog la// bsgrim par gyis shig bzhin bzang dag

/sgyu ma'i grong khyer yangs pa na// rmi lam skyes bu longs spyod pa// sems nyid rten cing 'brel bar 'byung*// snang sems de ltar shes par bya// ltos shig lus ni chu shing 'dra// ngag ni brag ca mkha' 'dra'i yid// rdul tsam dmigs pa yod min na// bu dag gang la su zhig 'ching*// yu bu thams cad nga snyam dang*// nga'o snyam dang gzhan snyam dang*// gzhan gyi 'o zhes log rtog pa// 'di dag ji ltar gang du dog /ji ltar rmi lam bu shi ba// bu nyid med na de shi yang*// bden par yod pa ma yin pa// de bzhin yu bu'i 'dzin pa yang*// chos kun rmi lam 'dra ba'i phyir// zas gos nor dang grogs bshes dgra// sna tshogs snang ba 'di dag kun// sgyu ma yi ni rta glang bzhin// gang shar sor gzhag dran pa yis// dran pa rang grol bral ba ste// bral ba ro mnyam lhun gyis grub// snying po'i gseb lam rnam pa gsum// ༄༅// rang gis sems kyi mdud pa dgrol ba'i gdams pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mi tra a nan+das mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ swa tsit+ta yo gi gran+tha ka ta u pa de sha /bod skad du/ rnal 'byor pa rang gi sems kyi mdud pa dgrol ba'i man ngagabacom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// e ma'o gdod nas ma skyes pa// 'khor dang 'das pa'i byed rgyu can// gzhan min rang gi snying dbus nas// bla ma'i zhal las shes par 'gyur// kye hoḥbazhin bzang nga la nyon// gang gis 'ching bar byed pa'i rgyu// de nyid grol bar byed pa'i lam// 'di na 'ching ba gang yang med// rmi lam grong khyer yangs pa na// sgyu ma'i skyes bu longs spyod pa// longs spyod dus na longs spyod med// snang sems de ltar shes par bya// sna tshogs snang ba rang gi sems// de ni sprul pa'i tshogs 'dus bzhin// rang sems dbang po'i gzhu 'dra ba// gnyug ma 'od gsal lhun gyis grub// dge shar thams cad de yin te// de ni gang du'ang ma shar ba'o// de phyir gang skyes de ma skyes// ma skyes pa nyid skye ba'i tshul// me long gzugs dang pi wang sgra// dge slong sprul pa rdzu 'phrul bzhin// yod dang med dang skye 'gag dang*// 'gro 'ang mtshan nyid rtogs par gyis// sgyu ma yi ni rta glang ltar// snang ba rten cing 'brel bar 'byung*// de nyid ston gyi mkha' bzhin du// 'od gsal chos gsum sbyar bar bya// e ma'o rnal 'byor rgyal po che// e ma'o ma bcings ma grol ba'o// e ma'o ma spangs lhun gyis grub// e ma'o e ma bde ba che// ma rtogs 'gro la rang dbang du// snying rje chen po'i dbang gis na// dmigs med rnam kun yongs rdzogs pa'i// bsod nams ye shes phun tshogs 'gyur// rang gi sems kyi mdud pa dgrol ba'i gdams pa rdzogs so/// /bla ma mi tra a nan+da zhes bya ba sbas pa'i sangs rgyas de nyid bod yul kha ba can gyi mthil bkra shis kyi tshong 'dus chen po mgur mo rin po che'i gling du byon pa'i tshe/

mdo sngags kyi bdag po chen po rgya/ 'bre/ lam/ lo/ dro/ gshen drug gis zhus pa'i don du gsungs pa phyag rgya chen po chig chod kyi do ha gnubs lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'o// ༄༅// ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gnubs lo tsā bas bgyur/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ sa mā dhi a bhi ṣe ka /bod skad du/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba/ dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor los sgyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig dpal ldan bdud bzhin dgra bcom byang chub mchog dbang nyid brnyes nas// thugs rjes mi snyel lus can gzhan yang zhi ba bla med lam bzang du// smin mdzad dbang stsol sa gsum bdag po spyan ras gzigs dbang la btud de// skal ldan ting 'dzin ye shes sems spyod rnam dag dbang bskur cho ga bshad// yid 'ong gnas su bde ba yi// rkyen tshogs dam tshig kun ldan pas// snying rje chen po mdun bzhag la// gus pas sngon du gsol ba gdab// 'dom gang srid 'phags nam mkhar ni// thub pa chen po 'khor los sgyur// bde chen yum dang lhan cig skyes// dpag med sras bcas bsgom par bya// sna tshogs dngos kun mchod pa'i sprin// kun tu bzang spyod ji bzhin du// mchod byas sdig pa bsal nas su// rnam dag dbang bskur de rjes nod// lha dang bdag gnas rnam gsum du// rdo rje'i 'bru gsum mngon bsams la// dad dang thugs rje dam tshig gis// kha dog rim gsum 'od zer dbyung*// sku mchog snying po oṃ las 'od zer dkar po dang*// gsung rgyun dri med āḥlas de bzhin dmar ba'i 'od// rnam dag thugs bdag hūṃ las rnam 'phros rab sngo zer// bdag lus ngag yid gnas gsum la reg dri gsum sel// de rjes bdud rtsi dkar dmar sngo// dag byed rnam gsum man ngag bzhin// de 'og ye shes rnam gsum byug /mthar ni gnyis med bzhi pa'o// shin tu gsang ba bde ba che// thig le gsum rgyun sbyor ba ni// de rjes blo gros chen pos bsgom// dbang bskur nas ni legs par rol// ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba rdzogs so/// /gnubs lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'o//

༄༅// na mo bud+dhā ya'i 'grel pa bzhugs so// mdzad po mi gsal/ ༄༅// na/ skye ba med cing 'gag pa med// gzugs med gzugs dang ldan pa'ang med// 'khor med mya ngan 'das pa'ang med// yi ge na yis brjod pa'o// mo/ gti mug rtag tu 'jig par byed// thar pa gcig pu legs par ster// bdud dang nyon mongs 'joms par byed// yi ge ma yis brjod pa'o// bud/ sangs rgyas kyis ni pha rol gshegs// sangs rgyas 'gro ba phan pa med// sangs rgyas nyon mongs dag pa ni// yi ge bud kyis brjod pa'o// dhā/ chos rnams thams cad 'dzin pa yis// chos kyi dbyings dang bcas par ni// chos rnams nyid ni chos kyi mchog /yi ge dhā yis brjod pa'o// ya/ ji ltar gnas pa de bzhin 'jig /ji ltar 'jig pa de bzhin gnas// ji ltar smras pa de bzhin byed// yi ge ya yis brjod pa'o// na mo bud+dhā ya'i 'grel pa rdzogs so/// / ༄༅// dpal bde chen grub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon ka la pas mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā su kha sid+dhi na ma/ bod skad du/ dpal bde chen grub pa zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// dpe med 'od gsal yul 'das brjod bya med// mtshon bya mtshon byed dri med gzhi dang bral// gnyis med brjod bral dbyer med chos sku ni// kun rdzob la brten snying rje'i dbang gis ni// rmongs pa rnams la phan phyir bka' bshad bya// rgyu 'bras 'das pa chos kyi sku// ma grub sgom dang bsgom rgyu med// thog med mtha' dbus bral ba de// chos dang lte bar bcu drug gi /pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru'i dbus su ni// 'byung lnga'i thig le kha dog ldan// nyi zla kha sbyor rdo rje'i dbus// pad+ma'i 'od zer shes rab ste// rdo rje'i 'od gsal thabs yin no// dkyil 'khor drug ni rim gyis bltas// bdun pa'i rang bzhin nyams la shar// dug lnga'i sgrib pa dag 'gyur ro// kha cig thig le'i ngo bo ste// kha cig stong pa nyid du 'dod// kha cig khyab byed gzugs ldan pa// la la zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan// yang dag phyag rgya sprug dang 'dar// glu dang gar dang rol mo dang*// lha dang bzlas pa rdzogs pa ste// la la dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*// 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar ba// dbang bskur rim pa la sogs ni// dad phyir bstan pas yang dag min// rang bzhin dri med mtha' dbus bral// rang lus dkyil 'khor sems nyid yin// phung po khams kyi chon rtsi yis// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam gsum ni// rang bzhin rdul chon dkyil 'khor ro// lte dbus rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings// shar du me long ye shes te// thig le zla ba'i rang bzhin gnas// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni// zlum po'i bin+du nub tu'o// ye shes chen po mnyam pa nyid// blo 'das lho ru gru gsum mo// bya ba nan tan gru bzhi ni// byang du gnas te lha bsgom mo// de phyir gzhal yas gru bzhi ste// dran pa bzhi dang sgo bzhir ldan// mi bskyod pa yi rang bzhin gyi// dbus su 'od zer brgyad yin no// sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin yin// de ni byang sems gnyis med do// dkyil 'khor bstan nas sbyin sreg ni/

lha nyid tshim phyir bshad par bya// gnyis su med pa'i sems nyid 'di// rang bzhin hom khung shes par bya// phung po lnga bdag bud shing gis// sems kyi me ni sbar byas la// dug lnga'i rtogs pa bsreg par bgyis// de ltar sbyin sreg bshad byas nas// da ni rab gnas bstan par bya// phung po gzhal yas khang gi dbus// rab tu brtan pa'i sems nyid ni// mi g.yo rang bzhin grub pa med// de yi rang bzhin rab gnas so// rnal 'byor sngags kyi mtshan nyid la// dngos dang dngos med mtshan ma bral// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba ni// sems nyid stong pa'i sngags yin no// rang bzhin rnal 'byor gnas lugs ni// phung po lnga la brten byas la// bdag gam gzhan nyid sgrol mdzad pa// sems kyis sems nyid mtshon pa 'di// de ni rang bzhin lha nyid do// phyag rgya chen po de nyid de// sku gsung thugs la rgyas gdab bo// sna rtser mig gtad skyil krung du// mnyam bzhag phyag rgyar ldan pa yis// blor ldan sngags bshad nyams len bya// rnam par rtog med sems nyid 'di// rnal 'byor gang zhig rtogs gyur na// de ni de yi skad cig mar// sangs rgyas rnams dang 'phrad 'gyur ro// sna rtse'i thig le la sogs ni// bdag gis thog mar bshad byas pas// de ni kun rdzob don dam min// rak+ta shu kra nā sa dang*// mi bskyod rnam snang bder gshegs rnams// mtha' 'khob kla klo'i skad yin te// rtog med dam tshig sel phyir ro// dpal bde chen grub pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba slob dpon ka la pas gsungs pa rdzogs so/// /sgrub thabs bdun po 'di rat+na pha la'i rang 'gyur ro// ༄༅// rang gi sems ngal bso ba'i man ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa lnga pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// jo bo spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ swa tsit+ta bai shrā ma u pa desha pañtsi biṃ sha ti kā gā thā nā ma/

bod skad du/ rang gi sems ngal bso ba'i man ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa lnga pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// e ma'o gdod nas ma skyes pa// 'khor dang 'das pa'i byed rgyu can// gzhan min rang gi snying dbus gnas// bla ma'i zhal las shes par 'gyur// gang skyes gnyug ma nyid yin phyir// gang shar dran pa ma brjed na// de shar stong pa nyid dag tu// rnal 'byor rgyal por gdon mi za// gang shar thams cad de yin te// de ni gang du'ang ma shar ba'o// de phyir gang skyes de ma skyes// ma skyes pa nyid skye ba'i tshul// g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum sdigs mdzub gtad// rdo rje'i blta bas bltas nas ni// rta mchog dal bus 'gro 'ong la// gnas na du ma gcig tu bya// rkang pa rgya mtsho che la gzhag /lag pas sa steng kun tu nyul// mig gnyis nam mkhar blta bya ste// yid ni gang du'ang mi g.yo'o// sgeg mo'i me long stobs kyi gyad// khri btsun rgyal po'i btsun mo dang*// phyag dar ba dang smad 'tshong bzhin// gcig pur grogs dang 'grogs par byos// stag dang seng ge glang chen dang*// rnga mo khri snyan spre'u dang*// tsan+dan sdong po mi ro ltar// mkhas pas stong nyid rnal 'byor bya// ri gzar chu dang rgya mtsho che// bu gcig ma dang glang po skyong*// gangs ri dag dang shel dag bzhin// dmigs bral gyur na gzhi tshugs pa'o// thog ma bar dang mthar rim bzhin// rtsa ba ngo bo byed bral ba// rmi lam gyi ni mar me bzhin// snying brtse mi g.yo goms pas 'grub// 'gro 'ong gnas ni skye gnas 'gag /rnam dag stong pa nyid rnam gsum// bde chen 'od gsal rnam mi rtog /blo bzang rnams kyis mnyam par bzhag /snying rje chen po mdun bzhag ste// de nyid ma yengs rtag blta zhing*// lha dang bla ma'i sbyor ba yis// sgrub pa po ni ngal bso bya// bu nyon khyod gang rnam par rtog

/'dir bdag ma bcings ma grol phyir// ma yengs ma bcos rang gar ni// kye hoḥdub pa ngal sos shig /gzugs brnyan gzugs dang brag ca'i sgra// dngos dang rmi lam dran pa'i yid// ting nge 'dzin dang 'brel ba dang*// zad par goms pa'i sbyor ba'o// so sor rtog dang rten bral dang*// rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad sgom pa// gser bzhin me bzhin nam mkha' bzhin// shes byed zhi byed dag par byed// snang med de snang rkyen gyis snang*/ nam mkha' me long shel bzhin te// ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes dang*/ gzugs kyi sgo yis de rtogs byed// mthong ba mnyam bzhag 'od gsal te// de tshe de mthong de ma skyes// shin tu mi rtog rtse gcig gnas// g.yeng ba'i rdul dang bral ba nyid// rlung ni gar 'gro der sems 'gro// de lus khyim nang btson bzung nas// yid kyi skyes bu gsad byas na// de med sems ni gang du 'gro// thams cad rang bzhin ma bcos pa// kun rtog thams cad rkyen gyi dbang*// rang bzhin gsum gyis de shes na// kun rtog kun rtog med par byed// mthong bas grub dang bshig pa dang*// med ces rnam par rtog par zad// 'di la gdod nas ci yang med// bu kye nam mkha' bsgom par byos// ga bur dang ni de yi dri// phan tshun de med de yang med// de bzhin rkyen dang rkyen bral gang*// so so ma yin rang gar bsgom// mnyam pa'i sems kyi g.yo ba 'gog /mi mnyam dran pas 'ching bar byed// de tshe de dang bral mnyam gzhag /rnam par rtog pa gsod par byed// khrus byas nam mkha'i gos gyon la// rnam par rtog pa sbyin sreg bya// dran pa'i thal ba 'jug ngogs su// chu klu lhan cig sbyang bar gyis// snod bcud rlung rgyun brtan g.yo mkha'// nyi ma zla ba sgra gcan 'dzin// me khyer char dang bung ba'i dpes// dam tshig phyag rgya dbang du 'gyur// sna tshogs yid kyi me tog las// dga' ba rnam bzhi'i bcud blangs te// lhan cig skyes pa'i ro myangs pas// yid kyi skyes bu tshim par 'gyur// lus rlung rtsa chen phyag rgya yis// lus ngag yid ni bcing bar bya// drad thob pa la thogs pa med// kun spyod nges par mi bya'o// rnal 'byor pa rang gi sems ngal bso bar byed pa'i man ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa lnga pa zhes bya ba de kho na nyid rnal du mtshon par byed pa'i do ha rdzogs so/// /jo bo spyan ra sa gzigs dbang phyug las man ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa 'di nyid dngos su gsan nas grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shri dza ga ta mi tra a nan+da dang*/
lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis dpal gu lang gser khang gi nags khrod aṃ ba ra par ta'i bsil khang du bsgyur ba'o//

༄༅// rtogs pa brjod pa sum cu pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rnal 'byar gyi dbang phyug mi tra dzo kis mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ triṃ shat+ti a ba bha ṣa/ bod skad du/ rtogs pa brjod pa sum cu pa/ jo bo spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ rdo rje 'dzin pa tshangs dbang gtsug /chu skyes che dbus 'jig rten mgon// 'od zer rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas// e ma dri gsum dag mdzad rmad// brtan pa'i lus ni ri bo 'dra// spros bral sems ni nam mkha' ste// g.yo ba'i sems ni rlung rgyun bcings// tshul 'dis rnal 'byor bdag legs grol// yid ni khyab 'jug nam mkha' ste// 'khor lo lnga yi rang bzhin lus// srog rtsol nyi ma zla ba gnyis// bde chen rdo rje'i zhags pas bcings// dri ma lnga ni ye shes sbyangs// lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs// de dag ma bcos skye ba med// e ma 'di na bsgom bya gang*// rgya mtsho'i snying po me 'bar bas// ri rab srog shing shing rta brgyud// tshangs dbang rtse nas char rgyun 'babs// thabs kyis thabs bral de la ltos// gang ma rig pa de stong nyid// kun nas dkris pa bde ba'i tshal// zhe sdang 'bar bas 'od gsal che/ lha mchog mi de gang gis 'ching*// lte ba'i mar mes mun pa bsal// snying gar shes rab pad+ma rgyas// spyi gtsug ye shes bde chen 'dzag /da ni rang lus dngos grub 'gyur// rtsa gsum 'khor lo 'dus pa'i dbus// bde chen dwangs ma'i thig le gnas// de dbus rnam par mi rtog pa// ye shes mig gcig dri med nyid// gzung 'dzin mun par rtogs pa'i 'od// nam mkha' la ni nyi shar bzhin// der yang mi gnas gzhan du'ang min// kye hoḥshin tu zab pa'i gnas/ 'jig rten thams cad nam mkhas bcings// nam mkha' de yi sprin gyis bsgribs// gang tshe rtog pa'i sprin dag pa// de tshe 'di la ci zhig snang*// sgyu ma sgyu ma'i grong khyer bcom// sems kyi sems nyid bslu ba ste// 'di nas bdag 'dras bslu med rig

/e ma'o e ma bla ma'i drin// 'og ni las kyi 'khor los bsdam// bar ni rdo rje'i mdud pas bcing*// steng du yi ge gyen du bsgyur// thabs 'di bdag gis rang las rnyed// lus ni ri bo 'drar byas la// ngag ni rlung rgyun lta bur bsdam// sems ni nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// dbyer med chos nyid kun gyi dngos// brtan lus shing rta rab bcas pa// g.yo ba srog shing lam du gzhug /de ltar bcings pa'i ting 'dzin ni// 'chi med nam mkha'i dngos grub thob// nam mkha'i rnal 'byor rnam mi rtog /yongs dag lha ni bde ba che// de yi zung 'jug 'od gsal nyid// gnas 'dir ngal bso mkhas pa dag /rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje 'chang*// rdo rje rgyal po rdo rje bde// rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpas stong*// e ma rdo rje kun rig pa'o// me tog mthong gi rtsi mi mthong*// chab rom mthong gi chu ma yin// lus mthong bde ba blang bar gyis// sems mthong ba ni ma mchis so// chu nang skyes bu su yi bu// rmi lam grong khyer bdag po med// me long gzugs ni gang las 'ong*// 'gro ba 'di kun de dang 'dra// gang na gnas dang skye ba dang*// 'gag 'gyur yul rgyu dus med pa// nam mkha'i mtshan nyid chos 'di la// kye hoḥ'ajig pa gang zhig yod// 'di dag snang ba snang brnyan tsam// rig pa de yang rig pas dben// thams cad rig snyam shes snyam ste/ tsam snyam de la'ang snyam nyid med// skyes bu don kun grub pa 'di// zhe sdang nyi ma 'od gsal lha// 'dod chags zla ba bde bas spyod// gti mug sgra gcan mi rtog 'joms// nam mkha'i sprin dang rgya mtsho'i rlabs// me tog rtsi dang ga bur dri// me long gzugs dang shel dkar bzhin// rnam rtog mi rtog dngos dbyer med// 'gro ba 'di dag las las skyes// las kyis nyon mongs de yi rgyu// mtshan ma yin te de shes na// skyes bu mtshan med rnam par grol// rtog pa'i glang chen lcags kyus dgug

/sems kyi bung ba rtsi yis bsdu// ting 'dzin ngang pa mtsho nang rtse// shes rab pad+mo nyi zer 'byed// yid kyi mar mes mun pa sel// bde ba'i me tog bung bas 'jibs// 'dzin pa'i rba rlabs rgya mtshor thim// bde sdug sprin de nam mkhar dengs// yi ge gsum gyi brdas mtshon nas// yi ge med pa bdag go rtogs// rnal 'byor rgyal po yi ge mchog /sems las gzhan ni ma mchis so// gang du 'gro med 'gro ba 'di// gnas zhes bya bar ga la 'gyur// gang mi gnas pa chos kyi dbyings// de la ji ltar 'gag 'gyur sems// rtag tu byed bral gti mug med// khong khro bag chags gtan bcom pa// zhi ba'i dam pa mya ngan 'das// gter chen rang la yod shes kyi// 'jig rten sgyu ma'i las kyis bsgrub// sgyu ma sgyu ma'i yid kyis te// 'di kun sgyu ma nyid shes na// sgyu ma lta bur rnam par grol// sgyu ma rtogs pas bden rtog 'joms// rtog med sgyu ma la mi gnas// mi gnas 'gro la phan brtson pas// e ma nor bu rin chen rnyed// rtogs pa brjod pa sum cu pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so/// /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po mi tra dzo ki de nyid kyi spyan sngar gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// ༄༅// shin tu spros pa med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bir+wa pas mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ su ni pra pañtsa tat+t+wa u pa de sha nā ma/ bod skad du/ shin tu spros pa med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag ces bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// stong nyid snying rje gcig pa'i sku// srid gsum bde chen ngo bo nyid// spros pa'i dri mas ma gos pa'i// bla ma rdo rje can zhabs 'dud// lo gsum bar du rnyed dka' ba// bla ma mchog gi bka' drin gyis// skad cig nyid la 'char ba ni// bla ma nye bar bsten par bshad// shin tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod du// 'jig rten chos la ltos med pa'i// rnam rtog kun spangs dpa' bos ni// dog pa med par bsgrub par bya// blo gros mchog ldan sgrub pa pos// gza' skar tshes grangs 'dir med de// dkyil 'khor la sogs lha rnams dang*// phyi rol bkod pa 'dir mi dgos// bsam gtan bzlas pa yod ma yin// bsreg blugs dang ni gtor ma med// phyag rgya bcing dang 'khrul 'khor sogs// phyi rol g.yeng ba kun spangs te// brtser ldan gzhan gyi don sems pa// bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten nas// skad cig nyid la dngos grub 'gyur// thog mar bla ma lhar bcas la// maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing mchod gsol gdab// gsang sngags rgyal po rjes dran nas// sems ni dag cing las rung 'gyur// bla ma dang ni rdo rje sems// tha dad par ni mi bya ste// bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang ni// de bzhin dge 'dun bla ma ste// dngos grub go 'phang mchog 'dod pas// kun nas bla ma mnyes par bya// sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje 'chang*// rtsod pa'i dus 'dir bdag don du// kun dang mthun par ston mdzad pa// de ltar shes nas dngos kun gyis// bsten bya dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi// dngos grub rgya chen snod du 'gyur// srid pa'i rtsa ba nyon mongs dang*// bdag 'dzin la sogs ma lus pa// zhen pa med pa'i sems kyis ni// ltos pa med par gtang bar bya// dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma la// bsam pa thag pas skyabs song pas// lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa gang*// bag la nyal dang bcas las grol// sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes ni// rdo rje rnam dag dbyer med 'gyur// 'di nyid gsal zhing stong pa dang*// rig pa de nyid ma 'gags pa// rang rig ye shes skad cig ma// 'dir ni thog ma dbus mtha' med// srid med mya ngan 'das pa med// bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste// 'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid// 'di nyid gsal zhing stong pa nyid// 'di las mtshon te shes par bya// 'di ni rang bzhin sku gsum dang*// ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can// sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// sangs rgyas gzhan du bstan du med// sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes sa sku// gzhan du btsal bas rnyed ma yin// chos kun stong pa nyid rtogs pas// 'gro la snying rje rgyun mi 'chad// thabs mkhas spyod pa mtha' yas pa// yul dang dngos po med pa'o// sgyu ma lta bur 'dzin med pa// rgya chen bsod nams tshogs la 'bad// rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// srid pa'i rgya mtshor nub byed yin// rtog pa'i 'ching ba las grol ba// de tshe mchog gi lam rnyed do// phyi rol yul gyi 'ching byed rnams// bu ga dgu nas snying gar bsdu// gang gi rnam rtog zug rngu yang*// spyi gtsug nas ni rkang mthil bar// me shel tsam du snying gar dgug

/snying gi bu ga gsal por dbye// skar mda' 'phong ba ji lta bar// rgya mtsho'i mthar thug spro bar bya// rtog pa dang ni bral ba yi// lus 'di bde ba can der song*// yi ge gsum gyi gsang sngags brjod// mkha' dang rang rig stong pa nyid// ro gcig nam mkha' ye shes bsgom// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs kyi gsang chen bla na med// 'di ni srid dang zhi las grol// blang dang dor ba ci yang med// bde ba dang ni sdug bsngal dang*// bdud dang nyon mongs yod ma yin// lha dang srin po 'dir med de// nad dang sdug bsngal gyis mi gos// 'dis ni bdud dang nyon mongs 'joms// 'joms byed bcom ldan 'das zhes bya// de la gzhan pa gang yin pa// chos kun gnyen por mi 'gyur te// thams cad rtog pa yin phyir ro// rtog pa'i 'ching bas bcing bar 'gyur// de nyid rnal 'byor pas shes nas// phyi dang nang dang gzhan rnams kyi// spros pa'i drwa ba rnam par gcad// yul gyi 'dzin pa rnam par gzhig /stong pa nyid la gtod legs na// rtog pa'i drwa ba spong bar 'gyur// rten dang brten pa rnam par dbye// mnyam par gzhag pa goms par bya// de nas byang chub sems bskyed pa'i// bla ma'i man ngag bshad par bya// bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi sku// 'og min bde chen der bsgoms te// mi phyed bsam pas gsol ba gdab// mthar phyin tsa na rang la bstim// thog med bsags pas sbyangs pa yi// drin chen rnams la snying rje bsam// gnod byed 'di rnams bdag gi ma// sngon tshe yang yang phan btags kyang*// smyon pa bzhin du rang dbang med// mi dge'i las kyis mnar med 'gyur// de ltar dran pas srid gsum la// snying rje mthar phyin 'gyur ba yin// phyi nang spros pa mi srun pas// blo gros shin tu 'khrugs pa'i tshe// bdag dang gzhan du brje ba yi// byang chub sems 'dir dran par bya// des ni bdud dang nyon mongs tshogs// 'joms shing spros med nyid du 'gyur// srog 'gag pa yi sbyor ba yis// goms par byed pa'i rnal 'byor pas// ji ltar rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis// lus 'di rnam dag sbyang bar bya// dgang ba'i sbyor bas spyi gtsug nas// rkang mthil bar du dgang byas la// rngub pa'i sbyor bas zhi bar bya// dang po srub cing bsrub par bya// gnyis pa rgya mtsho bskyod pa ste// gsum pa gsad pa nor lha gnyis// bzhi pa yan lag brkyang bskum 'dis// phyogs bzhi g.yo zhing srid gsum skrag

/'di yi sbyor ba goms byas na// nad kun las ni gol 'gyur zhing*// 'di ltar rgud dang rgas pa dang*// 'chi bdag thag ring kun rtog 'joms// srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol zhing*// spros med ye shes go 'phang thob// dag pa'i bzhi mnyam blang bya ste// gla ba yis ni dug med 'gyur// gan ji dang ni ba ru ra// sga skya dang ni lhan cig byas// bu ram mar dang sbrang rtsir bcas// gsang sngags bzlas shing zhag bdun bsgrub// dam tshig brtan ldan rnal 'byor pas// nangs par dus su bsten par bya// skra dkar gnyer ma la sogs spong*// dbang po rnams ni mchog tu gsal// lus kyi mdog rgyas zo mdog bde// mkha' 'gro rnams kyis byin gyis brlab// bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin dang*// spros med ye shes go 'phang thob// rdo rje 'jig byed sbyor ba yis// rgyal ba'i tshogs su mnyes byas te// snying gi kun rdzob sna rtse nas// sor bzhi bcal nas dbu mar gzhug /nor bu'i bar du srid 'dzin pa// steng gi dag pas zin pa yin// phyag na rdo rje gzung bya ste// g.yas pa'i mthil gyis bum par sbyor// tsak+ṣuḥgyen du blta bar bya// cig shos g.yo bar mi byed de// ba thag tsam yang mi 'byung ngo*// gal te phyi rol byung ba na// mkha' 'gro rnams kyis tshar gcad do// 'og rlung bsdams pas dgra tshogs zhi// steng rlung mnan pas bdud rnams 'joms// dbus rlung dkrugs pas bar chod sel// rnal 'byor 'di la sgrub pa pos// du ba la sogs mngon shes so// rnam rtog drwa ba ma lus gcod// shin tu spros med go 'phang thob// sgrub po'i lam gyi gegs byed pa// bar du gcod pa de sel ba// phyi rol bdud kyis dkrugs pa dang*// lus la sems dang rang rig dang*// nad dang sdug bsngal rengs pa yis// bar du gcod pa phal cher la// sngar gyi man ngag bsgoms pa yis// mkha' la sprin tshogs 'khrigs pa la// mi bzad rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin/

gzhan yang bdud kyi bar chad gang*// spros med de nyid dbyings su bstim// rten dang brten pa so so bya// 'dzin pa nyid la gtad par bya// de ltar goms pas spros med 'gyur// dga' dang bde ba dang ba yis// phyi dang gsang ba mtshon par bya// blo yi rtog pa ma zhi na// sems bskyed lam gyi dpa' bskyed la// til mar ngar btags ral gri bzhin// thogs pa med par gzhom par bya// shin tu spros med bla ma'i gsung*// blo yi yul du goms na yang*// spros pa rtsub mos spyod pa'i tshe// blo la spros med kyis ma reg /blo ni phal par brtan par gnas// de tshe spros pa spros med du// ro cig mnyam pa nyid du thim// 'dre dang srin po 'jigs pa'i tshogs// dur khrod ro langs la sogs pa// 'khun dang ngar ba bshugs pa 'bod// 'jigs pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa// sems las ma gtogs gzhan med par// rang sems skar mda' 'phong ba ltar// de yi snying la thim pa yis// blo dang gzhan dang spros med rnams// spros med ye shes nyid du 'gyur// yang na blo de nyid la gtad// bdag gi gces de mchod sbyin bya// mi bzad gdon dang 'go ba'i nad// sdig pa'i rmi lam 'pho ba sogs// gza' dang rgyu skar gdon la sogs// nad dang mya ngan sdug bsngal dang*// dgra dang 'byung ba'i gnod pa dang*// mi dang mi ma yin pa yis// nye bar 'tshe ba sna tshogs pa// thag pa'i sbrul ni sangs pa bzhin// skyug bro ba dang gtsang sbra dang*// 'dzem bag dang ni ngo tsha dang*// spros med ye shes kyis gzhom bya// bla ma 'dod ltar bsgrub bya ste// dga' dang bde dang rangs pa dang*// tshim dang nga rgyal dregs pa dang*// sgeg dang tshul 'chos rgyan la sogs// spros med ye shes ngo bo nyid// zhum dang sgyid lug mi mthun phyogs// thams cad spros med nyid du 'gyur// mi bzad nyon mongs gang yin pa// spros med de nyid las gzhan min// de ltar bgrod dang bgrod min pa// yid du 'ong dang mi 'ong ba// shin tu spros med sems kyis ni// zhen pa nyid du mi bya'o// 'jig rten rnams dang mthun pa yi// rnam gzhag hrul por bshig nas kyang*// dog pa med pa'i sems kyis ni// dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyod// de las yon tan phun sum tshogs// dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur// e ma zhi ba chen po'i chos// e ma khro bo 'jigs mdzad pa// e ma mya ngan 'das pa mchog

/e ma 'khor ba zhi ba nyid// e ma 'di ni rab tu mtshar// skyon ni gang yin yon tan 'gyur// byang chub med cing mngon rtogs med// dngos po min zhing bsgom pa min// khams kyang min zhing rnam shes min// nam mkha'i dkyil dang mtshungs pa nyid// nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pa// chos 'di bde ba chen po'o// sa yang ma yin chu yang min// me min rlung min nam mkha' min// rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis// skye ba 'di la rab tu gnas// dngos po thams cad dngos med bshad// dngos po med ces ma skrag par// rnal 'byor sbyor ba dang 'brel phyir// chad pa ma yin rtag pa min// yan gal med cing kha dog med// thog ma dbus dang mtha' yang spangs// dngos po thams cad med par 'gyur// mchog tu dga' ba'i mtshan nyid do// bsod nams sdig pa dag dang ma 'brel ba// mchog tu dga' ba dri med dga' ba yi// mgon po de nyid gter chen gcig pu ste// kun kyang snying rje'i sems 'dir mgon 'di yod// chos rnams ngo bo bde ba chen po'i mchog /mchog tu lhan cig skyes dga'i ngo bo ni// gzugs med bsod nams med cing sdig pa med// skye dang 'gag pa yod pa ma yin no// de ltar bla ma'i drin gyis rang nyid yid ches dran phyir gsal byas pas// de la nongs gyur dpal ldan bla ma lha mo rnams la bzod par gsol// rgyal ba sras bcas thugs kyi gsang 'di legs par bkod pa yis// bsod nams gang bskyed de yis 'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin gyur cig /shin tu spros pa med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon dpal ldan mthu stobs kyi mgon po thugs spros pa med pa'i dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin du sku'i spros pa dpag tu med pas gdug pa can tshar gcod cing*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bir+wa pas mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /bstan pa srung ba'i lha rnams kyis bu gcig pa ltar bskyangs pas rgyal po gzhan gyi phyir rgol bas glags blta bar ma nus pa'i ljongs/

chos kyi rgyal po'i sku mkhar nyi ma gzugs su rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta dngos grub brnyes pa dpal dar+pan ā tsār+ya dang*/ glo bo lo tsā ba dge slong shes rab rin chen gyis bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o//

༄༅// lhan cig skyes pa'i man ngag bdag byin gyis brlab pa bzhugs so// ri khrod pa chen pos mdzad/ ༄༅// dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// rang bzhin rnam dag gnyis kyis rgyu byas pas// brgyad po 'jig rten pa dang thun mong ste// lnga nyid spang bya lnga nyid lam yang yin// dag byed ngo bo sems kyi rang bzhin sku// bsam mi khyab pa'i rtogs pa rang las byung*// bzhi dang bral te gsum du rtog tu med// dag byed rang bzhin dag pa'i ngang du snang*// gnyis po spangs te lnga nyid lam du bya// lnga la mi chags glang chen smyon pa 'dra// ku sha rlung bskyod spyod 'di bdag la gces// sha'u gsar pa 'dra bar gso ba 'di// kun la gces pa yin zhes ri khrod gsungs// ma rtogs rtogs pa'i spyod pa smyon pa 'dra// rtogs nas mi spyod blun po'i spyod pa yin// gang yang mi rtog de yi ngang la gzhag /grol bar gyur te de nyid the tshom med// gsum po spang bar gyis shig rang la ltos// zhes gdams pa'o// dpal ldan lhan cig skyes pa'i man ngag bdag byin gyis brlab pa zhes bya ba ri khrod pa chen po'i gsung*/ rje mi nyag lo tsā bas bsgyur ba rdzogs so/// / ༄༅// ri khrod pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag bzhugs so// ri khrod pa chen pos mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ shrī sa ha dza sam+ba ra swa a dhiṣ+ṭha naṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal lhan cig skyes pa bde ba chen po'i mchog bdag byin gyis brlab pa zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// kye hoḥsgrub pa'i snying po bde chen rang gi sems// 'khrul pa'i dbang gis rkyen dang bcas gyur kyang*// rgya mtsho'i chu ni dwangs ma'i rang bzhin yin// rnyog ma'i rang bzhin glo bur rkyen las byung*// ma bcos rang sar bzhag na rgyal ba'i thugs// 'di na bla ma'i dus thabs bsten las byung ba ste// thabs kyi rgyal po bya ba thams cad gtang bar bya'o// zhes ri khrod pa chen pos gsungs so// phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag rdzogs so/// /

༄༅// byang chub sems kyi 'grel pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ bo dhi tsit+ta bi ba ra ṇa nā ma/ bod skad du/ byang chub sems kyi 'grel pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos po thams cad dang bral ba// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// chos bdag med par mnyam nyid pas// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pas// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// zhes bya ba 'byung ngo*// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnams kyis ji ltar byang chub chen por thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*/ dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba'i phyir/ dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du byang chub chen por sems bskyed par bgyi'o// byang chub sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgor spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyis de ltar kun rdzob kyi rnam pas byang chub kyi sems smon pa'i rang bzhin can bskyed nas/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i stobs kyis bskyed par bya ba yin pas/ de'i phyir de'i rang bzhin bshad par bya'o// byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid dngos// dpal ldan rdo rje rnams btud nas// byang chub sems kyi bsgom pa ni// srid pa 'jig de bdag gis bshad// sangs rgyas rnams kyis byang chub sems// bdag dang phung sogs rnam rig gi /rtog pa rnams kyis ma bsgribs shing*// rtag tu stong nyid mtshan nyid bzhed// snying rjes brlan pa'i sems kyis ni// 'bad pas bsgom par bya ba yin// thugs rje'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sems ni rtag tu bsgom// mu stegs can gyis gang brtag pa'i// bdag de rig pas rnam dpyad na// phung po kun gyi nang rnams na// gang zhig gnas kyang rnyed ma yin// phung rnams yod kyi de rtag min// de yang bdag gi ngo bo min// 'ga' yang rtag dang mi rtag gnyis// rten dang brten pa'i dngos por med// bdag ces bya de dngos min na// byed por zhes byar ga la rtag

/chos can yod na chos rnams la// 'jig rten na ni spyod la 'jug /gang phyir rtag pas don byed pa// rim dang cig car gyis min pa// de phyir phyi dang nang du ni// rtag pa'i dngos de med pa nyid// gal te nus na ci phyir ltos// de ni cig car dngos 'byin 'gyur// gang zhig dngos gzhan la ltos pa// de ni rtag dang nus ldan min// gal te dngos na rtag min te// dngos rnams rtag tu skad cig phyir// gang phyir mi rtag dngos po la// byed pa po nyid bkag pa med// bdag sogs bral ba'i 'jig rten ni// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung 'dzin blo yis 'joms par 'gyur// phan par bzhed pa rnams kyis ni// gzugs dang tshor dang 'du shes dang*// 'du byed rnam shes phung po lnga// de ltar nyan thos rnams la gsungs// rkang gnyis mchog gis rtag tu yang*// gzugs ni lbu ba rdos 'drar snang*// tshor ba chu yi chu bur 'dra// 'du shes smig rgyu dang mtshungs shing*// 'du byed chu shing dang 'dra la// rnam shes sgyu ma lta bu zhes// phung po bstan pa de lta bu// byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gsungs// 'byung chen bzhi yi rang bzhin can// gzugs kyi phung por rab tu bshad// lhag ma gzugs med nyid du ni// med na mi 'byung phyir na 'grub// de dag rnams kyis ming gzugs sogs// khams rnams gang bshad de dag nyid// skye mched dang ni gzung ba dang*// 'dzin par yang ni shes par bya// gzugs rdul dbang shes skyed min te// de ni dbang po las 'das yin// 'dus pas de rnams skyed byed na// tshogs pa de yang mi 'dod do// phyogs kyi dbye bas phye ba yis// rdul phran la yang dbye ba mthong*// gang la cha shas kyis brtags na// de ni rdul phran ji ltar 'thad// phyi rol don ni rnam gcig la// tha dad shes pa 'jug par 'gyur// yid 'ong gzugs ni gang yin pa// de nyid gzhan las gzhan du 'gyur// bud med gzugs ni gcig pu la// ro dang 'dod bya bza' bya zhes// kun tu chags can khyi rnams bzhin// rnam par rtog pa gsum yin no// don mtshungs pa yis don byed pa// rmi lam gnod pa bzhin min nam// rmi lam sad pa'i gnas skabs na// don med pa la khyad par med// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i ngo bo yis// rnam shes snang ba gang yin pa// rnam shes las ni tha dad par// phyi rol don ni 'ga' yang med// de phyir dngos po'i ngo bo ni// phyi don rnam pa kun tu med// rnam shes so sor snang ba 'di// gzugs kyi rnam par snang bar 'gyur// ji ltar skye bo sems rmongs pas// sgyu ma smig rgyu dri za yi// grong khyer la sogs mthong ba ltar// de bzhin gzugs sogs snang ba yin// bdag tu 'dzin pa bzlog pa'i phyir// phung po khams sogs bstan pa yin// sems tsam pa la gnas nas ni// skal chen rnams kyis de yang spong*// rnam par shes par smra ba la// sna tshogs 'di ni sems su grub// rnam shes rang bzhin gang zhe na// da ni de nyid bshad bya ste// 'di dag thams cad sems tsam zhes// thub pas bstan pa gang mdzad de// byis pa rnams kyis skrag pa ni// spang ba'i phyir yin de nyid min// kun brtags dang ni gzhan dbang dang*// yongs su grub pa 'di nyid ni// stong nyid bdag nyid gcig pu yi// ngo bo sems la brtag pa yin// theg chen dga' ba'i bdag nyid la// chos la bdag med mnyam pa nyid// sems ni gdod nas ma skyes te// sangs rgyas kyis ni mdor bsdus gsungs// rnal 'byor spyod pa pa rnams kyis// rang gi sems kyis dbang byas te// gnas yongs gyur nas dag pa'i sems// so so rang rig spyod yul brjod// 'das pa gang yin de ni med// ma 'ongs pa ni thob pa min// gnas phyir nas ni yongs gyur pa// da ltar ba la ga la yod// ji lta de ltar snang ba min// ji ltar snang de de ltar min// rnam shes bdag med ngo bo ste// rten gzhan rnam par shes pa med// ji ltar khab len dang nye bas// lcags ni myur du yongs su 'khor// de la sems ni yod min te// sems dang ldan bzhin snang bar 'gyur// de bzhin kun gzhi'i rnam shes ni// bden min bden pa bzhin du ni// gang tshe 'gro 'ong g.yo bar 'gyur// de tshe srid pa'ang 'dzin par byed// ji ltar rgya mtsho dang ni shing*// sems ni med kyang g.yo bar 'gyur// de bzhin kun gzhi'i rnam shes ni// lus brten nas ni g.yo ba yin// lus med na ni rnam par shes// yod pa min zhes yongs rtog na// de yi so so rang rig nyid// ci 'dra zhes byar brjod par gyis// so so rang rig nyid brjod pas// de ni dngos po nyid du brjod// 'di de yin zhes brjod par ni// nus min zhes kyang brjod pa yin// rang la nges bzhin gzhan dag la// nges pa bskyed par bya ba'i phyir// rtag tu 'khrul pa med par ni// mkhas rnams rab tu 'jug pa yin// shes pas shes bya rtogs pa ste// shes bya med par shes pa med// de lta na ni rig bya dang*/

rig byed med ces cis mi 'dod// sems ni ming tsam yin pa ste// ming las gzhan du 'ga' yang med// ming tsam du ni rnam rig blta// ming yang rang bzhin med pa yin// nang ngam de bzhin phyi rol lam// yang na gnyis ka'i bar dag tu// rgyal ba rnams kyis sems ma rnyed// de phyir sgyu ma'i rang bzhin sems// kha dog dbyibs kyi dbye ba 'am// gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa'am// skyes pa bud med ma ning sogs// ngo bo sems ni gnas pa min// mdor na sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni// gzigs par ma gyur gzigs mi 'gyur// rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin can// ji lta bur ni gzigs par 'gyur// dngos po zhes bya rnam rtog yin// rnam rtog med pa stong nyid yin// gang du rnam rtog snang gyur pa// der ni stod nyid ga la yod// rtog bya rtog byed rnam pa'i sems// de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis ma gzigs// gang na rtog bya rtog byed yod// der ni byang chub yod ma yin// mtshan nyid med cing skye ba med// yong gyur ma yin ngag lam bral// mkha' dang byang chub sems dang ni// byang chub gnyis med mtshan nyid can// byang chub snying po la bzhugs pa'i// bdag nyid chen po sangs rgyas dang*// brtser ldan kun gyis dus gsum du// stong pa mkha' dang mtshungs par mkhyen// de phyir chos rnams kun gyi gzhi// zhi zhing sgyu ma dang
